title: Platform basics
text:
This page explains the ideas that come back on every page of the platform. Once you know them, any new screen is easy to understand.

Companies and one structure for the group
- The platform serves several companies of the group, and every employee belongs to one company.
- The organization structure is one for the whole group: sectors, departments, sections and units, and every employee belongs to one of them. A unit may be shared between companies.
- Every unit has a head (the leader), set from the employee form or by job title. The head of a unit automatically receives a role made for that unit.
- This structure decides «who is under whom», and permission scopes are built on it.

Roles
- A role is a group of permissions given to a person. A person can hold several roles.
- Roles that come with the system: Employee (every employee has it: the pages of their own account, their own tickets and tasks) and System Admin (every permission at the widest scope).
- Some roles are automatic: the system grants them by a rule (such as «head of a unit» or «job title»), so they change when your position or title changes.
- A permission can also be added to one person, a group of roles or a group of people. The «My access» page shows where each of your permissions comes from.

Scope: how far a permission reaches
Every permission has a scope that says which records it covers. For example, «View employees» with a different scope gives different results.
Scope | Meaning | Example
Own record only | Only what concerns you | An employee sees their own tasks
Their unit | The unit you belong to (or manage) | A colleague sees their section's team
Their unit and 1 level below (up to 5 levels) | Your unit and a set number of levels below it | A sector head sees the departments directly under them
Their unit and below | Your unit and every unit under it | A department head sees all its sections and units
Their whole company | Every unit of your company | HR in one company
All companies | Everything in the group | System administrator
When a unit-based scope falls on a unit shared between companies, your permission reaches only the employees of your own company.

Permissions
- Every page has a view key, and every button or action has its own key (create, edit, delete, approve, reject, export, import…).
- The platform hides what you do not have: a page whose key you lack is not in your menu, and a button whose key you lack is not on the page.
- A menu with one page shows as that page: when your permissions leave only one page under a menu (for example «Tickets»), the sidebar shows that page directly instead of a menu you must open first.
- What is outside your scope looks as if it does not exist: if you open a record outside your scope you get «not found» (404), not «forbidden», so you cannot even tell whether the record exists.
- If you need a permission, ask your administrator and give its name as shown on «My access».

Platform admin mode
The administration pages (roles, permissions, page visibility, list management, audit log, settings…) appear only while platform admin mode is on. A person who may use it works as an ordinary employee until they switch it on. This protects them from changing something important by mistake.
1. Press «Platform admin mode» at the top of the page. The button shows only for people who hold Use platform admin mode («Use platform admin mode»).
2. Enter a fresh code from the authenticator app. A code already used is refused, so wait for the next one if needed. Backup codes are not accepted here.
3. The administration pages appear and the button reads «Admin mode on». To stop, press «Turn off platform admin mode».
- The mode stops by itself after 30 minutes without admin activity; a message tells you, and you switch it on again when needed.
- Repeated wrong codes lock the attempts for a few minutes.
- The permissions of your administrative role (such as System Admin) are not counted on «My access» and do not work unless the mode is on.

Signing in as another employee
A feature for system administrators only, off by default and switched on in Settings → Security. When on, a person who holds Sign in as another employee («Sign in as another employee») and is in platform admin mode can work as any active employee, to see what they see and solve their problem.
- The button «Sign in as this employee» is on the employees list and on the employee's page. After you confirm, a fixed bar shows: «You are working as … — signed in by …» with a «Back to my account» button.
- The session ends when you go back to your account, or by itself after some idle minutes (30 by default).
- What is refused inside the session: turning on admin mode, changing the employee's security (authenticator, devices, sessions), their roles, groups and access, their account status, and the security settings.
- Everything done is recorded in the audit log under the employee's name with the administrator's beside it, and the employee is notified afterwards.

The welcome tour
At your first sign-in the platform highlights its real elements one by one and explains each. You can skip it and restart it from «Restart the tour». The details are in the section «The welcome tour».

Language and page direction
- The platform is in Arabic (right to left, the default) and in English (left to right).
- Switch the language with the button in the top bar or from «Profile». Your choice is saved in your account for every device.

Light and dark theme
Choose «Light», «Dark» or «Follow the device» with the button in the top bar or from «Profile». Every page works in both themes.

Ways to view lists
- Every list shows as a table or cards with the «View» switch, and some lists have a third view that suits their data: a Kanban board for tasks and tickets, and a chart and an icicle chart for the organization structure.
- The platform remembers the last view you chose for each list.

Search and filters
- Above every list is a search box that searches the texts the table shows.
- Beside it are filters for everything that can narrow the list: status, owner, unit, type, dates, yes/no. Applied filters are shown and each can be removed; «Clear filters» removes them all.

Export and import
- Export: an «Export» button on every list. You choose the scope (the rows shown on the page, or all results of the current search and filters), the columns and the file type (Excel or CSV). It needs the export key of that page.
- Import: on lists whose records can be created from a file (such as employees and companies). You download the template (it has drop-downs with the system's options), fill it in and upload it. The system checks the file, tells you how many rows are valid and what is wrong in each row, and imports only the valid ones.
- Dates are written one way everywhere: 2026-12-01, and with the time 2026-12-01 14:30 (24 hours, Riyadh time), in Arabic and in English, in tables, notices, e-mails and exported files. The date picker of the browser itself shows your device's format.
- Viewing an attached picture: the picture opens in a window inside the platform, with zoom in, zoom out and «Fit to the window» buttons, the percentage, the keys + / − / 0 (when the picture frame is focused) and Ctrl + wheel (or a trackpad pinch); a picture bigger than the window scrolls inside its frame. PDF files use the zoom of the PDF viewer itself.
- Attached files: pictures, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint (pptx) and CSV, each up to the size the platform administrator set (10 MB until changed; every attachment box says the number). A chosen file shows as a thumbnail you can click to check it before sending. Word, Excel and PowerPoint open inside the platform as an approximate view (a deck as slides of text and pictures); download the file for the original.
- Your picture in the header: the photo shown beside your name in the header is the same photo of your employee record that the employee lists show; with no photo, your first letter is shown.
- The trail above a page (home › group › page) says a name once: when a menu group and its main page are called the same («Tickets»), only the page appears.
- Anywhere that asks for a file or a picture uses the file drop box: drag the file onto it or click to browse; it checks the file type and the largest size.

Row actions are icons
At the end of every row are icons, one for each action on it (edit, delete, open…). Hold the pointer over an icon to see its name. Clicking anywhere on the row itself opens its details in a page or a dialog.

Notifications
The bell in the top bar alerts you to what concerns you, and every notification is on the «Notifications» page. Some also reach you by e-mail, and the e-mail never carries the text of conversations. The details are in the section «Notifications».

The four message colors
Every message on the platform (a notice in the page, a pop-up message or a status badge) has one of four colors, with an icon, so the meaning never rests on color alone:
Color | Meaning
Blue (petrol) | Information
Yellow | Warning
Red | Error
Green | Success

The audit log
The platform records sensitive operations: sign-ins, changes to employees, roles and permissions, work on tasks and tickets… who did what and when, in sentences you can understand and in categories. Secrets are never recorded. It is read by people who hold the audit-log view key, in platform admin mode.

title: Signing in
text:
There is no password on the platform. You sign in with the company Microsoft account or with your work e-mail, and in both cases a 6-digit code is e-mailed to you at once and you enter it to finish. The authenticator app (Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator) is the second choice, for when the e-mail does not work. No page works before the code is verified.

Who can sign in
- Only employees for whom HR has created an account. There is no self sign-up, and a deactivated account is refused.
- This page has no permission key: it is for anyone who has not signed in yet.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Sign in with Microsoft | You sign in with the company account at Microsoft, then a code reaches your e-mail by itself | Not needed
Type the work e-mail then «Continue» | A code is e-mailed to you by itself and its boxes show (on a first sign-in you choose the way first) | Not needed
Enter the code e-mailed to you (6 digits) | Opens the platform (valid 10 minutes, used once) | Not needed
«Send the code again» | E-mails a new code (once a minute) | Not needed
«Change e-mail» | Takes you back to type another e-mail | Not needed
«Use the app code» | Shows the authenticator-app code boxes, the second choice when the e-mail does not work | Not needed
«Use a backup code» | You sign in with one of the codes you saved when linking | Not needed
«Send the code to my e-mail» | Takes you back from the app code to the e-mailed code, or (on a first sign-in) sends the first code | Not needed
«Remember this device and do not ask for the code there» | Ticked by default: trusts the browser; for the time the platform administrator set, typing your e-mail is enough to sign in there, with no code (also after Microsoft) | Not needed

How to
The usual sign-in with the work e-mail
1. Type your work e-mail and click «Continue». If a bot check appears, complete it.
2. A 6-digit code is e-mailed to you by itself (press nothing). Open your mailbox and enter it in the boxes.
3. The platform opens. «Remember this device and do not ask for the code there» is ticked by default (shown when the platform administrator allows trusted devices): keep it to sign in from this browser with no code next time, and untick it on a shared device.
4. The code did not arrive? Click «Send the code again» (once a minute). The code is valid 10 minutes, works once and stops after 5 wrong tries.
Signing in with the authenticator app code (when the e-mail does not work)
1. After «Continue» click «Use the app code». (If the e-mail could not be sent, a notice shows and the app code stays available.)
2. Open the authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code it shows for your account; it changes every 30 seconds. If the phone is lost, use «Use a backup code».
3. To go back to the e-mailed code click «Send the code to my e-mail».
Signing in with the Microsoft account
1. Click «Sign in with Microsoft» and sign in with the company account.
2. On the «Verify your identity» page the code reaches your mailbox by itself; enter it and click «Continue». On a trusted device no code is asked and nothing is sent. For the app code click «Use the app code».
First sign-in: linking the authenticator app
1. Type your e-mail and continue. A message says: «This is your first sign-in. Choose how to verify»; choose linking the app and open the link with the QR code that we e-mailed you.
2. Open the link in your e-mail. Install Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator on your phone.
3. In the app add an account and scan the QR code. If you cannot scan, enter the key shown by hand.
4. Enter the code shown in the app and press «Confirm and link the app».
5. Backup codes appear. They are shown only once and each works one time. Copy them or download them as a file and keep them safe, then «Continue».
First sign-in: you choose between the e-mailed code and linking the app
1. Type your e-mail and continue. A notice says «This is your first sign-in. Choose how to verify» and no code is sent until you choose.
2. E-mailed code: click «Send the code to my e-mail» and enter the code that arrives. You enter the platform without linking the app and can link it later from «Security».
3. Linking the app: open the link we e-mailed you and follow the «Link your authenticator app» steps above, then sign in with the code shown in the app.
4. After signing in with Microsoft, someone who has not linked the app sees a page with the same two choices: «Link the authenticator app» and «Send the code to my e-mail».
5. Note: switching on admin mode asks the app code, so the system administrator has to link the app.

Fields (form inputs)
The sign-in has three small forms, one after the other. Nothing here is a permission: a person who has not signed in yet holds no keys.
Step 1: the e-mail form
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Work email | The e-mail HR registered for you on the platform. It tells the platform who is signing in and where to send the first-time link | Yes | A well-formed e-mail, up to 254 characters; it must belong to an existing, active employee and use one of the allowed company domains
Bot-protection check (Cloudflare) | A small «I am not a robot» box, shown only when the administrator switched bot protection on (Settings → Bot protection). «Continue» stays disabled until it passes | Only when shown | Solved by you; if it fails you see «The protection check did not pass, try again.»
Step 2: the code form (after «Continue»)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Authenticator code | The 6-digit number your authenticator app shows for your account. It proves the phone is yours. The second choice, shown after «Use the app code» | Yes, if you use it instead of the e-mailed code | 6 digits; it changes every 30 seconds and a code already used is never accepted
Code e-mailed to you | A 6-digit code e-mailed to your work e-mail by itself after «Continue» (on a first sign-in after you press «Send the code to my e-mail»); «Send the code again» for a new one | Yes, it is the first way | 6 digits; valid 10 minutes, works once, 5 wrong tries cancel it
Remember this device and do not ask for the code there | Asks the platform to trust this browser; next time, typing your e-mail signs you in there with no code | No | A tick box, ticked by default and shown only when the administrator allowed trusted devices (Settings → Security, days above 0); the time is the one the administrator set
The «Verify your identity» page (after «Sign in with Microsoft»)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Authenticator code | The same 6-digit code; Microsoft only proves who you are, the code is still asked. The second choice after «Use the app code» | Yes, if you use it instead of the e-mailed code | 6 digits
Code e-mailed to you | The 6-digit code e-mailed to your work e-mail by itself when the page opens; it is the first way | Yes | 6 digits; valid 10 minutes, works once, 5 wrong tries cancel it
Backup code | One of the codes you saved when you linked the app, for when the phone is lost (press «Use a backup code», and «Use the app code» to go back) | Yes, if you use it instead of the app code | 6 to 12 characters, such as K7MQ2-X9PD4; each works once
Remember this device and do not ask for the code there | Trusts this browser | No | A tick box, ticked by default and shown only when trusted devices are allowed
The first-time page «Link your authenticator app» (opened from the link in your e-mail)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
QR code and «Cannot scan? Enter this key manually» | Read-only. Scan the QR with the app, or type the key by hand, so the app starts producing codes for your account | Not typed | Shown only on a valid link
Code shown in the app | Confirms the app works before it is linked | Yes | 6 digits; press «Confirm and link the app»
«Copy codes» / «Download file» (backup codes) | Saves the backup codes. They appear once only | No | Each backup code works one time

Workflow
Normal sign-in, step by step
1. You open the platform and either press «Sign in with Microsoft» or type your work e-mail and press «Continue». If bot protection is on, you solve its check first.
2. The platform looks for your account. It never says whether the e-mail exists: a wrong e-mail or a wrong code gives the same message.
3. The platform e-mails a 6-digit code to you at once (also after Microsoft, unless this is a trusted device). You enter it and press «Sign in» (or «Continue»), or press «Use the app code» and enter the authenticator-app code if the e-mail does not work.
4. The platform checks the code, opens a session in a secure cookie that the page's scripts cannot read, and takes you to the page you asked for, or Home.
5. The sign-in is written to the audit log (category «Sign-in and security»). Nobody else is notified.
First sign-in (linking the app)
1. You type your e-mail and press «Continue». The platform tells you: «This is your first sign-in. Choose how to verify», and e-mails you a link with a QR code to link the app; you choose «Send the code to my e-mail» or link the app from the link.
2. The platform e-mails you a link, which is valid for 72 hours; if HR sends a new invitation, the old link stops working.
3. You open the link, scan the QR in the app (or type the key), enter the code and press «Confirm and link the app».
4. The platform links the app, shows 10 backup codes once (copy or download them), and you press «Continue to sign in». The linking is recorded in the audit log.
If the phone is lost: use «Use a backup code», or ask HR (Reset the authenticator app, «Reset the authenticator app») to reset the app; a new invitation then reaches you by e-mail and you link the app again. Resending the invitation needs Resend the activation link («Resend the activation link»).
Status | Meaning | Who can change it (permission key) | Moves to
App not linked yet | The account exists but the first-time link was not used | HR can resend the invitation (Resend the activation link) | Linked, once you confirm the first code
Linked | The app is linked; every sign-in asks for a code (a trusted device skips it after a Microsoft sign-in or an e-mail sign-in) | HR can reset it (Reset the authenticator app) | App not linked yet
Locked for a while | 5 wrong codes in a row | Nobody; it ends by itself after 15 minutes | Linked
Signed in (session) | A session that ends 2 days after you sign in | You, by signing out or ending it on the Security page; it also ends when your account is deactivated | Signed out
Account deactivated | HR stopped the account; sign-in is refused | HR (Deactivate and activate employees, «Deactivate and activate employees») | Active again if HR reactivates it
What happens by itself
- The session ends 2 days after you sign in, and at once if the account is deactivated.
- A used code is remembered, so the same code is refused the second time.
- The lock after 5 wrong codes lifts after 15 minutes.
- Every sign-in, wrong code and app linking is recorded in the audit log (FR-11).
What each person sees: the page is the same for everybody. After signing in, what you see depends on your roles and scopes, not on how you signed in.

Business rules
- No password and no self sign-up, and the error is one generic message: «The email or the code is not valid» (it does not say which is wrong). (FR-01)
- A code is never accepted twice: each code is used once, so if yours is refused, wait for the next one. (FR-01)
- After 5 wrong codes the account is locked for a while (15 minutes) and «Too many attempts. Try again in a moment» appears. (FR-01)
- More than 5 sign-in attempts in a minute show «Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again».
- Microsoft sign-in is for the company account only and for an employee whose account was created beforehand. If «Microsoft sign-in is not set up yet» appears, contact the system administrator. (FR-03)
- No employee is added with an e-mail outside the domains the administrator set.
- The session ends 2 days after you sign in, and at once if your account is deactivated.
- A «trusted device» skips the code after a Microsoft sign-in and when signing in with an e-mail, for the time the platform administrator set.
- The sign-in is recorded in the audit log. (FR-11)

Tips and common problems
Problem | Cause | Fix
The code is refused | It was already used, or your phone's clock is wrong | Wait for the next code, and set the phone's time to automatic
«Too many attempts» appeared | You passed the allowed attempts | Wait, then try again
You lost your phone | No code available | Use «Use a backup code», or ask HR to reset the app and a new invitation reaches you by e-mail
The link is not valid or has expired | The app-linking link is old | Ask HR for a new invitation
The QR e-mail did not arrive | It is in junk mail, or the account is not active | Check junk mail, then ask HR
«The protection check did not pass» | The bot check did not finish | Try again

title: Home
text:
The first page after signing in: your day at a glance. The numbers of your tasks and tickets and what needs your attention now, charts of them, the task matrix, and for managers the employee statistics. Each number opens the list it counts, so the details are one click away.

Who sees it
- The page is for every employee and needs no view key of its own. Its sections show according to the keys you hold (see the table), and a section disappears if the administrator hides its related page from your role.
- It does not need platform admin mode.
- The «Employee» role holds the tasks and tickets keys at the «Own record only» scope, so you see your own numbers. A unit head holds the task matrix at «Their unit and below», so the team numbers and the employee statistics show for them.
Section on the page | What it needs | Default role
«My numbers» (tasks) and my current tasks | View my tasks and task details | Employee, unit head
Ticket numbers and «My tickets» | View the tickets page and ticket details | Employee, unit head
Task matrix | View the task matrix | Unit head (their unit and below); the Employee if it is given to them
Team numbers | A tasks scope wider than «Own record only» | Unit head
Employee statistics | View employees at a scope wider than «Own record only» | Unit head, HR, system administrator

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Click a number in «My numbers» | Opens the list of tasks or tickets it counts (for example «Overdue tasks» opens tasks filtered by overdue) | View my tasks and task details / View the tickets page and ticket details
Click a task title in «My current tasks» | Opens the task details and its conversation | View my tasks and task details
«All my tasks» | Opens the tasks page | View my tasks and task details
«New task» (shown when you have no open tasks) | Opens the new-task form | Create a task
«All tickets» | Opens the tickets page | View the tickets page and ticket details
Choose «View» in the matrix: «My tasks» or «My team's tasks» | Switches the tasks shown | View the task matrix

What you see
- My numbers (tasks): My open tasks, Overdue tasks, Due within 7 days, Finished (last 30 days), Finished on time (a percentage), and two tiles that appear when something waits for you: «Awaiting my review» and «Awaiting my approval».
- Team numbers (for those with a team scope): Team: overdue, Team: stale, Team: finished (this week).
- Ticket numbers: Tickets I sent, still open; Awaiting my confirmation; Awaiting my reply.
- My current tasks: the nearest open tasks by due date, with a bar that divides your open tasks by status.
- My tickets: what you sent and is still open, what waits for your reply, and what waits for your confirmation.
- Charts: open tasks by status, tasks finished on time and late, my tickets by status, and the employees (active, IDs and contracts).
- The task matrix: your open tasks in four squares by importance and urgency: «Important and urgent» (start with these), «Important, not urgent» (plan them before they become urgent), «Urgent, not important» (finish them fast or hand them to someone), «Neither» (do them when there is time).
- Employee statistics: Employees, Active, IDs expired or expiring (within 30 days), Contracts ending soon (within 30 days), and a «Need a unit» tile when an employee has no unit.

How to
Find what needs your attention
1. Open Home and look at the tiles with an alert tone (red or yellow): overdue items, and what waits for your reply, confirmation or approval.
2. Press the tile to open what it counts.
3. Do what is needed and come back to Home to see the number go down.
Set your priorities with the matrix
1. Look at the «Important and urgent» square and start with its tasks.
2. Plan the «Important, not urgent» tasks before their date comes close.
3. If you are a manager, switch «View» to «My team's tasks» to see your team's tasks.

Fields (form inputs)
Home has no form to fill. It has one choice, and the tiles themselves are links.
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Show (the «View» choice in the task matrix) | Chooses whose open tasks fill the four squares | No (it starts on «My tasks») | «My tasks», or «My team's tasks» (offered only to people whose task scope reaches a team)

Business rules
- A task is «important» when its priority is high, and «urgent» when its date is near or past or it was marked urgent. (FR-49)
- The numbers and sections are counted from your scope only; nothing outside it enters any number.
- The «Awaiting my review» and «Awaiting my approval» tiles show only when something waits for you.
- The employee statistics are about other people, so an ordinary employee (scope «Own record only») does not see them.
- A greeting with your first name appears at the top of the page.

Tips
- If a section does not appear, its key is not yours or its page is hidden from your role; check «My access».
- A number «0» is not a fault: it means nothing waits for you.

title: The welcome tour
text:
A guided tour that appears once at your first sign-in: it dims the screen and highlights the real elements one by one, explaining each in a bubble with a title, a text and the buttons «Next», «Back» and «Skip». It starts with your account, then Home, then the pages you hold. A manager has a separate tour for the administration pages, and a page in Settings to edit the tour's wording.

Who sees it
- The general tour: every employee at first sign-in, with no permission key.
- The administration tour: whoever holds Use platform admin mode («Use platform admin mode») at the first time admin mode is turned on; for anyone else it looks as if it does not exist.
- The tour settings page (Settings, then the «Welcome tour» tab): in platform admin mode, and it needs View the welcome tour settings («View the welcome tour settings»). By default only the System Admin role has it.

What you can do
In the tour itself (every employee)
Action | What happens | Permission
«Next» / «Back» (or the arrow keys) | You move between steps, even between pages | Not needed
«Skip» (or Esc) | The tour ends and is recorded as skipped | Not needed
«Done» on the last step | The tour is recorded as finished | Not needed
«Restart the tour» from your account menu or from «Profile» | The general tour starts again from the beginning | Not needed
«Show me» on the «There is something new» card | Shows only the new steps | Not needed
«Later» on that card | Postpones; the steps count as seen | Not needed
On the tour settings page (for managers)
Action | What happens | Permission
View the list | A table of steps: Step, Order, Tour (General / Administration), State (Shown / Switched off), Last change; with a table or cards view | View the welcome tour settings
Search and filters | Search in the title and text, and filters by tour, by state and by «Changed from the original» | View the welcome tour settings
The «Edit» icon (or clicking the row) | Opens a dialog with the title and text in Arabic and English | Edit the wording of a welcome-tour step
The «Switch the step off» / «Switch the step on» icon | Switches the step off or on at once, without touching its wording | Switch a welcome-tour step on or off
The «Move the step up» and «Move the step down» icons | Move the step in the order | Reorder the welcome-tour steps
The «Reset to original» icon (shown only for a changed step) | After confirmation the step's wording, order and visibility go back to what the system has | Reset a welcome-tour step to its default wording
«Export» | Exports the list of steps to Excel or CSV | Export the list of welcome-tour steps

How to
Restart the tour
1. Press your name in the top bar to open your account menu.
2. Press «Restart the tour». (Or from «Profile», the «Welcome tour» section, then «Restart the tour».)
Reword a step (for managers)
1. Turn on platform admin mode, then open «Settings» and the «Welcome tour» tab.
2. Click the step or its edit icon.
3. Type the title and text in Arabic and English. Leave a field empty to show the original wording. Plain text, no formatting.
4. Turn off the «The step is shown in the tour» switch if you want to hide it, then save.
5. To go back to the original press the «Reset to original» icon and confirm.

Business rules
- The result of the tour (finished or skipped) is saved on your account, not in the browser, so it does not come back from another device. (FR-67)
- Every step shows only to someone who holds the key of its page and does not have it hidden; so two people see two different lists. Each step lists one line for everything you can do there.
- A step whose element does not show (for example on a phone, or with no data) is skipped silently.
- After new steps are released, someone who finished their tour is offered a «There is something new» card with only the new ones.
- The administration tour starts the first time admin mode is turned on, and is recorded separately from the general tour.
- A system administrator edits only the wording, the order and the visibility. The steps themselves (what is highlighted and where) come with the system and cannot be added or removed from Settings, and the manager cannot see anyone's progress in the tour.
- Every edit, reset to original or reorder is recorded in the audit log.

Tips
- Keyboard: arrows to move, Esc to skip.
- If you lost the tour, restart it at any time.

title: The platform assistant
text:
A chat you can open from any page of the platform. Instead of going through several pages, you tell the assistant what you want to do («add a ticket type called Technical problem to my unit»). It asks for anything missing, shows you a card with what it is going to do, and does it only after you press «Confirm», with your own permissions: it can do only what you could do yourself with the buttons of the platform.

Who sees it
- Open key: Open the platform assistant («Open the platform assistant»). Writing to it and confirming its requests needs Talk to the platform assistant and confirm its requests («Talk to the platform assistant and confirm its requests»). Seeing your earlier conversations needs View my earlier conversations with the assistant («View my earlier conversations with the assistant»).
- Attaching pictures to a message needs Attach pictures in the assistant chat («Attach pictures in the assistant chat»), and speaking needs Speak to the platform assistant («Speak to the platform assistant»). All three groups of keys are held by everyone with the Employee role and by unit heads. The round button is in the bottom corner of every page. It does not need platform admin mode.
- What the assistant does for you always goes through the permission of the action itself. If you cannot add a ticket type yourself, the assistant cannot add one for you; it does not even offer it.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Open the assistant | A panel opens beside the page | Open the platform assistant
Write a request | The assistant understands it, asks for what is missing, and prepares a request | Talk to the platform assistant and confirm its requests
«Confirm» on the card | The request runs as you, once | Talk to the platform assistant and confirm its requests and the permission of the action itself
«Cancel» on the card | The request is dropped | Talk to the platform assistant and confirm its requests
«Earlier conversations» | Lists your past conversations and opens one | View my earlier conversations with the assistant
Paperclip «Attach a picture» (also paste with Ctrl/Cmd+V, or drop on the writing box) | Uploads a screenshot to send with your message | Attach pictures in the assistant chat
Microphone «Speak to the assistant» (also a sound file in the paperclip box) | Records or reads your speech and writes it into the writing box | Speak to the platform assistant
A picture in a message, or on a card | Opens it in a window | Open the platform assistant (your own conversation only)
Tick box under a picture on a card | Chooses whether that picture goes with the request | Talk to the platform assistant and confirm its requests

How it works
1. Write what you want in your own words, in Arabic or English.
2. If mandatory fields are missing, the assistant lists all of them in one message for you to fill. It never guesses a value you did not give, and it matches names by meaning (a unit written a little differently is still found; if several are close it asks which).
3. When everything is there, a card shows the name of the action and a summary in plain words. A card that deletes something is red and names the item.
4. Press «Confirm» to run it, or «Cancel». The card waits a limited time (30 minutes unless the administrator changed it) and then expires; ask again if that happens.
5. After it runs you see «Done», or why it was not done (for example, the platform refused a value).

Do I have permission?
Ask «can I add an employee?». The assistant looks at everything the platform can do, not only at what you can do, and tells you plainly: you can; or you lack the permission (it names it, and an administrator can give it); or its page is hidden from your roles; or it must be done from its page (it needs admin mode, a file upload or an import); or the platform has nothing like it.

Pictures (screenshots)
Press the paperclip beside the writing box, paste a screenshot straight into the box (Ctrl/Cmd+V), or drop an image on the box. Each picture is uploaded at once and shown small above the box with a ✕ to take it out before sending. You may send up to 3 pictures in one message, PNG or JPG, up to 5 MB each, and a picture alone (no text) is a message.
- The assistant looks at the picture when the AI service the administrator switched on can read pictures, so you do not have to describe an error message or a wrong screen in words. If that service cannot read pictures, the assistant tells you so and asks you to describe the problem; your picture is still kept and can still go with a request.
- Do not attach sensitive data (salaries, ID numbers). A picture cannot be masked like typed numbers are, and it is sent to the AI service. Only you see your pictures: nobody else can open them, not even through the conversation.
- When the assistant prepares a request that takes files (for example a ticket), its card shows the pictures of the conversation with a tick box each, all ticked. The ones you leave ticked are attached to the ticket when you press «Confirm»; untick any you do not want attached. The assistant never chooses the files itself.
- Pictures stay with the conversation. A picture attached to a ticket stays on the ticket, seen by whoever may see the ticket.

Speaking to the assistant
Press the microphone, allow it in the browser the first time, speak, and press it again to stop (a recording lasts at most 5 minutes). Or press the paperclip and choose a sound file (mp3, m4a, wav, ogg… anything your browser can play, up to 5 minutes), for example a voice note from your phone. The sound is written down and the text appears in the writing box: read it, correct any word the listening got wrong (names and numbers often do), and press send. Nothing reaches the assistant before you send it. If you already typed something, the speech is added after it.
- Whether it works depends on the AI service the administrator switched on. Claude does not take sound; with it the screen says «the AI service that is switched on does not take sound», and you type instead. Some other services take it and some do not.
- Your recording is sent to the AI service to be written down and is not kept by the platform: no file, no copy in the conversation, only the text you choose to send. Speech cannot be hidden like typed numbers, so do not say sensitive data (salaries, ID numbers).
- A very long speech is cut at the size of a message and the screen says so. Recording counts toward your messages per hour.
- If the microphone is blocked, allow it for the platform in the browser's address bar, or choose a sound file instead.

Links and the form
- After it explains where something is, buttons under its message open the matching section of this manual and the page itself (the page button shows only if the page is in your menu).
- When fields are missing, the assistant asks and also shows an «Open the form» button: a real form with all the fields, filled with what it understood, with lists to choose from (ticket types, units…). «Send the form» makes the same confirmation card; nothing runs until you press «Confirm».

Asking «how do I…?»
Ask the assistant how to do something («how do I add a ticket type?»). It answers with the whole workflow from this user manual: the page, each button in order, the fields, and the permission needed. It explains only what you may do: a page you cannot open is not explained to you.

Fields (form inputs)
Field | What it is for
«Write your message» (the box at the bottom of the panel) | What you ask for, in your own words. Needs Talk to the platform assistant and confirm its requests.
The paperclip file box | The pictures to send with the message: PNG or JPG, up to 3, 5 MB each. Needs Attach pictures in the assistant chat.
The fields of the form the assistant opens | They are not fixed: they are the fields of the action you asked for (for a ticket type: the unit, the Arabic and English names, and so on). A star marks a mandatory field; a choice list shows real data of the platform; a mistake is shown under its field as you type, and the send button waits until all is right.

Workflow
State of a card | Meaning | Who moves it | Permission
Waiting for you | The request is ready and nothing has run | The assistant makes it | —
Confirmed | It ran once as you | You press «Confirm» | Talk to the platform assistant and confirm its requests and the action's own permission
Failed | The platform refused (a value, a rule); the reason is shown | The platform | —
Cancelled | You dropped it, or a newer request in the same conversation replaced it | You or the assistant | Talk to the platform assistant and confirm its requests
Expired | Nobody confirmed it in time (30 minutes unless changed) | Automatic | —
A form follows the same road: «Open» until you send it, then «Sent», which makes the confirmation card. Everyone sees only their own conversations; a person with Open the platform assistant and without Talk to the platform assistant and confirm its requests can read the assistant's answers but not write, confirm or send forms.

Business rules
- The assistant runs nothing by itself: every change waits for «Confirm», and a request runs once (two presses at the same moment run it once) (FR-141).
- It acts only with your own permissions, in your own scope; an action you may not do is not offered, and a record out of your scope is not found (FR-139).
- An id is accepted only if one of its own lookups showed it, together with its name; it never invents one (FR-140).
- At most six steps are taken for one message; after that it says it could not finish (FR-138).
- A card expires after the time the administrator set (30 minutes by default); a new request replaces the one still waiting (FR-141).
- Only an image (PNG or JPG) of at most 5 MB is accepted, checked by its real content and not by its name; at most 3 per message; each picture goes with one message only (FR-180).
- A recording is a 16-bit WAV of at most 5 minutes and 10 MB made by your browser; it is written down by the AI service, never stored, and what you read is text you may edit (FR-181).
- Pictures are read only by the owner of the conversation they came with; anyone else gets «not found» (FR-180).
- The pictures that go with a request are the ones you left ticked on its card, never ones the assistant chose, and only from this conversation (FR-180).
- The messages per hour are limited (30 by default); a message the AI service could not answer does not count (FR-144).
- If the administrator switches the assistant off, nothing it prepared can be confirmed (FR-150).
- Sensitive fields of platform records (national ID, IBAN, salary) are removed by field name from lookup results, and an IBAN or any number of ten digits or more that you type is replaced by «[hidden number]», before the AI service receives them (your own message keeps what you wrote); still, do not type a national ID or an IBAN in a chat. What the assistant runs is written to the audit log as coming through the assistant (FR-144).

Good to know
- The assistant never changes anything by itself. The most it does is prepare a card.
- It cannot upload files other than your screenshots, import lists, sign you in or out, or change system settings. Do those from their pages.
- You see what the assistant is doing and its answer as it is written, not only at the end.
- There is a limit on how many messages you may send in an hour (30 unless the administrator changed it).
- What you write, the names it looks up and the pictures you attach are sent to the AI service the administrator switched on in the settings. Do not write passwords or other secrets to it, and do not attach pictures that show them.
- A new request in the same conversation cancels a card still waiting.
- Your conversations are private to you.

For the administrator
In Settings, the «Security» tab has a «Platform assistant» part with a check box «Switch the platform assistant on» (off: the button disappears for everyone and nothing it prepared can be confirmed; conversations are kept) and two numbers: messages per employee per hour and minutes a request waits for confirmation. The AI service itself (Claude or the free compatible service) is set in the «Artificial intelligence» tab.

title: Profile
text:
Your own page: here you set the look and language of the platform, edit your contact details, see your work details as HR keeps them, and restart the welcome tour if you wish.

Who sees it
- View key: View my profile («View my profile»), and edit key Edit my contact details and preferences («Edit my contact details and preferences»). Their scope is «all» because they concern your own account only.
- Held by everyone who has the Employee role, by unit heads, and by everyone who holds the «collaborator base».
- You find it in your account menu (press your name in the top bar, then «Profile»).
- It does not need platform admin mode.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Choose the theme: Light, Dark, Follow the device | The platform's look changes at once and is saved in your account | Edit my contact details and preferences
Choose the language: العربية, English | The language and the page direction change at once and your choice is saved | Edit my contact details and preferences
Edit the personal phone | Your contact number is saved | Edit my contact details and preferences
Edit the personal e-mail | Your personal e-mail is saved | Edit my contact details and preferences
Edit the full name in English | Your English name is saved | Edit my contact details and preferences
«Request a change» on the basic data card (Arabic name, gender, nationality, birth date, marital status) | A request with only what you changed goes to HR; your data does not change until HR approves, and you get a notice of the decision | Request a change of my basic data (HR approves) (Request a change of my basic data)
«Cancel the request» | Your request is cancelled while it waits, so you can send another | Request a change of my basic data (HR approves)
«Save changes» | Saves the contact details and shows «Changes saved» | Edit my contact details and preferences
«Restart the tour» | The welcome tour starts again from the beginning | Not needed (every employee)
The «Security and authenticator app» link | Takes you to the Security page | View the security page

How to
Change the language or theme
1. Open «Profile» from your account menu.
2. In the «Appearance» section choose the theme (Light, Dark, Follow the device) and the language.
3. The choice applies at once and is saved for all your devices.
Update your contact details
1. In the «Contact details» section type the personal phone in international format, such as +966501234567.
2. Type the personal e-mail and the full name in English (English letters and spaces only).
3. Press «Save changes».
See your work details
In the «Work details» section you read: employee number, company, unit, job title, direct manager, work e-mail and start date. These are read-only.

Fields (form inputs)
The page has two forms. The appearance choices save the moment you pick them; the contact form saves with «Save changes». All fields need the key Edit my contact details and preferences («Edit my contact details and preferences»); without it the contact fields are shown but cannot be changed.
Appearance
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Theme | How the platform looks to you: bright, dark, or following your phone or computer | No (one is always chosen) | Light, Dark, Follow the device. Saved on your account, so every device shows it
Language | The language of the screens and the direction of the page (right-to-left for Arabic) | No (one is always chosen) | العربية, English. Saved on your account
Contact details
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Personal phone | A number HR can reach you on outside work | No (leave it empty to clear it) | International format with a plus sign, 7 to 15 digits after it, such as +966501234567; no spaces
Personal e-mail | An e-mail outside the company for contacting you | No (leave it empty to clear it) | A well-formed e-mail up to 255 characters; it must differ from your work e-mail
Full name in English | How your name is written in English on documents and screens | No (leave it empty to clear it) | Up to 255 characters; English letters and spaces only (a hyphen or apostrophe inside a name is fine, no doubled separators), starting with a letter
Work details (employee number, company, unit, job title, direct manager, work e-mail, start date) are not fields: they are shown for reading only and HR changes them.

Workflow
1. You open «Profile» from your account menu.
2. You pick the theme and the language. The platform applies them at once and saves them to your account; no button is needed.
3. You edit the personal phone, the personal e-mail or the English name. The form checks each field as you type or leave it, and «Save changes» stays disabled while a field is wrong.
4. You press «Save changes». The platform checks the same rules again, saves them on your employee record and shows «Changes saved».
5. The audit log records «Edited their own profile» (category «Employees»). Nobody else is notified.
6. HR sees the new contact details on your employee record; HR alone changes the Arabic name and the work details.
There are no statuses: a change is saved at once or refused with a message under the field.
Automatic things: the theme and language are applied on every device you sign in on; nothing is sent by e-mail.
What each person sees: only your own profile, whatever your scope is. A person whose account has no employee record sees only the appearance choices. A platform administrator who signs in as you cannot change your profile.

Business rules
- Basic data with approval: one pending request at a time, carrying only the fields that changed. If HR rejects it you see its reason (when written) and may send a new one. The birth date must be in the past and the age between 18 and 70. The request and the decision are audited by field names, never values.
- You edit directly only three things: the personal phone, the personal e-mail and the English name. HR updates the rest of the employee record.
- The phone must be in international format (such as +966501234567) or «International format, e.g. +966501234567» is shown; the e-mail must be well formed; the English name is English letters and spaces only.
- The theme and language are saved in your account, not in the browser, so they appear as you chose on any device.
- If your account is not linked to an employee record, only the appearance settings are shown, with a note saying so.
- Changing your details is recorded in the audit log.

Tips
- The «Save changes» button does not show? You do not hold Edit my contact details and preferences; ask the system administrator.
- Changing the Arabic name or the work details is asked from HR.

title: Notifications
text:
The platform alerts you to what concerns you: a reply to your ticket, a task assigned to you, a mention of your name in a conversation, or something waiting for your approval. Notifications reach you from the bell in the top bar, and all of them are together on the Notifications page.

Who sees it
- View key: View the notifications page and the bell («View the notifications page and the bell»), scope «all» because notifications are yours alone.
- Held by everyone with the Employee role, by unit heads, and by the collaborator base. It does not need platform admin mode.
- Nobody sees another person's notifications.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Press the bell | A list opens with the latest five notifications and a «View all notifications» link | View the notifications page and the bell
Click a notification in the bell or on the page | Opens the related page and marks it as read | View the notifications page and the bell
«Mark all as read» (in the bell and on the page) | All your notifications become read | Mark notifications as read
The «Mark as read» icon on a row | Only this notification is marked | Mark notifications as read
The «Open» icon on a row | Opens the page linked to the notification | View the notifications page and the bell
Search the title or text | Narrows the list | View the notifications page and the bell
Filters: State (Unread / Read), From date, To date | Narrow the list | View the notifications page and the bell
«Export» | Exports your notifications to Excel or CSV (scope and columns) | Export notifications

How to
Read your notifications
1. Look at the bell: the yellow number on it is the count of unread ones («99+» if more).
2. Press the bell, then press a notification to go straight to the task or ticket it is about.
3. For older ones press «View all notifications».
Find an old notification
1. Open the «Notifications» page.
2. Type a word in the search box, or choose «Unread», or set dates.
3. Open the notification by clicking its row.
Export your notifications
1. On the page press «Export».
2. Choose the scope (the rows shown or all results), the columns (Title, Text, Time, State) and the file type.
3. Press «Export».

Fields (form inputs)
The page has no form to save; it has a search box, filters and the export window. No field here changes a notification.
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Search the title or text | Finds notifications by a word in their title or body | No | Free text
State | Shows only unread or only read notifications | No | Unread, Read (empty = both)
From date | Shows notifications from this day on | No | A date
To date | Shows notifications up to this day | No | A date, not meant to be before «From date»
Scope (in the «Export data» window) | How many rows go into the file | Yes | «The rows shown on this page (N)» or «All results of the current search and filters (N)»; a single export holds a limited number of rows and the window says when it caps
Columns | Which columns to put in the file | Yes, at least one | «Select all» / «Clear selection»; the window shows «N of M columns»
File type | The format of the file | Yes | Excel (.xlsx) or CSV (.csv)
Export columns offered: Title, Text, Time, State. Export needs Export notifications («Export notifications»).

Workflow
How a notification reaches you
1. Someone or something does an action that concerns you: a task is assigned to you, your ticket gets a reply, your name is mentioned with @, a confirmation or approval is asked of you, or a «sign in as» session in your name ends.
2. The platform saves your notification in the same step as the action itself, so a notification is never lost if the action succeeded. It appears in the bell and on this page at once.
3. If the notice also goes by e-mail, the platform puts the e-mail in a waiting queue in the same step; a background process takes it out within about a second and sends it. The e-mail is written in your language and never carries the text of a comment or conversation.
4. The sent e-mail is recorded in the e-mail log (status Pending, then Sent or Failed), which the system administrator can read.
5. You see the yellow number on the bell, press the bell or open the page, and press the notification: it opens its page and is marked read.
Status | Meaning | Who can change it (permission key) | Moves to
Unread | New; shown in heavier type and counted on the bell | You, by opening it, with «Mark as read» or «Mark all as read» (Mark notifications as read, «Mark notifications as read») | Read
Read | You have seen it; shown in a lighter color | Nobody changes it back | Stays read
Automatic things
- The in-app notification is created at once; the e-mail copy is sent in the background by a queue, and each queued message is processed only once even if the process repeats.
- Some repeated reminders are not repeated while an earlier one with the same link is still unread.
- Nothing is deleted by you; there is no delete button.
What each person sees: only your own notifications; nobody, not even an administrator, sees another person's.

Business rules
- In-app notifications reach you at once, and some also reach you by e-mail in the background. The e-mail never carries the text of comments and conversations. (FR-08)
- An unread notification shows in heavier type, and a read one in a lighter color.
- Clicking a notification that has a link marks it read automatically and opens the link. A notification with no link opens nothing.
- You are notified when a task is assigned to you, when your ticket gets a reply, when your name is mentioned with @ in a conversation, when a confirmation or approval is asked of you, and when someone who signed in as you (a system administrator) finishes their session.
- What you lack the key for does not show: a person without Mark notifications as read does not see the mark-as-read buttons.

Tips
- You do not see the bell or the page? You do not hold View the notifications page and the bell, or the page is hidden from your role.
- You got an e-mail but see no notification? Open the page and clear the filters; it may be filtered on «Unread».

title: Security
text:
A page that shows how your sign-in is protected, and lets you watch the devices you are signed in on and end the ones you do not know. There is no password on the platform; the authenticator app on your phone is the key.

Who sees it
- View key: View the security page («View the security page»), scope «all» because it concerns your own account.
- Held by everyone with the Employee role, by unit heads, and by the collaborator base. You find it in your account menu. It does not need platform admin mode.
- The company-wide security settings (trusted devices, request limits and signing in as another employee) are another page for the system administrator: Settings, then the «Security» tab. It needs View the security settings (trusted devices and request limits) («View the security settings (trusted devices and request limits)») and Edit the security settings («Edit the security settings») in platform admin mode.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Read the authenticator-app status | Tells you whether it is linked to your account | View the security page
«End the session» on a device | That session ends and a sign-in is needed again there | View the security page
«End all other sessions» | Every session ends except your current one | View the security page
«Remove trust» on a trusted device | The code is asked on that browser again | View the security page
«Remember this device and do not ask for the code there» | Trusts the current browser | View the security page

What is on the page
- The status notice: «The authenticator app is linked to your account» (green) or «The authenticator app is not linked yet» (yellow).
- How sign-in works: no password; you sign in with the work e-mail and the app code or with the Microsoft button; even with Microsoft the code is asked every time; the session ends 2 days after you sign in, and at once if your account is deactivated.
- Devices you are signed in on: every open session in your name, with the device name and last activity, and a «This device» mark on your current session.
- Trusted devices: the browsers you trusted and the date the trust ends.
- Lost your phone? A note on what to do.

How to
End a session you do not know
1. Open «Security» from your account menu.
2. In «Devices you are signed in on» look for a device or a time you do not know.
3. Press «End the session» on it, or «End all other sessions» if you doubt your account.
4. Tell HR or the system administrator if you suspect a break-in.
If you lose your phone
1. On the sign-in page choose «Use a backup code» and enter one of the codes you saved when linking (each works once).
2. If you cannot find them, ask HR to reset the app; a new invitation reaches you by e-mail to link the app again.

Fields (form inputs)
This page has almost nothing to type: you read your protection and press buttons. The authenticator code is typed on the sign-in page, and the company-wide numbers are on the Settings page (see «Settings», the Security tab).
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Remember this device and do not ask for the code there | Trusts the current browser so the code is not asked there again for a while | No | A tick box, shown only when the administrator allowed trusted devices (days above 0); the trust lasts the days the administrator set
«End the session» (on each device row) | Ends that one sign-in | Not a field | Each row shows the device name, the hidden-end address, the last activity and a «This device» mark on your own session
«End all other sessions» | Ends every session except the one you are using | Not a field | Needs no typing
«Remove trust» (on each trusted device) | Makes that browser ask for the code again | Not a field | Each row shows the browser, the date the trust ends and a «This browser» mark

Workflow
Checking and closing sessions
1. You open «Security» from your account menu and read the status: «The authenticator app is linked to your account» (green) or «not linked yet» (yellow).
2. You look at «Devices you are signed in on». Each open sign-in in your name is listed.
3. You press «End the session» on a device you do not know, or «End all other sessions» if you doubt the account. The session ends at once and a new sign-in is needed on that device.
4. You tell HR or the system administrator if you suspect a break-in.
Trusting a browser (only when allowed)
1. You sign in with Microsoft and enter the code, ticking «Remember this device and do not ask for the code there».
2. The platform lists the browser under «Trusted devices» with the date the trust ends. On that browser the code is skipped until that date: after a Microsoft sign-in, and when you sign in with your e-mail (typing it is enough). If the administrator has not set any days, nothing is remembered and the code is asked every time.
3. You press «Remove trust» when you want the code asked there again.
Status | Meaning | Who can change it (permission key) | Moves to
Session open | A sign-in in your name, with its last activity | You, with «End the session» or «End all other sessions» (View the security page); the platform 2 days after the sign-in, or the account is deactivated | Ended
Session ended | The device must sign in again | Nobody | Nothing (a new sign-in is a new session)
Trusted device | A browser that skips the code after a Microsoft sign-in or an e-mail sign-in | You, with «Remove trust» (View the security page); it also ends by itself on its end date | Trust removed or expired
Authenticator app: linked / not linked | Whether a code can be produced for your account | HR resets it (Reset the authenticator app) | Not linked, until you link it again from the new invitation
Automatic things: sessions end 2 days after the sign-in, and all at once when your account is deactivated; a trusted device stops being trusted on its end date; when a system administrator finishes a «sign in as» session in your name, you are notified.
What each person sees: only your own sessions and devices. The company-wide security settings are another page for the system administrator.

Business rules
- Nothing works on the platform before the code is verified: with the authenticator app or with a code e-mailed to you (on a first sign-in the employee chooses between linking the app and the e-mailed code). (FR-02, FR-164)
- You do not change the link from this page; a reset is done by asking HR.
- A trusted device skips the code, after a Microsoft sign-in and when signing in with the e-mail, after one code entry (from the app or by e-mail), and for a time the platform administrator sets. If the time is 0 the option is off (the default).
- Ending a session or removing trust takes effect at once.
- The code of platform admin mode (Settings, «Security» tab, Edit the security settings, in admin mode): «Switching on admin mode needs a code from the authenticator app» is ticked by default, so every activation asks for a fresh 6-digit code. Untick it only while testing: admin mode then turns on with one click and a warning shows under the box, because anyone holding an open session of an administrator could switch it on. Tick it again when you finish; the change is recorded in the audit log. (FR-34)
- A system administrator who signs in as you (the «Sign in as another employee» feature) cannot change your security from inside the session, and you are notified when it ends.
- When your account is deactivated, all your sessions end at once.

Tips
- A session with a browser or city you do not know? End it at once.
- On a shared device do not trust the device, and sign out from the top menu when you finish.

title: My access
text:
A page where you read what you may do on the platform now, and which role or group gives you each permission, and how far each permission reaches. It is yours alone and nobody else sees it. It is the first place to open when you ask: «why do I not see this page?» or «why can I not use this button?».

Who sees it
- View key: View my access page («View my access page»), and the export key Export my access («Export my access»). Their scope is «all» because the page concerns your own account.
- Held by everyone with the Employee role, by unit heads, and by the collaborator base. You find it in your account menu. It does not need platform admin mode.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Read «My roles» | You see your roles, each marked «Automatic from the system» or «Given to you» | View my access page
Browse the table | You see every permission: «What you can do», «Area», «Reach» and «Source», grouped by area | View my access page
Search | By permission, area or source | View my access page
Filters: Area, Reach, Source | Narrow the list | View my access page
«Turn on platform admin mode» from the notice | Shown to someone with a hidden administrative role (see the rules) | Use platform admin mode
«Export» | Exports your list of permissions to Excel or CSV | Export my access

Table columns
Column | Meaning
What you can do | The name of the permission (every page and every button)
Area | The section it belongs to: tasks, tickets, employees…
Reach | How far it goes: own record only, their unit, their unit and below, their whole company, all companies, or «their unit and N level(s) below»
Source | Where it came from: a role, a group of roles, a group of people, or «given to you directly»

How to
Find out why you do not see something
1. Open «My access».
2. Type in the search what you want (such as «export» or «employees»).
3. If you do not find it, you do not hold it; ask the system administrator and give its name as written on this page.
4. If you find it, look at «Reach»: you may hold it at a narrower reach than you thought (for example «Own record only»).
Find the source of a permission
Look at the «Source» column. If it is an automatic role (such as head of a unit), it changes when your position in the structure changes.

Fields (form inputs)
The page is read-only. It has a search box, three filters, the export window and the code window of platform admin mode.
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Search my permissions | Finds permissions by the permission, the area or where it comes from | No | Free text
Area | Narrows to one section of the platform (tasks, tickets, employees…) | No | The areas of the permissions you hold
Reach | Narrows to permissions of one reach | No | Own record only, their unit, their unit and 1 to 5 levels below, their unit and below, their whole company, all companies
Source | Narrows to permissions that come from one place | No | A role, a group of roles, a group of people, or given to you directly
Scope (in the «Export data» window) | How many rows go into the file | Yes | «The rows shown on this page (N)» or «All results of the current search and filters (N)»; a single export holds a limited number of rows and the window says when it caps
Columns | Which columns to put in the file | Yes, at least one | «Select all» / «Clear selection»; the window shows «N of M columns»
File type | The format of the file | Yes | Excel (.xlsx) or CSV (.csv)
The window «Turn on platform admin mode» (opened from the notice, only if you may use admin mode)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Authenticator app code | A fresh code that proves it is really you before the administrative pages and permissions appear | Yes | Exactly 6 digits from the app (a backup code is not accepted); a new code each time and a code already used is refused; after several wrong tries it locks for a few minutes

Workflow
1. You open «My access» from your account menu. The platform reads your roles, groups and personal permissions once after sign-in.
2. You read «My roles» (each marked «by the system» or «given to you») and the table of everything you may do, with its area, reach and source.
3. You search or filter when you look for one permission, for example «export».
4. If something is missing, you send the permission's name (and the export if you wish) to the system administrator, who gives it from the Permissions page or the employee form.
5. If a notice says your administrative role is hidden, you press «Turn on platform admin mode», enter a fresh code, and the hidden permissions appear.
6. The page refreshes by itself when admin mode changes.
Status of admin mode | Meaning | Who can change it (permission key) | Moves to
Off | You work as an ordinary employee; administrative permissions are hidden | You, with a fresh code (Use platform admin mode, «Use platform admin mode») | On
On | The administration pages show and their permissions count | You, by turning it off (Use platform admin mode) | Off
Ended by itself | 30 minutes passed without admin activity | Nobody; the platform ends it | Off (turn it on again when needed)
Automatic things: admin mode ends by itself after 30 minutes without admin activity, and each admin action moves the time forward; turning it on and off, and its automatic end, are recorded in the audit log.
What each person sees: only your own permissions. Nothing here is edited; changes are made by the administrator elsewhere.

Business rules
- It is read-only; permissions are not edited here but on the permissions or roles page by the system administrator.
- If you have an administrative role (such as System Admin), its permissions are hidden here until you turn on platform admin mode, and a notice says so with the turn-on button.
- If you hold one permission from several sources, the one with the widest reach counts.
- Nobody can give another person a wider permission than they hold themselves.
- The page is read once after sign-in and refreshed when admin mode changes.

Tips
- A long table? Use the search and filters, or switch the view to cards.
- Send the export to the system administrator when you ask for a permission, so they see exactly what you hold.

title: Employees
text:
The «Employees» page is the directory of employee records and their sign-in accounts. From here HR adds a new employee, edits their details, deactivates an account or ends the contract, and sees an employee's unit, job title and manager through time. A second tab, «My career team», shows the colleagues of your unit. What you see on the page follows your permissions and scope.

Who sees it
- View key: View employees («View employees») gives the list page; opening an employee's page is its own key, Open an employee (the row's eye, a click on the row and the page) and choose the details shown on it («Open an employee»). Scope: own, unit, unit and below, company or all.
- The «Employee» role (everyone gets it automatically) holds it at scope «own»: an employee sees only their own record.
- The head role of a unit (made automatically for every unit of the structure) holds it at «unit and below», together with the employee history (placement and changes).
- HR roles and the System Admin role are set on the roles page; the HR roles start with no permissions until an administrator sets them.
- The page does not need «platform admin mode». Every button shows only for someone who holds its key.
- The «My career team» tab shows for whoever holds «View my team (colleagues of my unit)» (View my team (colleagues of my unit)) or «View «my career team»» (View «my career team»), unless an administrator hid the page from the role.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Key (label on the permissions page)
Add employee | Opens the two-step form; a sign-in account is created and an activation invitation is sent | Add employees
View (eye icon or click the row) | Opens the employee page, or a pop-up (like «My team», with the «Chat on Teams» button) for whoever sees fewer than 10 details and holds no other permission on the employee besides viewing. The eye and the click show only on the rows the key's scope reaches (with «own» you open your own page only) | Open an employee (the row's eye, a click on the row and the page) and choose the details shown on it (Open an employee)
Choose what the employee page shows | On the roles page (and groups and exceptions) a «Details shown (N)» button sits beside «Open an employee» to choose the details the holder sees; the default is all of them, and what is not chosen is neither drawn on the page nor sent by the server. The name, number and company always show, while «Roles» shows only when chosen, and the ID, IBAN and salary also need View sensitive data (ID, IBAN, salary). Whoever may edit the record sees it whole | Open an employee (the row's eye, a click on the row and the page) and choose the details shown on it, set by whoever holds Edit a role and its permissions
Edit (pencil) | Opens the form to change the fields you are allowed | Edit employees
«Request to change basic data» (a card on the employee page, shown when the employee asks to change the name, gender, nationality, birth date or marital status) | Shows today's and the requested value of each field. «Approve» writes the values to the record and notifies the employee; «Reject» (optional reason) leaves the record as it is and notifies them | Edit employees with a scope that reaches the employee and all five fields asked for
Deactivate / Activate (power icon) | Stops the employee signing in and ends their sessions at once, or gives sign-in back | Deactivate and activate employees
Sign in as the employee (icon) | An administrator works as the employee to see what they see | Sign in as another employee
Select several, then «Bulk edit» | Changes unit, job title, manager, work location, work mode or relation type for many | Edit many employees at once, plus Change an employee's unit, job title or manager from a date when changing unit, title or manager
Export | Downloads the list (you choose scope, columns and file type) | Export employees
Import | Adds employees from an Excel or CSV file with a template | Import employees from a file
Update from file | Updates existing employees by employee number | Edit employees
Roles / Groups (on the employee page) | Sets the employee's roles or groups of roles | Assign employee roles, Give an employee groups of roles
End contract | Records the end date and reason | End an employee's contract
Resend invitation | Sends a new activation link by e-mail | Resend the activation link
Reset authenticator app | Ends the employee's sessions and sends a link to link the app again | Reset the authenticator app
Change photo | Adds, changes or removes the employee's photo; the button shows only on the page of someone the key's scope reaches (with «own», on your own page only) | Change an employee's photo
«History» tab | Shows unit, job title and manager through time and the log of changes; it shows only for someone the key's scope reaches (with «own», your own history only) | View an employee's history (placement and changes) (View an employee's history)
Cancel a waiting change (in History) | Cancels a change that waits for its day | Change an employee's unit, job title or manager from a date
See ID, IBAN and salary | The values show instead of being hidden | View sensitive data (ID, IBAN, salary) (View sensitive data)
Above the list there is a search by name, number or e-mail, and filters: company, status, relation type, unit (after choosing a company), job title (after choosing a unit), contract type, nationality, gender, work mode, marital status, residency status, contract starts from / until, «ID expiring soon», «Contract ending soon», «Needs a unit». You can switch between the table and cards. Row actions are icons at the end of each row.

How to

Add a new employee
1. Press «Add employee» at the top of the page.
2. In the first step «Employee details» fill the sections: Work, Contact, Personal, Contract, Salary and cost, Notes. Required fields carry a star, and an error appears under the field as you type.
3. Choose the company, then the unit, then the job title (a new employee needs a unit and a job title). The unit's manager is proposed as direct manager; you can change or clear it.
4. Press «Next: roles». The «Employee» role and the role of the chosen job title are ticked from the start; untick them or add other roles (each role may have an optional last day). This step shows for people who may assign roles.
5. At the bottom of the last step, tick or untick «Send the activation invitation by e-mail after saving» (ticked at first), then press «Save». The sign-in account is always created. If the box is ticked the employee receives an e-mail with the activation link; they link the authenticator app with a QR code and get backup codes. The link works for 72 hours and only once. If it is unticked nothing is sent; use «Resend invitation» later.
If the e-mail could not be sent, the employee is still saved and a message asks you to use «Resend invitation».

Edit an employee or change their unit
1. Open the employee's row and press «Edit».
2. Fields you may not change are locked, with a note.
3. When you change the unit, job title or manager the form asks for «Effective from» (today or a later day) and «Reason for the change». A later change waits for its day and then takes effect by itself; it shows in the «History» tab.
4. Press «Save».

Bulk edit
1. Select employees with the boxes at the start of each row (or the page box; limit 500).
2. A bar «N employees selected» appears; press «Bulk edit».
3. Choose the company (so its units are offered), then the values to change. What you leave empty stays as it is. To change unit, title or manager give «Effective from» and «Reason for the change». You can also tick «Remove the direct manager».
4. Press «Preview»: you see «N would change» and «N would be refused» with the reason for each person. Nothing is saved in the preview.
5. Press «Apply to N employees». One person's refusal does not stop the others.

Deactivate an account or end a contract
1. To deactivate: press the deactivate icon on the row, or «Deactivate» on the employee page, and confirm. The employee can no longer sign in and their sessions end at once. You can activate it again later.
2. To end the contract: open the employee page and press «End contract», choose the end date and the reason (write it if the reason is «Other»), then «Confirm end of contract».

Fields (form inputs)
A star (*) on screen marks a required field. The form is in two steps: «Employee details» (the sections below) then «Roles». Fields you may not change are locked with a note. The people you can pick in drop-downs, and the units and titles offered, follow your scope.

Add / edit employee: Work
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
