Company | The company the person works for. It decides which units and job titles are offered next, and «Company on the contract» is filled with it | Yes | One of the companies in your scope. Changing it clears the unit and title
Relation type | How the person relates to the company (employee, collaborator...). Some relation types are marked «limited» in the system lists: they need an end date and the person gets the collaborator base role instead of the «Employee» role | No | A value from the list
Unit | Where the person sits in the organization structure. It decides their scope (what they see as «unit» or «unit and below»), who their manager is, the head role if they lead it, and their place in the org chart | Yes | A unit of the chosen company that accepts employees. Enabled after you choose the company
Job title | The person's post in that unit. It gives them the role made for the title, places them in the reporting line of titles (which proposes their manager) and shows in the career pages | Yes | A title of the chosen unit. Enabled after you choose the unit
Leader of this unit | Makes the person the leader of the unit they are placed in, from today (or their start date if later); they then get the unit's head role | No | A tick; shows only for who holds Assign unit leaders and acting leaders. Refused with nothing saved if the leader rules do not allow it
Direct manager | Who the employee reports to; what needs the manager's decision goes to them, and the employee shows as their report. A new employee gets the unit's manager as a proposal; you may change or clear it | No | Any employee (search by name or number); not the person themselves
Effective from | (Edit only, shows once you change the unit, title or manager) the day the change starts | Yes, then | Today or a later day. A later day waits and is applied by the nightly job
Reason for the change | (Same condition) why; shown in the employee's history | No | Up to 500 characters
Work location | Free text such as the office or city | No | Up to 255 characters
Work country | The country of work; it proposes the salary currency | No | A value from the list
Work mode | How the person works | No | On-site, Hybrid, Remote

Contact
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Work email | The sign-in identity and the Microsoft account. The activation invitation is sent to it | Yes | A valid e-mail up to 255 characters, on an allowed domain (default arweqah.sa; Settings → Security), not used by another employee. Locked when editing
Personal email | A private address for contact | No | A valid e-mail, different from the work email. A plain employee may edit it on their own record
Work phone | Work mobile | No | International format, e.g. +966501234567. A plain employee may edit it on their own record
Personal phone | Private mobile | No | Same format. A plain employee may edit it on their own record

Personal
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Employee number | The number HR uses to name the person (also the key of «Update from file» and of the manager column in imports) | Yes | Up to 50 characters, unique
Full name | The name shown everywhere, in Arabic | Yes | Up to 255 characters
Name in English | Filled automatically from the Arabic name as you type; correct it if needed. A plain employee may edit it on their own record | No | English letters, spaces, hyphen or apostrophe, no doubled separators
Gender |  | No | Male, Female
Date of birth | Used to check age | No | In the past; age from 18 to 70; the person must be 18 at the start date
Nationality | Also decides the ID number rule for some ID types | No | A value from the list
Marital status |  | No | A value from the list
Residency status |  | No | A value from the list
ID type | The kind of identity document | No (see rules) | Shown when adding an employee to whoever holds Add employees, and when editing only to who holds View sensitive data (ID, IBAN, salary). Required once an ID number is typed
ID number | The document number, stored encrypted | No (see rules) | Shown when adding an employee (in the form and in the import template) to whoever holds Add employees; when editing or reading, only to who holds View sensitive data (ID, IBAN, salary). Checked by the ID type (and nationality for some types); required with the ID type; one number per ID type across the system
ID expiry date | Feeds the «ID expiring soon» badge and filter (30 days) | No | After the birth date

Contract
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Start date | The first day of the relationship; the history of unit, title and manager starts from it | Yes | A date (not before the person turned 18)
End date | The last day of a fixed contract; sign-in stops the day after | Only if the contract type or relation type needs one | After the start date. Moving or removing a passed end date can give sign-in back
Contract type | The kind of contract | No | A value from the list; some types require an end date
Describe the contract type | Free description | Yes, when the type is «Other» | Up to 255 characters
Company on the contract | The legal employer | No | A company; proposed from the company chosen above
Profession | The profession on the contract | No | Up to 255 characters
Registered in GOSI | Whether the person is registered with GOSI | No | A tick. Opens the three fields below
Company registered in GOSI | The company the registration is under | No | A company
GOSI registration date |  | Yes, when registered | Not before the start date
GOSI system |  | Yes, when registered | A value from the list
Qiwa contract | Whether the contract is on Qiwa | No | A tick
Medical insurance | Whether the person has medical insurance | No | A tick. Opens the next field
Company registered for health insurance |  | No | A company
Termination reason | Why the relationship ends | No (shows once an end date is set) | A value from the list. Needs the end date
State the reason |  | Yes, when the reason is «Other» | Up to 255 characters

Salary and cost (shown when adding to whoever holds Add employees, and when editing only to who holds View sensitive data (ID, IBAN, salary))
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Monthly gross salary | The monthly total before deductions, stored encrypted and never written to the audit log | No | A number from 0 to 9,999,999,999.99
Currency | The currency of the salary; the work country's currency is proposed | Yes, when a salary is typed | A value from the list
IBAN | The bank account for payment, stored encrypted | No | Saudi IBAN: SA followed by 22 digits, checked by its check digits

Notes
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Notes | A free note on the record | No | Up to 2000 characters

Second step: Roles
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Default roles | The «Employee» role (badge «Everyone») and the role of the chosen job title are ticked from the start. Without «Employee» the person will not see their own pages (my account, security, notifications, tickets) | No | You may untick either
Other roles | Head roles of the company, manual roles and what the person already holds | No | Only roles you are allowed to give (never wider than your own permissions); up to 20 roles
Ends on (per role) | A last day for a role given for a limited time | No | Today or later
Roles can also be changed later from the employee page with «Roles» and «Groups».

End contract (dialog)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
End date | The last day of service | Yes | After the start date
Termination reason | Why | Yes | A value from the list
State the reason |  | Yes, when the reason is «Other» | Up to 255 characters

Bulk edit (dialog)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Company | Only decides which units are offered; a selected person from another company is refused with the reason | No | A company
Unit, Job title | The new placement; choose the title together with the unit | No (one value at least) | Titles must fit the unit
Direct manager / Remove the direct manager | Sets the same manager for all, or clears it | No | An employee, or the tick
Work location, Work mode, Relation type | Plain fields changed at once | No | As in the form
Effective from, Reason for the change | When and why a unit, title or manager change starts | Yes, with a unit, title or manager change | A day; the reason up to 500 characters

Import from a file
The template has one column for each field above, with the system's lists as drop-downs, plus «Direct manager employee number». After the file is checked, the preview has one box «Send the activation invitation e-mail to everyone imported» (ticked at first): it applies to all the imported employees at once; unticked, no e-mail is sent. Required columns: Company, Unit, Job title, Work email, Employee number, Full name, Start date. The ID number, salary and IBAN columns are in the add template for everyone who holds Add employees, and in the «Update from a file» template only for who holds View sensitive data (ID, IBAN, salary). The three yes / no columns take Yes or No. Every date column (birth date, ID expiry, start and end date, GOSI registration date) takes year-month-day, for example 1990-04-15: the template shows this format when you select a cell of such a column, and 2024-1-5 or 2024/01/05 are also read; a day written 5/1/2024 is refused because its day / month order is unclear. Phones (work and personal) take the international format +966501234567; Excel drops the + of a number typed in a cell, so 966501234567 is accepted and read as +966501234567, but a local number such as 0501234567 is refused because it has no country code; so is a numeric cell that lost its leading zero (501234567): type the number as text or with the country code. A day that does not exist in the calendar (such as 2023-02-29) is refused. «Update from file» uses the same columns without Company and Work email; only «Employee number» is required, and an empty cell leaves the record as it is.

Photo (dialog)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Photo | The employee's picture, cropped square (zoom and position) before upload | No | JPEG or PNG, up to 2 MB

Workflow

What happens when HR adds an employee
1. HR (Add employees) presses «Add employee» and fills the details. The company, unit and title must be inside HR's scope, and the work e-mail, employee number and ID document must be new.
2. HR goes to «Roles» and ticks «Send the activation invitation by e-mail after saving» and presses «Save».
3. The system creates the sign-in account and the record, writes the first periods of unit, title and manager (from the start date), gives the chosen roles, refreshes the automatic roles (Employee, job-title role, head role, direct-manager role) and lets the manager follow the reporting line of titles. The action is written to the audit log.
4. The employee receives an e-mail with the activation link (valid 72 hours, once). They open it, link the authenticator app with the QR code and keep the backup codes. After that they sign in with Microsoft or with the work e-mail plus the code.
5. If the e-mail could not be sent the employee is still saved; HR uses «Resend invitation» (one per minute per address).
6. Others see: the employee appears in the list of everyone whose scope reaches the unit. Their direct manager and head of the unit see them as a report.

What happens afterwards
1. Change of unit, title or manager: HR edits the employee with «Effective from» and a reason. Today's change is applied now; a later one waits as «pending» in the History tab (it can be cancelled with Change an employee's unit, job title or manager from a date) and a nightly job applies it on its day. The previous value is closed the day before.
2. Lost phone: HR presses «Reset authenticator app»; the employee's sessions end and a new invitation is sent.
3. Deactivate: HR (Deactivate and activate employees) deactivates the account; sessions end at once. Activate gives sign-in back. Nobody can deactivate or end the contract of their own account.
4. End of contract: HR (End an employee's contract) records the end date and the reason. A message is queued so the employee's open tasks go to their direct manager. Sign-in continues through the end date and stops the day after (at once if the end date is already past).
5. Coming back: if HR moves the end date to today or later, or removes it, the account is switched on again (for who holds Deactivate and activate employees).

Statuses
Status | Meaning | Who can change it (permission key) | Moves to
Active | The account can sign in | Deactivate and activate employees | Deactivated
Deactivated | Sign-in is stopped and sessions ended | Deactivate and activate employees | Active
Contract ended (shown as «Sign-in closed because the contract ended») | Sign-in stopped by the nightly job after the end date | End an employee's contract (sets the end date); Edit employees / Deactivate and activate employees (moving the end date back) | Active, if the end date is moved to today or later
Needs a unit | A flag, not an account state: the person has no unit or no job title, so their role and reach cannot be right | Edit employees | Cleared once the unit and the job title are chosen
The badges «Authenticator app linked / App not linked yet», «ID expiring soon» and «Contract ending soon» are reminders, not statuses.

Automatic things
- Every night, Riyadh time: 00:05 accounts whose contract ended yesterday or before are deactivated and audited; 00:10 placement changes whose day came are applied, and every employee's direct manager is recomputed from the reporting line of job titles (a manager HR chose by hand stays); 03:00 automatic roles are refreshed (also after every change to employees or to the structure).
- E-mails: the activation invitation (on adding, on «Resend invitation» and on «Reset authenticator app»).
- Audit: creation, edits (field names only, never values), roles, groups, invitations, activation, deactivation and end of contract are recorded.

What each person sees
- A plain employee sees and edits only their own record (four fields).
- A direct manager or head of a unit sees the employees of the unit and below, when their role holds the key at that scope.
- HR sees by company or everything, as set on the roles page. A record outside the scope shows as if it does not exist.

Business rules
- Requests to change basic data: nobody decides their own request, a person whose permission does not cover every field asked for sees no decision buttons, and a second decision on a request already decided is refused. The notice goes only to those whose permission reaches the employee and its fields.
- Scope: a record outside your scope shows as if it does not exist (no «forbidden» message). (FR-06, FR-20)
- The work e-mail is the sign-in identity and Microsoft account and cannot change after adding. Only allowed domains are accepted (default arweqah.sa; the list is set in Settings → Security). (FR-77)
- Employee states: Active, Deactivated, «Needs a unit» (no unit or no job title). Badges: «Authenticator app linked / App not linked yet», «ID expiring soon», «Contract ending soon». (FR-72)
- Field checks: age from 18 to 70, phone in international format such as +966501234567, a Saudi IBAN (SA and 22 digits), the ID number checked by ID type and nationality, and an end date after the start date. (FR-17, FR-18)
- Sensitive data: ID number, IBAN and salary are encrypted and hidden for anyone without «View sensitive data», and never written to the audit log. (FR-21)
- Who edits what: the list of fields a holder of «Edit employees» may change belongs to each grant (a role, a group or a person) and is set with the «Fields they may change» button on the roles and permissions pages. A plain employee edits only work phone, personal phone, personal e-mail and the English name of their own record; any other field is refused. (FR-83, FR-94)
- The direct manager is optional. The «Leader of this unit» tick in the work section shows for those who may assign leaders. (FR-100)
- Deactivating ends sessions at once. Ending a contract: sign-in stays through the end date and stops the next day (a daily job just after midnight, Riyadh time), and the employee's open tasks go to their direct manager. (FR-55, FR-71)
- Reset authenticator app ends the employee's sessions and sends a new invitation. Resend invitation sends a new link (one per minute per address).
- History: every change of unit, job title or manager closes the previous value the day before it starts, and is kept with its reason and who made it. A change cannot start in the past. (FR-89, FR-90)
- Photo: JPEG or PNG up to 2 MB, cropped square with zoom and position before upload; when removed, the first letter of the name shows. (FR-91)
- «My team»: every employee sees only the colleagues of their own unit with basic details (name, photo, job title, e-mail, phone), not the units above or below, and including the platform administrator's account when it holds a place in the unit; a manager of a colleague sees more about them. Someone without a unit sees a message explaining it. In a colleague's window, «Chat on Teams» (key Chat with a colleague on Teams, «Chat with a colleague on Teams», held by the «Employee» role and the head role of every unit) opens a Microsoft Teams chat with their work e-mail in a new tab. (FR-92, FR-154)
- Bulk edit: at most 500 employees; each goes through the same dated-placement rules, and the platform is told once. (FR-93)
- Import: download the template (its drop-downs hold the system's lists), fill it, then the preview shows errors, only valid rows are imported, and an error report can be downloaded. A row the server refuses starts its reason with the column name as in the file. Every row passes the same checks as the form. (FR-29)
- Update from file: a row is identified by employee number; the cells you fill are what changes and an empty cell leaves the record as it is; no new employee is made in this mode. A change of unit, title or manager takes effect today with the reason «Imported from a file». (FR-95)
- Sign in as an employee: off by default, switched on in Settings → Security; it needs platform admin mode. The administrator works with the employee's permissions without a code; everything done is recorded under the employee's name with the administrator beside it, and the employee gets a notice afterwards. Roles, security and account status stay closed. It ends with «Back to my account» or after an idle time. (FR-85)

Tips / common problems
- You only see your own record? That is the «Employee» role. Ask an administrator to widen the scope.
- A job title is missing from the filter? Choose the company, then the unit first; the lists follow each other.
- Badge «Needs a unit»: open Edit and choose the unit and job title.
- On a phone the table turns into one card per row.

title: Organization structure
text:
The «Organization structure» page shows one tree for the whole group and all its companies: sectors, departments, sections, units and offices, with their leaders, job titles and headcount. What each company sees follows where its employees are placed. You can view it as a chart, a horizontal icicle, a table or cards, and choosing a unit opens its details beside the list.

Who sees it
- View key: View the organization structure («View the organization structure»). The «Employee» role holds it automatically at scope «all».
- Every employee sees only their own company's structure: the units that have employees of their company under them, the units above them up to the top, and the shared units that have employees. A note says how many units are hidden (the ones without employees). (FR-98, FR-108)
- «See the whole structure» (See the whole structure (even units with no employees)) shows every unit even if empty, and adds the «Employees only / Full view» switch and the «Show me a company's structure» list. By the product design it is for HR and the platform admin, and is given on the roles page.
- The buttons that change things (add, move, edit, delete and so on) show only in «platform admin mode» and only for someone who holds the key of each button.
- The head role of a unit does not list View the organization structure because the general «Employee» role already holds it.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Key (label on the permissions page)
Switch the view (chart / icicle / table / cards) | Changes how the structure is drawn; your choice is remembered | View the organization structure
Search and filters | Search by unit name, code or a job title in it; filters: type, management type, status, employees, leader | View the organization structure
Full view and «Show me a company's structure» | Shows every unit and compares it with what one company sees (faded with a dashed border = that company does not see it) | See the whole structure (even units with no employees) (See the whole structure)
Export | Downloads the units with the columns you choose | Export units of the structure
Structure divisions | Edits the unit types and the «who may be created under whom» table | Edit and copy the levels of the structure
Add unit / Add a unit under it | Creates a new unit with a suggested code | Add a unit to the structure
Edit (pencil) | Changes the name, start date, manager and «The unit is working», with an effective date and a reason | Edit a unit (name, manager, start date) (Edit a unit)
Set code | Sets once the code of a unit made before codes existed | Edit a unit (name, manager, start date)
Change management type | Turns the unit between shared and per company, with a reason | Change how a unit is managed (shared or per company) (Change how a unit is managed)
Move | Moves the unit under another parent | Move a unit
Delete | Deletes a unit with nothing under it | Delete a unit
«Leaders» tab: assign a leader or acting leader, end, delete | Manages the leaders of the unit | Assign unit leaders and acting leaders
«Leaders» tab: click a leader's name | Opens the same popup as «Unit employees» (work number, work e-mail, the unit they lead, direct manager, «Chat on Teams») | View the organization structure
«History» tab: versions of the unit and its change log | Shows the unit's dated versions and the change log. Without the key the tab is hidden and the API sends nothing of the history | View a unit's history (its versions and change log) (View a unit's history); given to HR / structure administrators and to the head role of every unit (its unit and below), not to the «Employee» role
«Charter» tab: write / edit | Writes the purpose, outputs, scope and limits | Edit the charter of a unit
«Titles» tab: add and edit a title | Manages the unit's job titles | Manage job titles and Add a job title / Edit a job title
«Unit employees» tab: open a person, then «Chat on Teams» | Shows the work number, work e-mail, unit and direct manager; «Chat on Teams» opens a Microsoft Teams chat with them in a new tab (the person must use the same Microsoft work account) | View the organization structure; the button needs Chat with a colleague on Teams (Chat with a colleague on Teams, held by the «Employee» role and the head role of every unit)
There is no import on this page on purpose: the structure is built from the screen, and job titles are imported from the «Job titles» page.

How to

Read the structure
1. Choose the view with the view switch. The chart starts with the group card open; the circle under a card opens what is below it, and the chart has «Open all», «Fit», zoom and drag.
2. Card colors follow the unit type and every card carries a text badge with the type name, so meaning never depends on color alone.
3. Click a unit and its details open with the tabs: Overview, Titles, Leaders, Charter, History.

Add a unit
1. Switch platform admin mode on, then press «Add unit» (or the «Add a unit under it» icon on the parent's row).
2. Choose the parent, then the type; the types offered are those the rules table allows.
3. Write the Arabic name (English is optional and is translated as you type) and the start date.
4. Under the top (a sector, department or office) write the unit code: three capital English letters such as OPS.
5. Choose the management type: «Inherited from the parent», «Shared» or «Per company» (a sector and anything directly under the group needs an explicit choice). The suggested code and a note on which companies will see the unit are shown.
6. Press «Save the unit».

Change the management type
1. Press the «Change management type» icon on the row.
2. Read the impact shown (the manager of employees of the subsidiary companies changes).
3. Write the reason and press «Confirm the change». The affected units and the number of employees whose manager was recalculated are shown.

Assign a leader or an acting leader
1. Open the unit, then the «Leaders» tab, and press «Assign a leader or acting leader».
2. Choose the kind (leader or acting leader), the company (for a per-company unit), the employee, their job title in the unit, the «Starts from» date and the reason.
3. An acting leader needs an end date too. Save.

Fields (form inputs)
A star (*) on screen marks a required field.

Add a unit
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Parent | Where the unit sits: «Arweqah Alreyadah (the top)» or another unit. It decides the unit's code, the types allowed and what the unit inherits | Yes | An active unit (or the top) under which the rules table allows a new unit
Type | The kind of unit (sector, department, section, unit, office, or a type the admin added). It decides the slot of the code, and whether the unit takes job titles and employees | Yes | Only the types the rules table allows under that parent
Unit code (three letters) | The letters every code under this unit starts with | Yes, only when the parent is the top | Three capital English letters, such as OPS
Arabic name | The name shown in Arabic | Yes | 2 to 120 characters
English name | The name shown in English; it follows the Arabic as you type | No (the Arabic name is used if left empty) | 2 to 120 characters
Start date | The day the unit started (or will start) working | Yes | From 1980-01-01 up to two years ahead
Management type | «Inherited from the parent», «Shared» or «Per company»: who manages the employees under the unit (see Business rules) | Yes | «Inherited» is not offered directly under the top, where a choice between the other two is needed
The dialog also shows the suggested code and which companies will see the unit; nothing there is typed.

Edit the unit
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Arabic name, English name | The unit's names | Yes | 2 to 120 characters each
Start date | The day the unit started working | Yes | From 1980 up to two years ahead
Unit manager | Offered as the direct manager of the unit's employees. A unit with a leader row follows its leader; the manager typed here counts only while the unit has no leader row | No | Any employee
The unit is working | Untick to stop the unit (a unit is stopped by a date, not deleted) | No | A tick
Effective from | When a change of names or of «The unit is working» starts | Yes (today by default) | Today or later. A later day makes a «scheduled» version applied by the nightly job
Reason for the change | Kept in the unit's history and the audit log | Yes, when a name, the switch or a later date is changed | 3 to 500 characters
The type, the parent and the code are not changed here (use Move and Set code).

Move the unit
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
New parent | The place to move the unit under; the code stays as it is | Yes | Only places the rules table allows for this type, never the unit itself or anything under it

Set the unit's code (units made before codes existed)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Unit code | Sets the code once; it never changes afterwards | Yes | The form OPS.03.03.01 (three capital letters, then three groups of two digits); not used by another unit. «Use the suggestion» fills it

Change how the unit is managed
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Management type | «Inherited from the parent», «Shared» or «Per company» | Yes | Inherit is not allowed for a sector or a unit directly under the top
Reason for the change | The reason is audited with the number of units and employees affected | Yes | 3 to 500 characters

Assign a leader or acting leader («Leaders» tab)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Kind | Leader, or Acting leader (covers a window while a leader exists) | Yes | Leader, Acting leader
Company | The company the leader leads for | Yes | For a shared unit only the group company; for a per-company unit the company of the person
Employee | The person who leads | Yes | An active employee of the chosen company (search by name or number)
Title in the unit | The job title the leader takes in this unit; they move to the unit with it from the start day | Yes for a leader (not asked for an acting leader) | An active job title of the unit
Starts on | The first day | Yes | Today or later
Ends on | The last day | Yes for an acting leader; empty = no end for a leader | Not before the start day
Reason | Shown in the unit's history | No | 3 to 500 characters when written
«End» (an in-force leader): Last day (today or later) and Reason (3 to 500 characters), both required.

Charter («Charter» tab)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Purpose | Why the unit exists, in Arabic and English | No | Up to 2000 characters per language
Outputs, In scope, Out of scope, Limits | What the unit delivers, what is inside and outside its work, and its limits; one item per line, in both languages | No | Up to 30 items of up to 400 characters per language
Effective from | When the charter takes effect | Yes | Today or later
Reason for the change | Kept in the history | Yes | 3 to 500 characters

Structure divisions
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Arabic name, English name (of a new division) | A new unit type for the whole group | Yes | Not a name already used
Takes titles and employees | Whether units of this type may hold job titles and employees | No | A tick (a sector never does)
The tick table «Who is created under whom» | A tick means the child type may be created under that parent type; it never moves existing units | No | A sector only under the top; no office under an office
Job titles of a unit are added from the «Titles» tab with the dialog described in the «Job titles» section.

Workflow

The life of a unit
1. The platform admin (admin mode on, Add a unit to the structure) presses «Add unit», chooses the parent, type, names, start date and management type, and saves.
2. The system gives the unit its code from the type slot, writes it to the audit log, and refreshes the automatic roles: the unit gets its own head role («leader of the unit»).
3. HR / the admin adds job titles in the «Titles» tab (Add a job title); each title gets its code and its own role.
4. A leader is assigned from the «Leaders» tab (Assign unit leaders and acting leaders) from today or a later day. From the start day the leader holds the unit's head role, is placed in the unit with the chosen title, and becomes the manager of the unit's employees of that company (in a shared unit, the group-company leader manages the employees of all companies) (a leader's own manager is the nearest leader above).
5. Employees are placed in the unit from the employee form. A per-company unit shows in a company's structure when its first employee is placed there; a shared unit shows to every company when the first employee of any company is placed in it.
6. The unit changes: edit (names and the «working» switch are dated), move (immediate, audited, code unchanged), change management type (with a reason; managers of other companies' employees are recomputed), charter edits (dated). A unit is stopped by a date; it is deleted only when it has no sub-units and no employees.
7. Who is told: nobody is e-mailed or notified from this page. Every change goes to the unit's History tab and the audit log with who, when and why.

Statuses
Status | Meaning | Who can change it (permission key) | Moves to
In force | The unit works | Edit a unit (name, manager, start date) | Stopped
Stopped | The unit was switched off (immediately or on a date) | Edit a unit (name, manager, start date) | In force
Scheduled change | A dated change of name, switch or charter waits for its day | Edit a unit (name, manager, start date) / Edit the charter of a unit | Applied by the nightly job
Empty | No employees in the unit | placing employees (Edit employees) | In force with employees
No leader | Employees of a company are in the unit and nobody leads it for them | Assign unit leaders and acting leaders | A leader assigned
A leader row has its own status: Scheduled (starts later; may be removed), In force (may be ended with a last day) and Ended.

Automatic things
- Every night, Riyadh time: 00:15 dated unit changes whose day came are applied and the leaders that started or ended are refreshed (the head role and the unit's manager follow); 00:10 employees' managers are recomputed from the leaders and the reporting line of titles; 03:00 automatic roles are refreshed (also right after any change to the structure).
- No e-mails are sent from this page. Everything is audited.

What each person sees
- Every employee sees their own company's structure: units with employees of their company under them, the units above up to the top, and shared units that have employees, with a note of how many units are hidden.
- Holders of «See the whole structure» (See the whole structure (even units with no employees)) see every unit, even empty ones.
- The buttons show only in admin mode and only for who holds each key. A leader sees the unit and below through the head role.

Business rules
- Unit types: five built-in types that cannot be removed (sector, department, section, unit, office); the platform admin can add more from «Structure divisions» (Arabic and English names, and the «Accepts titles and employees» tick). An added type shows in every company and can be removed only while no unit uses it. A sector never takes titles or employees. (FR-96)
- Who may be created under whom: a table of tick boxes (parent in the row, child in the column) edited from «Structure divisions». Changing the table only stops new creation; it never moves existing units. Two rules are fixed: a sector is created only under the group, and no office under an office. (FR-96)
- The unit code is built by unit type in four slots (sector.department.section.unit) such as OPS.03.03.01; a zero in a slot means there is no level of that type here. An office takes number 09 in the slot where it sits, and an added type takes the unit slot. The code does not change when the unit is moved. If no slot is free the message «No code slot is free for this type under this parent» appears. A unit made before codes gets its code once. (FR-96)
- Management type: «Shared» is managed once from Arweqah and the leader of the unit manages any employee under it; «Per company» means each company has its own leader and employees. It can be marked on any level and what is below inherits it unless a unit under it is marked differently. Changing it needs a reason and is audited. (FR-97)
- When a unit shows: a shared unit shows to all companies once the first employee of any company is placed in it; a per-company unit does not show in a company's structure until its first employee is placed. Someone with «See the whole structure» always sees it. (FR-98)
- Leaders: a shared unit has one leader from the group company; a per-company unit has a leader for each company from its own active employees. An acting leader holds the leader role only for their term, needs an end date and a leader in force for the whole term, cannot be the leader, and cannot overlap another acting leader. A leader starts today or later, and only a leader who has not started can be deleted (one in force is ended). When a leader is given a job title in the unit, they move to the unit with that title from the start day. The «unit leader» role is one role, not tied to a company. (FR-100)
- A unit with employees and no leader in their company shows the status «No leader», with a yellow notice for holders of the full view and a «Show them» button. The manager then goes up to the nearest leader above in the same company; if there is none the manager stays empty. (FR-100)
- Charter and history: the charter (purpose, outputs, in scope, out of scope, limits) is edited with an effective date and a reason. An edit today does not change yesterday's record; a change that starts later is kept as a «scheduled» version, applied by itself on its day, and the unit shows «Scheduled change». A change cannot start in the past or on a date that does not follow the last version. A unit is stopped by a date instead of being deleted. (FR-99)
- Move: immediate and audited, and the code stays the same; only places the rules allow are offered, and a sector cannot be moved. A department with an active ticket desk or open tickets cannot be moved or deleted.
- Delete: a unit with sub-units or employees cannot be deleted; move or remove them first. Its job titles are deleted with it.
- The start date is required for every unit, from 1980 up to two years ahead. (FR-35)
- Every change to the structure is recorded in the history with the date, who made it and the reason.

Tips / common problems
- You do not see the edit buttons? Switch «platform admin mode» on from the top bar and check your role holds the key.
- A unit does not show for you? It may still have no employees of your company; holders of «See the whole structure» see it.
- A missing code on an old unit: use the «Set code» icon; it will not change afterwards.

title: Job titles
text:
The «Job titles» page gathers every job title of the group in one list with its code, grade, track and headcount. Click a title to open its «card»: the code broken into its parts, the development stage, the duties, qualifications and indicators, the holders in each company, and the «Who is the direct manager?» chain.

Who sees it
- View key: View the job titles page and their cards («View the job titles page and their cards»). Scope: all.
- The page is not part of the default «Employee» role or of the unit head role; it is given to a role from the roles or permissions page (for example HR and the System Admin).
- You see the titles of the units whose structure you see (the same rule as the structure page); holders of «See the whole structure» see all. The headcount is counted for your company, and for every company in the full view.
- The add, edit and delete buttons show in «platform admin mode» and for whoever holds each button's key. Export and import have their own keys.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Key (label on the permissions page)
Open the card (click the row or name) | Shows the title card | View the job titles page and their cards
Search and filters | Search by name or code; filters: sector, department, section, grade, track, vacancy | View the job titles page and their cards
Table / cards switch | Changes how the list is drawn | View the job titles page and their cards
Add title | Chooses the unit, then the name, grade, track and the title it reports to | Add a job title
Edit | Changes the name and the reporting title, and sets grade and track once | Edit a job title
Edit the content | Writes duties, qualifications and indicators | Edit the content of a job title (duties, qualifications, indicators) (Edit the content of a job title)
Delete | Deletes a title nobody holds | Delete a job title
Export | Downloads the titles of the current search and filters | Export job titles
Import | Adds or updates titles from a file | Import job titles from a file

How to

Add a title
1. Switch platform admin mode on and press «Add title».
2. Choose the unit (only units that accept titles are listed), then «Next».
3. Write the Arabic and English names, choose the grade (L1 to L9), the track (Management, Professional, Projects, Consulting, Support) and, optionally, the title it reports to. You may add more than one title to the unit in the same dialog, and choose which role the permissions are copied from (default: the «Employee» role).
4. Save. The title code is built and a role named after the title is made.

Read a title card
1. Click the title's row.
2. «Meaning of the code» breaks the code into sector, department, section and unit, then the grade and track, then the sequence.
3. «Who is the direct manager?»: choose the employee's company (among the companies that have holders of the title) and the chain from the title upward appears.

Import titles
1. Press «Import» and download the template: title code (empty for a new title), unit code, the two names, grade, track, reporting-title code, and the duties, qualifications and indicators in Arabic and English (one item per line).
2. Fill the file and upload it, then read the preview: «New titles / Updated / Unchanged» and the rejected rows with their reasons.
3. Confirm the import (limit 1000 rows).

Fields (form inputs)
A star (*) on screen marks a required field.

Add a title
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Unit | The unit the title belongs to; its code starts the title's code and its employees hold the title in it | Yes (first step, then «Next») | Only units whose type accepts titles (never a sector)
Arabic name | The title as shown in Arabic; the role made for the title is named after it | Yes | 2 to 120 characters
English name | The title in English; follows the Arabic as you type | Yes | 2 to 120 characters
Grade | The level of the title, L1 to L9; it is part of the code and gives the development stage | Yes | L1 to L9. Set once, then locked
Track | The career track, also part of the code | Yes | Management, Professional, Projects, Consulting, Support. Set once, then locked
Reports to | The higher title this one reports to; it is how an employee's direct manager is found | No | Search by name or code. Never itself, and never a loop
Copy permissions from a role | The title's role starts with this role's permissions (edited later on the roles page); shown to who may choose it | No | A role you could hand out; default: the «Employee» role
You may add several titles in one dialog with «Add a title» (up to 50); the last row cannot be removed.

Edit the title
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Arabic name, English name | The title's names | Yes | 2 to 120 characters each
Grade, Track | Shown only for an older title that has no code yet: choose both once to build the code | Both or none | L1 to L9 and a track; locked once chosen
Reports to | Changes the reporting line | No | A title other than itself; no loops; «No reporting line» clears it
Active title | Untick to stop using the title | No | A tick. The last active title of a unit that accepts employees cannot be stopped

Edit the content (title card)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Responsibilities, Qualifications, Performance indicators | The duties, the required qualifications and the indicators the person is measured by, in Arabic and in English; one item per line | No | Up to 30 items of up to 400 characters per language. Every save raises the content version

Import titles
Column | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Title code | The title to update; empty for a new one (built from unit, grade and track) | No | Like OPS.03.03.01-L7P-01
Unit code | The unit a new title belongs to | Yes for a new title with no code | A unit code that exists and accepts titles; must match the title code if both are given
Arabic name, English name | The names | Yes | 2 to 120 characters
Grade, Track | Grade (L1 to L9 or 1 to 9) and track (name in either language, or its letter) | Yes for a new title | Frozen once the code exists
Reports-to code | The code of the higher title (in the file or already in the system) | No | No loop, not itself
Responsibilities, Qualifications, Performance indicators (Arabic and English) | The content, one item per line | No | A file with these cells empty never overwrites existing content
The import takes up to 1000 rows.

Workflow

The life of a job title
1. HR / the admin (admin mode on, Add a job title) presses «Add title», chooses the unit and fills the names, grade, track and, optionally, «Reports to» and the role to copy permissions from.
2. The system builds the code (unit code-L<grade><track>-<sequence>), creates the title's own role named after the title with the copied permissions (in the same save), and audits it. A title added to a unit with no code waits for the unit's code.
3. Content: someone with Edit the content of a job title (duties, qualifications, indicators) writes the duties, qualifications and indicators (or they come with the import); every save raises the version, and the career profile reopens its acknowledgement at the new version.
4. Holders: when HR gives an employee this title (the employee form, a bulk edit, an import), the employee gets the title's role automatically, and the title's «Reports to» line decides their direct manager (the nearest higher title that has a holder in the same company).
5. Changes: rename, change the reporting line, or stop the title (Edit a job title); grade and track never change after the code exists. Deleting is possible only when nobody holds the title and it is not the last active one of its unit; its role is deleted with it.
6. Nobody is e-mailed from this page; changes are audited.

Statuses
Status | Meaning | Who can change it (permission key) | Moves to
No code | An older title without grade and track | Edit a job title (give grade and track) | Coded
Coded / Active | The title is in use | Edit a job title | Stopped
Stopped | Not offered for new employees («Active title» unticked) | Edit a job title | Active
Vacant | Nobody holds it (the «Vacancy» filter) | placing an employee in it | Held

Automatic things
- The code and the role are made in the same save; the role is removed with the title.
- Every night, Riyadh time, (00:10) employees' direct managers are recomputed from the reporting line of titles (a manager HR chose by hand stays); the roles of titles are refreshed with the other automatic roles at 03:00.
- A change of «Reports to» moves the automatically calculated managers of the holders (not a manager HR chose by hand) at the next recomputation.

What each person sees
- The page is for roles that hold View the job titles page and their cards (HR, administrators and heads of units; not the plain «Employee» role).
- You see the titles of the units whose structure you see; the headcount is for your company, and for every company in the full view.

Business rules
- The title code looks like OPS.03.03.01-L7P-01: the unit code, then the grade (1 to 9) and a track letter (M management, P professional, J projects, C advisory, S support), then a sequence inside the unit. It is built when the title is added, and is never changed or reused. (FR-104)
- Grade and track are set once and then locked because the code is built from them. A new title needs a grade and a track. Older titles without a code keep working; their code is built when grade and track are set. A title added to a unit with no code waits for the unit's code. (FR-104)
- No title on a sector. A title never reports to itself or to a title that reports to it. (FR-104)
- Development stage is derived from grade and track: Foundation, Specialization, Mastery, Operational leadership, Institutional leadership, with the yearly hours and the budget limit; where there is no rule the card says «HR decides it» and nothing is guessed. (FR-107)
- The direct manager is the nearest title above that has a holder; vacant titles are skipped, and the search never goes beyond the employee's company. If there is none, the employee enters the report of units without a leader and HR assigns the manager by hand with a date and a reason. (FR-107)
- Content: saved in Arabic and English, one item per line (up to 30 items, 400 characters each); every save raises the content's version number and is audited. (FR-106)
- Delete: a title that has employees cannot be deleted; move them first. Its role is deleted with it.
- Import: a row is matched by code (update, or create with exactly that code) or the code is built from unit, grade and track; reporting lines are linked. A row is refused with a clear reason (unit not found, unit does not accept titles, duplicate code, sequence taken, unknown reporting title or one that makes a loop...). Nothing is written before you confirm. (FR-107)
- «Vacant» means a title with no holders; the «Vacancy» filter separates the two cases.

Tips / common problems
- No «Add title» button? Switch platform admin mode on and check the add key.
- A unit is not in the add list? Its type does not accept titles (such as a sector); add the title in a unit below it.
- The import says «The unit has no code yet»: set the unit's code on the structure page first.

title: Companies
text:
The «Companies» page shows the companies of the group with each company's code, Arabic and English names, headcount and status. From here the platform admin adds a company, edits it, deletes it if it has no employees and no units, and imports or exports companies.

Who sees it
- View key: View the companies page («View the companies page»).
- The page needs «platform admin mode»; it does not show in the side menu outside it. It is not part of the default Employee or unit head roles, and is given from the roles page (to the System Admin and whoever they choose).
- Every button has its own key and shows only for whoever holds it.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Key (label on the permissions page)
Search and filters | Search by code or name; status filter (active / inactive) and «Has employees / No employees» | View the companies page
Table / cards switch | Changes how the list is drawn | View the companies page
Add company | Opens the add form | Add a company
Edit (pencil or click the row) | Edits the code, the two names and the status | Edit a company
Delete (bin) | Deletes the company after a confirmation | Delete a company
Export | Downloads the companies (scope, columns, file type) | Export companies
Import | Adds companies from an Excel or CSV file | Import companies from a file

How to

Add a company
1. Switch platform admin mode on and open «Companies».
2. Press «Add company».
3. Write the code (English letters, digits and hyphen, 2 to 20), the Arabic and English names, and keep «Active company» ticked if you want it active.
4. Save. A new company starts with the default levels (sector, department, section, unit).

Delete a company
1. Press the delete icon on the company's row.
2. Confirm in the window. If the company has employees or units the system refuses; move or remove them first.

Import companies
1. Press «Import», then «Download template».
2. Fill the columns: Code, Arabic name, English name (required) and Status (yes / no, default yes).
3. Upload the file and read the preview (valid rows and rows with errors), then press «Import N rows». Only valid rows are imported, and you can download the error report.

Fields (form inputs)
A star (*) on screen marks a required field.

Add / edit a company
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Arabic name | The company's name in Arabic, shown in lists and drop-downs | Yes | 2 to 120 characters
English name | The name in English; follows the Arabic as you type | Yes | 2 to 120 characters
Code | A short unique code for the company, used in lists, imports and exports | Yes | English letters, digits and hyphen, 2 to 20; written in capitals; not used by another company
Active company | Whether the company is active | No (ticked by default) | A tick

Import companies
Column | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Code | The company code | Yes | As above; unique, also inside the file
Arabic name |  | Yes | 2 to 120 characters
English name |  | Yes | 2 to 120 characters
Status | Whether the company is active | No (default yes) | Yes / No drop-down

Workflow

The life of a company
1. The platform admin (admin mode on, Add a company) presses «Add company» (or imports a file) and fills the code, the names and «Active company».
2. The system checks that the code is new, saves the company, audits it and refreshes the structure-related automatic roles. A company needs nothing else: the structure is one for the whole group, and a company sees it according to where its employees are placed.
3. HR then adds employees to the company (the Company field of the employee form). The employees column counts them.
4. Edits (Edit a company) change the code, the names and the status; each is audited.
5. Deletion (Delete a company) is allowed only when the company has no employees and no units; the company is then removed from lists (a soft delete) and audited.
6. Nobody is e-mailed from this page.

Statuses
Status | Meaning | Who can change it (permission key) | Moves to
Active | The company is in use | Edit a company | Inactive
Inactive | Marked as not active (the «Active company» tick removed) | Edit a company | Active
Deleted | Removed from lists; only possible with no employees and no units | Delete a company | none from the screen

Automatic things
- Nothing runs on a schedule for companies. Create, edit and delete are written to the audit log, and a new company refreshes the automatic roles.

What each person sees
- The page is for the platform admin and whoever the admin gives View the companies page, in admin mode only. The same companies fill the Company drop-downs of the employee form for whoever may add employees in their scope.

Business rules
- A company code is unique; using an existing one is refused with «Company code is already used». (FR-19)
- A company with employees or units cannot be deleted: «Move or remove the company's employees and units first». (FR-19)
- Import: every row passes the same checks as the form, duplicates inside the file are flagged, and a row with an error is never imported. (FR-29)
- Export: you choose the rows (those shown on the page or all results of the search and filters), the columns (code, both names, employees, status) and the file type (Excel or CSV).
- The organization structure is one for the group; what each company sees of it follows where its employees are placed (see the Organization structure section).
- Editing and deleting are recorded in the audit log.

Tips / common problems
- You do not see «Companies» in the menu? Switch platform admin mode on.
- The employees column is zero but the company cannot be deleted? It may still have units.

title: My career path
text:
«Career path» is your own page. It shows the path of your job title in five sections, always in the same order: job description, performance evaluation, career development, learning plan and what is required of you. From here you also send proofs of the learning units you finished, follow your badges and your learning hours, ask for learning outside the plan, and (in the cycle) evaluate yourself. HR prepares the content once for each title; you read it and acknowledge it.

Who sees it
- View permission: View my career path, scope: all (it only ever shows your own path).
- Default roles: the Employee role (given to everyone) and the head role of every unit hold it, together with the keys of your own path listed below.
- It does not need platform admin mode.
- The link «Career path» sits right under «Home» in the side menu. If HR has not set the path of your title as ready, you see the card «Your career path is not ready yet» instead of the content, and the link appears as soon as it is ready.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Open the page and read the five sections | Shows the path of your title, your progress cards and your acknowledgement | View my career path
Acknowledge the path | Records your acknowledgement with your name, the content version and the date | Acknowledge my career path
Export the learning units | Downloads the table of units of your learning plan (scope, columns, file type) | Export the learning units of my path
Send a proof / Send again | Opens the proof dialog for a unit and sends it for approval | Send a proof for a learning unit
Tick «Done» on a required item | Marks the item as done in the «Required» section | Mark a required item as done
Request learning outside the plan | Opens the learning request dialog (see the page «Development requests») | Send a development request
Self-evaluation, my result, objection and milestones | Appear in the evaluation section when a cycle is open (see the pages of the evaluation cycle and the team evaluation) | My self-evaluation in the evaluation cycle, Object to the result of my evaluation, Export a copy of my evaluation result, Acknowledge reading the minutes of my milestone

The page at a glance
- Identity card: your name, your job title, your unit, your direct manager, the title code split into badges (sector, department, section, unit) and your development stage (Foundation, Specialization, Mastery, Operational leadership, Institutional leadership), which comes from your grade and track.
- Header badge: «You acknowledged content version N».
- Progress cards: learning units done («X of Y»), hours done with the next medal, the budget spent against the cap of your stage, and the core competencies of your level that are met.
- Five sections: job description (summary, performance indicators, the governing indicator and responsibilities with their tasks) · performance evaluation · career development (career ladder, level path, technical competencies) · learning plan (learning units, badges, my requests) · required (items with dates, then the acknowledgement text). The learning plan tab shows a counter of done units and «Required» shows a red counter of late items.
- Career ladder: a rising staircase with the mark «You are here» and the next level; below it the condition to move up.
- Level path: the steps of the level, each with its kind of proof (course, certificate or applied at work) and its state.
- Technical competencies: a table of competencies against levels («Basic», «Expert» or «—» when the level does not ask for it) with a column «My level».

How to
Read and acknowledge the path (first sign-in, new title, or reopened by HR)
1. Sign in. A full screen shows only your path, with the reason: «This is your first sign-in», «Your job title has changed» or «HR reopened the acknowledgement». Sign out is always available.
2. Read the first section. The button «Next: <section>» stays off until you scroll to the end of the section; a short section counts as read at once.
3. Press «Next» for each of the five sections in order. A section not yet reached is locked, and «Previous» takes you back to a section you read.
4. At the sixth step, «Acknowledgement», tick the box in the bar at the bottom (it stays off until you reach this step) and press «Acknowledge and continue».
5. You get the message «Acknowledged. You can keep using the platform.» and the platform opens.
Send a proof for a learning unit
1. Open «Learning plan», then «Learning units», and find the unit.
2. Press the upload icon on the row («Send a proof»), or «Send again» if it was rejected.
3. Choose the kind of proof: Certificate (a PDF or image, up to 10 MB), Applied at work (your direct manager approves it after you describe what you applied) or Written output (a summary or report you produced).
4. Attach the file (a certificate without a file is refused: «Attach the certificate file first»), add an optional note for the reviewer and press «Send for approval».
5. The state of the unit becomes «Waiting for approval». The hours count only after approval.
Follow your badges and hours
1. Open «Learning plan», then «Badges».
2. Each badge shows its threshold in hours, your progress bar and whether you reached it; the card on top shows the next medal and how many hours are missing.
Mark a required item as done
1. Open «Required».
2. Tick «Done» on the item. Items with a date show «Overdue», «In N days» (orange within 30 days) or «While you are in the period».

Fields (form inputs)
The page has five forms: the acknowledgement, the proof of a learning unit, the learning request, the self-evaluation and the objection. The tick on a required item is a single box.
Acknowledgement (the last step, in the bar at the bottom)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
«I have read my career path and acknowledge it» (tick box) | Your statement that you went through the five sections of your path | Yes, to continue | Off until you reach the sixth step. It is recorded with your name, the content version you read and the date. The button is «Acknowledge and continue»
Send a proof of completion (dialog opened from a learning unit)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Kind of proof | How you show that you finished the unit. It decides who reviews it | Yes (the first one, «Certificate», is chosen at the start) | «Certificate» (the certificate file), «Applied at work» (your direct manager approves it after you describe what you applied) or «Written output» (a summary or report you produced from the learning)
Choose the proof file | The evidence itself, dropped in the box or picked with a click | Yes for a «Certificate» («Attach the certificate file first»); optional for the other two | One file, PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB
Note for the reviewer (optional) | A few words that help the reviewer (for «Applied at work» say what you applied and where) | No | Up to 500 characters
The hours of the unit (its minutes in the plan) are not typed: they come from the unit and count toward your hours, your badges and the «Learning» part of your evaluation only after approval.
Learning request (the button «Request learning outside the plan»)
The dialog «Learning request» has four fields: «Course name», «Cost in riyals», «Is the course in your learning plan?» and «Retention agreement for funded training». Each one is explained in the table of the page «Development requests».
Mark a required item as done
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
«Done» (tick box on an item of «Required») | Your own statement that you did what the item asks | No | Tick or untick; saved at once. An item with a past date and no tick counts as late
Self-evaluation (the button «Start the self-evaluation», in the evaluation section while the cycle is in its first stage)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
My rating (one for each behaviour of your stage) | How often you showed the behaviour, on the same scale your manager uses. It is the employee's own view and gives your manager a starting point | Yes to send (a draft may keep it empty) | «Always» (100), «Often» (75), «Sometimes» (50), «Rarely» (25), «Never» (0)
Note (one for each behaviour) | The reason for your rating, with an example | Yes at «Always», «Rarely» and «Never»; optional at the other levels | At least 5 characters when required, up to 500
My achievements for each results criterion (no score) | What you achieved against the criterion and the evidence. You give no score: only the manager scores the results | No | Up to 1,000 characters for each criterion
Internal initiatives (tick the items of this year's catalog) | The internal initiatives you took part in. Each item has points (1 to 10) | No | Only items of the catalog of the open cycle and of the right kind; up to 30
Contribution to growth (tick the items of this year's catalog) | The ways you contributed to growth. Each item has points (1 to 10) | No | Same as above
Learning (not typed) | Calculated by the system from your approved learning hours against the hours of your stage | — | Automatic
What the self-evaluation does: it carries no score of its own and does not bind your manager. Your manager reads it before the evaluation; the manager's scores, with the extra component the manager accepts, make the final grade.
Objection to the evaluation result (the button «Object to a criterion or behaviour», after the individual notification)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Item | The one part of the result you disagree with | Yes | A results criterion, a behaviour, or one of the three parts of the extra component (Learning, Initiatives, Growth)
Reason for the objection | Why you think the item is wrong, with the facts | Yes | From 10 to 1,000 characters
You have one objection in all, and only within five working days of the notification.

Workflow
1. Acknowledging the path
1. HR sets the path of your title «Ready», or you sign in for the first time, or your title changes, or HR reopens the acknowledgement. The platform is held back and shows only your path.
2. You read the five sections in order, using «Next» after scrolling to the end of each.
3. At the sixth step you tick the box and press «Acknowledge and continue».
4. The acknowledgement is saved with your name, the content version and the date. The platform opens.
Status | Meaning | Who can move it (permission key) | Moves to
Pending | You have no acknowledgement of the title you hold now, or HR reopened it | HR: Reopen the acknowledgement of a career path for a title's holders (reopen); the system (first sign-in, change of title) | Acknowledged
Acknowledged | The version you read is recorded | You: Acknowledge my career path | Pending again when your title changes or HR reopens it
2. A proof of a learning unit (your side)
1. You press «Send a proof» on the unit, choose the kind, attach the file and press «Send for approval».
2. The unit shows «Waiting for approval» (certificate or written output), or «With the direct manager» (applied at work). The system sends no notice at this step: the proof appears in the queue of the person who decides.
3. The reviewer (or your direct manager) approves it, rejects it with a reason, or refers it to your direct manager. You are told of the decision, and you see the reason on the unit if it was rejected.
4. If it was rejected, you press «Send again» and the cycle repeats. After the third rejection of the same unit your direct manager is told.
5. When it is approved, the hours count for you at once.
Status | Meaning | Who can move it (permission key) | Moves to
Not started | You have not sent a proof for the unit | You: Send a proof for a learning unit | Waiting for approval, or With the direct manager for «Applied at work»
Waiting for approval | With the reviewer of certificates | Reviewer: Approve the proof of a learning unit, Reject the proof of a learning unit with a reason, Refer a proof to the direct manager | Done, Rejected or With the direct manager
With the direct manager | A work application, or a proof the reviewer referred | Your direct manager: Decide a proof referred to the direct manager (the reviewer may also decide it) | Done or Rejected
Done | Approved: its hours count (final) | — | —
Rejected | Refused with a reason | You: Send a proof for a learning unit («Send again») | Waiting for approval, or With the direct manager
See the pages «Certificate review» and «My career team» for the other side.
3. A learning request outside the plan
1. You fill the dialog and send it; the dialog shows who will decide and why, and what is left of your yearly budget.
2. The approver (direct manager, sector head or CEO, by cost) is told and decides: approve or reject with a reason.
3. You are told of the decision. Full steps and statuses are in the page «Development requests».
4. Self-evaluation and result (one yearly cycle)
1. HR opens the evaluation cycle: you are told, and «Start the self-evaluation» appears.
2. You rate your behaviours, write your achievements, pick from the catalog and press «Send my self-evaluation». Before that you may press «Save a draft». Your direct manager is told when you send it for the first time.
3. You can press «Change my self-evaluation» until your manager starts (the first stage, or the manager's stage before the manager's first save).
4. After your manager, the upper manager and the calibration, the result is approved and you are told individually: your result appears under «My result», with a printable copy.
5. If you disagree, you raise your one objection within five working days. The decision of the approver reaches you as a notice.
Status | Meaning | Who can move it (permission key) | Moves to
Not started | Cycle open, nothing saved | You: My self-evaluation in the evaluation cycle | Draft or Sent
Draft | A half-filled form that was not sent | You: My self-evaluation in the evaluation cycle | Sent
Sent | Your manager was told and reviews it; you may still change it until the manager starts | You: My self-evaluation in the evaluation cycle | Read only from the calibration stage on
Result shown | After the approval and the individual notification, within the objection window | The approval holder: Approve the results and decide the objections; you may object with Object to the result of my evaluation | An objection decided (see the page «Calibration and approval»)
The whole cycle, with its stages and dates, is described in the page «Evaluation cycle».
Automatic things
- Reminders: a notice every Sunday at 08:00 (Riyadh time) when you have dated required items that are late, and the evaluation reminders HR configured (see «Evaluation cycle»).
- Notices to you: a proof approved or rejected (with the reason), a development request approved, rejected or moved up, the cycle opened, a date of the cycle changed, minutes of a milestone recorded, your result, the decision on your objection.
- Audit: proofs sent and decided, acknowledgements, self-evaluation sent or changed, objection raised are recorded.
What each person sees: you see only your own path, proofs, requests and evaluation; your direct manager sees your progress and proofs in «My career team» and your evaluation in «Team evaluation»; reviewers and HR see what their pages and permissions reach.

Business rules
- Acknowledgement is required when you have not acknowledged the title you hold now (first sign-in, or your title changed since your last acknowledgement) or when HR reopened it after your last acknowledgement (FR-112).
- While the acknowledgement is pending, the rest of the platform is locked: every link in the side menu is disabled with the tooltip «read and acknowledge first», and a notice at the top says why. Only your path, sign-out and the account menu stay available.
- You must read before you acknowledge: the five sections are read in order; «Next» works only after scrolling to the end of the section; the acknowledgement box is off until the sixth step. Scrolling guarantees that you passed through the page, not that you read it. If the content changes while you read, the page asks you to reload and read the new version.
- A session where an administrator signs in as you is never held back and cannot acknowledge for you.
- The acknowledgement is recorded with your name, the content version and the date. When HR changes the content, its version goes up.
- The content comes from the title, not from you: you cannot edit it. The path is shown only when HR set it «Ready».
- Learning units count once: a unit approved stays yours if you move to a title that includes it. Hours count only after approval (FR-114).
- A proof is one record per unit: a proof waiting or approved is not replaced; a rejected proof is replaced by a new one («Send again»), and the page shows the reason of the rejection. After the third rejection of the same unit your direct manager is told.
- Applied at work goes first to your direct manager and its decision is final.
- Badges have thresholds in hours set by HR in the title; a badge is reached when your approved hours reach its threshold.
- Learning outside the plan is approved by cost: direct manager, sector head, then the CEO (see the page «Development requests»).
- A reminder is sent to you when you have dated required items that are late.
- The evaluation section explains that evaluation belongs to your development stage, not to the title; weights, criteria and grade scale show when a cycle opens. Scores are never shown before the individual notification after approval (FR-119).
- The lists on the page (learning units, my requests) have search and filters (priority, language, state), the table / cards switch and export.

Tips and common problems
- «Next» does not work: scroll to the very end of the section; if the section has sub-tabs, a hint lists the tabs you still have to open.
- The box of the acknowledgement is off: you have not reached the sixth step yet.
- «Your career path is not ready yet»: HR has not set the path of your title as ready. Ask HR.
- A unit shows «No link yet»: HR has not added the learning link for it yet.
- The proof was not sent: check that a certificate has its file, and that the type is PDF, PNG or JPEG up to 10 MB.

title: My career team
text:
«My career team» shows managers the career paths of the people under them: how much of the mandatory and necessary learning they finished, their approved learning hours and what they are late in. It is a view for follow-up: you do not edit anyone's path here. You decide here only a proof that was referred to you, and you record the level a team member reached in a technical competency.
It is not a page of its own any more: it is the tab «My career team» of the Employees page (the old link to «My career team» takes you there).

Who sees it
- View permission: View «my career team», scopes: unit, unit and below, company, all. The default scope is unit and below.
- Default roles: the head role of every unit (made automatically from the structure) holds the view, decide and export keys at «unit and below». The Employee role does not hold them.
- It does not need platform admin mode.
- With the key View my team (colleagues of my unit) as well, the table adds the columns unit, company, work e-mail and work phone. With View my team (colleagues of my unit) only (no career key) the tab shows only the colleagues of your own unit.
- A person outside your scope does not exist for you: the system answers as if the record was not found.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Open the tab, search and filter | Lists the people in your scope with the numbers of their path; search by name; filter by state (regular, late) | View «my career team»
Open a member (eye icon or a click on the row) | A window with three cards (mandatory and necessary done, approved hours, late items), the proofs waiting for a decision and the competencies of the title | View «my career team»
Approve a proof referred to you | The proof becomes approved and its hours count for the employee | Decide a proof referred to the direct manager
Reject a proof referred to you | Rejects it with a reason (at least 5 characters); the employee is told | Decide a proof referred to the direct manager
Record a competency level | Records «Basic» or «Expert» for a competency of the member's title, or takes the record back | Record a competency level for a team member
Export the list | Downloads the table (scope, columns, file type) | Export the «my career team» list

How to
See who is late
1. Open Employees, then the tab «My career team».
2. If some people are late, a warning on top says «N of your team are late in what is required».
3. Filter the state by «Late», or read the column «Late» (a red number of late items).
4. Click a row to open the member and see what is late.
Decide a proof that was referred to you
1. Open the member. The list «Proofs waiting for a decision» shows the proofs.
2. Only a proof referred to the direct manager can be decided here (the work applications of your team, or a proof the reviewer referred).
3. Press «Approve», or press «Reject with a reason», write the reason (5 characters at least) and confirm.
Record a competency level
1. Open the member and go to «Competencies of the title».
2. For each competency the title asks for, choose the recorded level («Basic» or «Expert»). The employee sees it in the column «My level».
3. To undo, press «Take back».

Fields (form inputs)
The tab has two inputs on a member's window: the level of a competency and the reason when you reject a proof. Approving is a button with no input.
Competencies of the title (in the member's window)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Recorded level (one for each competency the title asks for) | The level the employee actually reached in that technical competency, as you judge it. The column «Required» next to it is what the title asks for at the employee's level | No (a competency may stay «Not recorded») | «Basic» or «Expert»; «Take back» removes your record. The competency counts as met when the recorded level is at least the required one. Saved at once
Reject with a reason (a proof referred to you)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Reason | Why the proof is refused; the employee reads it on the unit and in the notice | Yes | From 5 to 500 characters
Search and filters of the tab
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Search the team | Narrows the list by name | No | Free text
State | Narrows by how the employee stands in the path | No | Regular, Late, No ready path

Workflow
A proof referred to you (the work applications of your team, or a proof the reviewer referred)
1. The employee sends «Applied at work», or the reviewer refers a proof: its state is «With the direct manager» (machine career.certificate).
2. You open the member in the tab «My career team». The list «Proofs waiting for a decision» shows it. (No notice is sent when it arrives.)
3. You press «Approve» (the hours of the unit count for the employee), or «Reject with a reason».
4. The employee is told. After the third rejection of the same unit you are told as the direct manager («A proof of your team member was rejected again»).
5. Your decision on a work application is final.
Status | Meaning | Who can move it (permission key) | Moves to
With the direct manager | The proof waits for you | You: Decide a proof referred to the direct manager | Done or Rejected
Done | Approved; the hours count (final) | — | —
Rejected | Refused with a reason | The employee sends a new proof (Send a proof for a learning unit) | Waiting for approval, or With the direct manager
Competency levels (no stages)
1. You open the member and go to «Competencies of the title».
2. You pick «Basic» or «Expert» for a competency, or press «Take back».
3. The employee sees it in the column «My level», and the card of competencies of their path counts it. Approving a proof never sets a level; only you do.
Status | Meaning | Who can move it (permission key) | Moves to
Not recorded | Nothing recorded yet | You: Record a competency level for a team member | Basic or Expert
