Basic / Expert | The level you recorded | You: Record a competency level for a team member | The other level, or Not recorded («Take back»)
Automatic things
- Monthly report: on the 1st of every month at 08:00 (Riyadh time) each direct manager gets «Monthly career-path report» with how many of their direct team are late in what is required.
- Employees' reminder: each employee with late dated items is reminded every Sunday at 08:00 (see «My career path»).
- Notices: you are told after the third rejection of the same unit for someone in your team.
- Audit: the decisions on proofs and every recorded competency level are recorded.
What each person sees: you see the people in your unit and below (default scope «unit and below»); a person outside it does not exist for you. The employee sees only their own result of what you recorded and decided. With View my team (colleagues of my unit) as well the table adds contact columns.

Business rules
- Only the direct-manager chain sees the career file of a person: a person outside your unit and below is not shown (FR-115).
- Read only: «you do not edit their career file from here». The only decisions here are on proofs referred to you and the competency levels.
- Progress columns: the share of mandatory and necessary units done (a bar), approved hours out of the hours of the year, the number of late items and the state: Regular, Late or No ready path (the person's title has no ready path; such people are left out of the list).
- Late means a required item with a date that is past and not ticked by the employee.
- A work-application proof starts with the direct manager and the manager's decision is final. After the third rejection of the same unit the manager is told.
- A competency counts as met when the level you recorded is at least the level the title asks for in the employee's current level. Levels are recorded by hand: approving a proof does not set them (FR-117).
- Approved hours count only after approval, a unit once.
- The list has search, a state filter, the table / cards switch and export; the number of rows follows your scope.

Tips and common problems
- The tab is missing in Employees: your role holds neither View «my career team» nor View my team (colleagues of my unit), or the page was hidden for your role.
- Someone you expect is not in the list: they are outside your unit and below, or their title has no ready career path.
- The contact columns are missing: they need the key View my team (colleagues of my unit) too.

title: Certificate review
text:
«Certificate review» is the page where the proofs that employees sent for the units of their learning plan are decided. You open a proof, look at the file and the unit, then approve it (its hours start to count), reject it with a reason, or refer it to the employee's direct manager. It is for the reviewer of learning proofs, normally the employee development officer.

Who sees it
- View permission: View the certificate review page and its files, scope: all. The review scope is all employees; it is not narrowed by unit.
- Default role: Employee development officer (made once by the platform when it does not exist yet, with the five certificate keys). The platform manager can add the keys to any other role or person from the permissions page.
- It does not need platform admin mode for the officer role.
- Menu: the group «Career file», item «Certificate review».

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Open the page, search and filter | Lists the proofs; search by employee or unit; filters: kind of proof (certificate, applied at work, written output) and state | View the certificate review page and its files
Open the proof (eye icon or a click on the row) | A review window: the employee, the unit, the kind of proof, the hours that will count, the date sent, the file with an open button and the note of the employee | View the certificate review page and its files
Approve (check icon) | The proof becomes approved and the hours of the unit count for the employee | Approve the proof of a learning unit
Reject with a reason (X icon) | The proof is rejected, the reason is saved and the employee is told | Reject the proof of a learning unit with a reason
Refer to the direct manager (arrow icon) | The proof goes to the employee's direct manager to decide | Refer a proof to the direct manager
Export the list | Downloads the list (scope, columns, file type) | Export the list of certificates
A button you do not hold the key for is hidden; the approve, reject and refer buttons show only on a proof that can still be decided.

How to
Approve a proof
1. Open «Certificate review». The page says «You review the proofs of every employee here».
2. Search by the name of the employee or the unit, or filter by the kind of proof or the state.
3. Click the row to open the proof. Read the details and press «Open the file» to see the certificate.
4. Press «Approve». You get «The proof was approved.» and the hours of the unit count.
Reject a proof
1. Open the proof, or press the X icon on its row.
2. Write the reason (at least 5 characters). The window says how many times this unit was rejected before.
3. Press «Reject the proof». The employee is told, sees the reason on the unit and can send a new proof.
Refer a proof to the direct manager
1. Open the proof that is waiting for approval.
2. Press «Refer to the direct manager». The state becomes «With the direct manager».
3. The manager decides it from «My career team». You can still decide it yourself if you need to.

Fields (form inputs)
The only form of this page is the rejection dialog. Approving and referring are buttons with no input. The search and the filters narrow the list.
Reject the proof (dialog «Reject the proof»)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Reason for rejection | Why the proof is refused, in words the employee can act on: the employee reads it on the unit and in the notice | Yes | From 5 to 500 characters (shorter shows «Write a reason of at least 5 characters.»). The dialog also says how many times this unit was rejected before
Search and filters of the list
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Search the proofs | Narrows the list by the name of the employee or the unit | No | Up to 120 characters
Kind of proof | Narrows by how the proof was given | No | Certificate, Applied at work, Written output
State | Narrows by where the proof stands | No | Waiting for approval, With the direct manager, Done, Rejected

Workflow
A proof is one record for one employee and one unit, run by the machine career.certificate.
1. The employee presses «Send a proof» on a unit and sends it with a kind, a file (certificate) and an optional note.
2. A certificate or a written output starts «Waiting for approval» with the reviewer (this page). An applied at work proof starts «With the direct manager» and goes to «My career team», not to this queue first.
3. The reviewer opens the proof, reads the file and the unit, and chooses: Approve (the hours of the unit count), Reject with a reason, or Refer to the direct manager.
4. A referred proof waits for the manager, who approves or rejects it from «My career team». The reviewer can still decide it meanwhile.
5. The employee is told of an approval or a rejection (with the reason). After the third rejection of the same unit the employee's direct manager is told too.
6. A rejected proof is replaced by the next one the employee sends (the same record, with a new run and the count of rejections kept).
Status | Meaning | Who can move it (permission key) | Moves to
Waiting for approval | Sent; with the reviewer | Approve the proof of a learning unit (approve), Reject the proof of a learning unit with a reason (reject), Refer a proof to the direct manager (refer) | Done, Rejected or With the direct manager
With the direct manager | A work application, or a proof the reviewer referred | The manager: Decide a proof referred to the direct manager; the reviewer may also decide it with the approve and reject keys | Done or Rejected
Done | Approved; the hours of the unit count and a unit counts once (final) | — | —
Rejected | Refused with a reason; the number of rejections is kept | The employee sends a new proof: Send a proof for a learning unit | Waiting for approval, or With the direct manager
Two people deciding at once: the first decision wins and the second gets «The decision could not be made: someone else may have decided it. Refresh the page.»
Automatic things
- Notices: the employee is told when a proof is approved or rejected (the reason is in the notice); the direct manager is told after the third rejection of the same unit. Sending a proof and referring it send no notice; the proof appears in the queue of the person who decides.
- Audit: sending, approving, rejecting and referring a proof are recorded with who and when.
- There is no timer on a proof: it waits for a person.
What each person sees: the reviewer sees the proofs of all employees (scope all); the direct manager sees only the referred proofs of the people under them in «My career team»; the employee sees the state and the reason on their own unit.

Business rules
- Proofs and who decides (FR-114): a proof is one record per employee and per learning unit. A certificate and a written output start with the reviewer. An applied at work proof starts with the employee's direct manager, and the manager's decision is final.
- States of a proof: not started, waiting for approval, with the direct manager, done, rejected.
- Hours count only once approved, and a unit counts once for the employee.
- A rejection needs a reason of at least 5 characters; the employee reads it. A rejected proof is replaced by the next one the employee sends; the number of rejections is kept.
- After the third rejection of the same unit the employee's direct manager is told.
- A decision taken by someone else meanwhile is refused: the page says «The decision could not be made: someone else may have decided it. Refresh the page.»
- A proof of a unit that was removed from the plan shows «A unit no longer in the plan».
- The name of whoever decided and the time are saved with the proof.
- The review scope is all employees for now; narrowing it is not offered.
- Like every list, the page offers the table / cards switch, search, filters and export.

Tips and common problems
- The list is empty: «No proofs are waiting for review» means nothing was sent or everything was decided.
- The approve button is missing on a row: the proof was already decided, or your role lacks the key.
- You see the page but cannot approve: your role holds the view key only. Ask the platform manager for the approve and reject keys.

title: Development requests
text:
A development request is a request for learning that is not simply a unit of your plan, for example a course at another provider, with its cost. The request goes to the right approver by its cost: the direct manager, the sector head or the CEO. Employees send requests from their learning plan; approvers decide them on the page «Development requests».

Who sees it
- Sending a request (employee): Send a development request, scope: all. Held by the Employee role; the button «Request learning outside the plan» is in «Learning plan». The employee follows the requests in «Learning plan», then «My requests».
- The approvers' page: view permission View the «development requests» page, scopes: unit, unit and below, company, all; default unit and below. The head role of every unit holds View the «development requests» page, Approve a development request, Reject a development request with a reason and Export the list of development requests at «unit and below».
- It does not need platform admin mode.
- Menu: the group «Career file», item «Development requests».

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Send a request | The dialog «Learning request» sends a request for approval; the approver is shown before you send | Send a development request
Follow my requests | The list «My requests» with search, filters and a details window | View my career path
Open the page, search and filter | Two views: «Waiting for me» and «All requests»; search by employee or course; filters: state, approver, in or outside the plan | View the «development requests» page
Open a request (eye icon or a click on the row) | A window with the course, cost, plan, approver, state, dates, the retention agreement file and a warning if the cost is above the budget left | View the «development requests» page
Approve (check icon) | The request is approved and its cost counts in the budget spent of the employee | Approve a development request
Reject (X icon) | The request is rejected with a reason and the employee is told | Reject a development request with a reason
Export the list | Downloads the requests (scope, columns, file type) | Export the list of development requests
The approve and reject icons appear only on a request that is with you.

How to
Send a learning request (employee)
1. Open «Career path», then «Learning plan» and press «Request learning outside the plan».
2. Write the course name and its cost in riyals (a whole number).
3. Choose «In the learning plan» (a unit of your plan you want at another provider) or «Outside the plan».
4. Optionally attach the retention agreement for funded training (PDF or image).
5. Check the line «Decided by» and the approver name that appear at once, and the budget left. Press «Send the request».
Decide a request (approver)
1. Open Development requests. The tab «Waiting for me» lists what is with you.
2. Click a request to read it. Check the cost, the plan kind and the budget warning.
3. Press «Approve», or press «Reject», write the reason (at least 5 characters) and confirm. The employee is told.

Fields (form inputs)
Learning request (dialog «Learning request», sent by the employee)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Course name | The name of the course or training you ask for | Yes («The course name is required.») | From 2 to 200 characters
Cost in riyals | What the course costs. The cost decides who approves (see the workflow) and is compared with what is left of your yearly budget | Yes («The cost is required (a whole number of riyals).») | A whole number from 0 to 10,000,000
Is the course in your learning plan? | Whether the course is a unit of your plan that you want to take at another provider, or something outside the plan | Yes (one of the two) | «In the learning plan» (up to 5,000 riyals goes to the direct manager) or «Outside the plan» (needs the sector head at least)
Retention agreement for funded training | The agreement you sign when the company pays for the training, attached for the approver to see | No | One file, PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB
While you type, the dialog shows «Decided by», the name of the approver, and «Left of your yearly budget». If the cost is above what is left it warns but still lets you send. If the approver post is vacant, or held by you, the request goes up to the next level; only when nobody holds any post that can decide it does the dialog say «Nobody holds the approver post yet: ask HR to set the unit leader.» and the request is refused.
Reject a request (dialog «Reject the request», by the approver)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Reason | Why the request is refused; the employee reads it | Yes | From 5 to 500 characters («The reason needs at least five characters.»)
Search and filters of the list
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Search the requests | By employee or course | No | Up to 120 characters
State | Where the request stands | No | Waiting, Approved, Rejected
Approver | The level that decides now | No | The direct manager, The sector head, The CEO
In or outside the plan | The plan kind of the course | No | In the plan, Outside the plan
Waiting for me / All requests (view) | Only what is with you, or all the requests of your scope | — | Two tabs

Workflow
A development request is a record run by the machine career.development_request.
1. The employee fills «Learning request» and presses «Send the request». The system picks the level by cost and plan, and the person by the structure, then stores them on the request.
2. The approver is told («A development request is waiting for your decision») and finds it under «Waiting for me».
3. The approver opens the request, reads the cost, the plan kind, the agreement and the budget warning, and presses «Approve» or «Reject» (with a reason).
4. The employee is told of the decision. An approved request counts its cost in the budget spent of the employee for the current calendar year.
5. If the direct manager does not answer in 7 days, the request goes up to the sector head by itself: the sector head is told, and so is the employee («Your development request went up»). If nobody holds a higher post, the direct manager keeps it and can still decide.
Who decides by cost: in the plan and up to 5,000 riyals, the direct manager; outside the plan, or above 5,000 up to 20,000 riyals, the sector head; above 20,000 riyals, the CEO. A post that nobody holds, or that the employee holds, sends the request up to the next level.
Status / Stage | Meaning | Who can move it (permission key) | Moves to
Sent (routing) | The request was just made and is being routed | The system, at once | The direct manager, the sector head or the CEO
With the direct manager | In the plan and up to 5,000 riyals; 7 days to answer | The approver: Approve a development request, Reject a development request with a reason; the system after 7 days | Approved, Rejected, or the sector head (timeout)
With the sector head | Outside the plan, or from 5,000 up to 20,000; no deadline | The approver: Approve a development request, Reject a development request with a reason | Approved or Rejected
With the CEO | Above 20,000; no deadline | The approver: Approve a development request, Reject a development request with a reason | Approved or Rejected
Approved | Decided; its cost counts in the budget (final) | — | —
Rejected | Refused with a reason the employee reads (final) | — | —
Automatic things
- The 7-day timeout of the direct manager is a durable timer of the workflow (it survives a restart) that moves the request to the sector head and notifies both people.
- Notices: the approver on sending and on going up; the employee on approval, rejection and going up.
- Audit: sending, approval, rejection and going up are recorded (the going up is recorded without a person: it is the system).
What each person sees: the employee follows their own requests in «Learning plan», then «My requests»; an approver sees, with View the «development requests» page at «unit and below», the requests of the people in their scope and can decide only the ones that reach them (the others are read only).

Business rules
- Who decides by cost (FR-116): in the plan and up to 5,000 riyals the direct manager; outside the plan or from above 5,000 up to 20,000 the sector head; above 20,000 the CEO. The dialog shows who decides and why as soon as you type the cost.
- The approver is chosen when the request is sent: the direct manager of the employee, the head of the sector above their unit, or the CEO (the head of the office directly under the group). If nobody holds the post, or the holder is the employee, the request goes up to the next level; if nobody holds any higher post the request is refused with the message «Nobody holds the approver post yet: ask HR to set the unit leader.»
- The direct manager has 7 days (about 5 working days); after that the request goes up to the sector head, who and the employee are told.
- You decide only what reaches you: a request with another approver is shown read only («The request is with another approver and you see it read only»). Someone outside your scope does not see the request.
- Approve or reject only, with a reason for rejection of at least 5 characters; the decision closes the request and the employee reads the reason. If someone decided it first, you get «The decision could not be made».
- The budget is a warning, never a block: the cap is the one of the employee's development stage; the spent amount is the cost of the requests approved in the current calendar year (Riyadh). If the cost is above what is left, the dialog warns and the lists show «Above the budget left»; the approver decides. If the stage has no cap, nothing is compared.
- The retention agreement is optional and is seen by the approver.
- States: waiting for a decision, approved, rejected. Plan kinds: in the plan, outside the plan.
- Both lists offer search, filters, the table / cards switch and export.

Tips and common problems
- The button «Request learning outside the plan» is missing: your role lacks Send a development request.
- The request is refused at sending: nobody holds the approver post above you; ask HR to set the leader of the unit.
- The page is empty: «There are no development requests yet» or nothing is with you; try «All requests».

title: Career-path content
text:
«Career-path content» is the HR page that prepares the career path of each job title. The job titles are listed with the state of each one's path. For a title you upload its title file (one file with the job description, the career development, the learning plan and the required items), review what the system read from it, fix details by hand, then set the path Ready so that the people holding the title see it and are asked to acknowledge it. The page also reopens the acknowledgement, imports the learning links from an Excel file and exports the list.

Who sees it
- View permission: View the career-path content, scope: all.
- Default roles: none of the standard roles holds it except the Administrator. The platform manager gives it, with the keys below, to the HR role from the permissions page. Administrative permissions that wait for platform admin mode work only while the mode is on.
- Menu: the group «Career file», item «Career-path content». The Employee role does not see it.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Open the page, search and filter | The titles as a column of buttons (name, code, state); search by title or code; filters on unit, grade, track and path state | View the career-path content
Edit a path by hand | The workspace of the title (seven tabs): description, ladder and path, technical competencies, learning plan, required, evaluation, shared lists; «Save changes» raises the content version. Without the edit key the workspace is read only | Edit the career-path content of a job title
Preview the path (eye icon) | Shows the path as the holders of the title see it, without a name, progress or acknowledgement | Preview a career path as the employee sees it
Upload the title file | Opens the dialog «Upload the title file»: choose a txt, docx or pdf file or paste its text, press «Extract», review, then «Save the extracted content» | Upload a title file and read the career path from it
Analyse with AI | Offers the AI to place the parts of a file the fixed reader could not | Analyse a title file with AI
Set the path ready / Set back to draft | Shows the path to the holders (and asks them to acknowledge), or hides it again | Set a career path ready or back to draft
Reopen the acknowledgement for its holders | Asks every holder of the title to acknowledge the path again, with a reason | Reopen the acknowledgement of a career path for a title's holders
Import learning links | Imports an Excel file of learning links (title code, period, unit, link) | Import learning-unit links from a file
Export the list | Downloads the list of titles and the state of their paths | Export the list of titles and the state of their paths

How to
Build the path of a title from its file
1. Open Career-path content and click the title in the list. The panel shows its name, code, content version and state.
2. Press «Upload the title file». Choose a txt, docx or pdf file (it is read in your browser) or paste the text (up to 200,000 characters).
3. Press «Extract». The table shows each part (job description, career development, learning plan, required) as «Sound» or «Needs review», with counts (indicators, responsibilities, ladder levels, learning units, learning minutes...) and the reader's notes; text that is not content (such as «Next», «Back», «Print») is skipped and listed.
4. If everything is sound, press «Save the extracted content». The content version goes up. Saving stays off while any part needs review.
5. If the reader could not place the parts, use «Analyse with AI» (see the rules), review the result in the same table, then save.
Set the path ready for its holders
1. Open the title. The panel lists what is missing, or says «Every part is complete: the path can be set ready».
2. Press «Set the path ready». The window says how many holders will see it and be asked to acknowledge.
3. Confirm. The holders see the path and read it on their next sign-in.
4. To hide it, press «Set the path back to draft»: nothing the people acknowledged is deleted.
Reopen the acknowledgement
1. Open the title and press «Reopen the acknowledgement for its holders (N)».
2. Write a reason (at least 5 characters) and press «Confirm».
3. The holders must acknowledge again when they sign in, and cannot use the platform before.
Import learning links
1. In the page header press the import button and choose the Excel file (download the template first; it has the columns «Title code», «Period», «Unit name», «Link»).
2. Review the preview: how many units will get a new link and how many stay as they are; each refused row shows its number and its reason.
3. Confirm. The content version of the titles changed goes up.

Fields (form inputs)
HR has four forms here: the title file, the workspace of a title (five editors), the reopening of the acknowledgement and the import of learning links. Texts of the path are written once, in the language of the title file (Arabic).
Upload the title file (dialog «Upload the title file: <title>»)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Choose the title file | The one file that holds the job description, the career development, the learning plan and the required items of the title. It is read in your browser | One of the two (file or text) | txt, docx or pdf
Or paste the text of the file | The same content as text, when the file cannot be read | One of the two (file or text) | Up to 200,000 characters
Then «Extract» reads it, the table shows each part as «Sound» or «Needs review», and «Save the extracted content» saves only when every part is sound. «Analyse with AI» is an extra button (see the rules).
Workspace of a title, tab «Job description»
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Job summary | A short paragraph of what the job is for | Yes to set ready | Up to 2,000 characters
Indicator (job performance indicators) | One measure the job is judged by | At least one to set ready | Up to 300 characters each, up to 30
Governing indicator (tick) | Marks the indicator that governs the job | No | One tick for the indicator that governs
Responsibility | A duty of the job | At least one to set ready | Up to 200 characters, up to 40 responsibilities
Its tasks | The tasks of that responsibility | No | One per line, up to 400 characters each, up to 30
Tab «Ladder and path»
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Level (a step of the career ladder) | The grade of the step | Yes for each step | L1 to L9, up to 9 steps
Title (of the step) | The job title at that level | Yes | Up to 120 characters
Current title (radio) | Marks where the holders of this title stand on the ladder (shown as «You are here») | One step marked | One only
Condition to move up | What the employee must do to go to the next level | Yes to set ready | Up to 600 characters
Unit / Title (of the path) | The unit and title the level path belongs to | No | Up to 200 characters each
Step n: heading, Content, Kind of proof | The steps of the level path: each with a heading, what it asks and the kind of proof (course, certificate or applied at work) | Yes for each step | Up to 9 steps; heading up to 80, content and kind of proof up to 300 characters
Documented output of this level / Certificates at the end of the level | What the level should produce and which certificates it ends with | No | Up to 600 characters each
Tab «Technical competencies»
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Column n name (Competency levels) | The levels at which competencies are asked (for example «L9 Recruitment coordinator»). The first column is the current level and is what «My level» is compared with | Yes for each column | Up to 12 columns, up to 40 characters each
Competency | A technical competency of the title | Yes | Up to 120 characters, up to 60
Value at each column | What the competency asks at that level | Yes (starts «—») | «Basic», «Expert», «Not required» or «—» (stored in the words of the file)
Tab «Learning plan»
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Period name | A year or period of the plan | Yes | Up to 80 characters, not repeated, up to 10 periods
Priority | How important the unit is | Yes | The file's words: إلزامي (mandatory), ضروري (necessary), أساسي (basic)
Unit | The name of the course or unit | Yes | Up to 300 characters, up to 60 units a period
Provider | Who gives it | No | Up to 300 characters
Duration | How long it is, as written; it is turned into minutes and shown under the field. These minutes become the hours the employee earns | Yes | Up to 60 characters; a duration nobody understands is refused («The duration is not understood»)
Language | The language of the unit | Yes | The file's words: عربي (Arabic), إنجليزي (English)
Link | Where the employee opens the unit | No | Empty, or a link starting with https:// (up to 500 characters)
Badge name / Its condition / Hours | A medal: its name, its condition and the approved hours that earn it | Yes (at least one badge to set ready) | Name up to 120, condition up to 300, hours 1 to 2,000, up to 8 badges
How the badge is awarded | The rule of the badges in words | No | Up to 1,000 characters
Tab «Required»
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
When | The period the item belongs to (for example «Before 10 March») | Yes | Up to 160 characters, up to 30 items
Item text | What the employee must do | Yes (at least one line) | One per line, up to 400 characters each, up to 10 lines
Last day | The date after which the item is late | No | A date; empty means «While you are in the period»
Acknowledgement text | The sentence the employee agrees to when acknowledging | Yes to set ready | Up to 500 characters
The tabs «Evaluation» and «Shared lists» hold no input here: the evaluation belongs to the evaluation cycle page.
Reopen the acknowledgement (dialog «Reopen the acknowledgement»)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Reason | Why the holders must acknowledge again (it is kept in the audit) | Yes | From 5 to 300 characters. Possible only for a path that is «Ready»
Import learning links (the import button of the page)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Title code | The code of the title, as in the list (for example OPS.01.01.01-L9P-01) | Yes | Up to 40 characters
Period | The name of the period in the learning plan | Yes | Up to 80 characters
Unit name | The name of the unit in that period | Yes | Up to 300 characters
Link | The https address the employee opens | No | https:// address up to 500 characters; empty clears the link
The file is an Excel sheet (download the template first), up to 1,000 rows. A first review shows how many units get a new link and the reason of every refused row; nothing changes until you confirm.
Search and filters of the list: search by title or code; filters on unit, grade, track and path state.

Workflow
The content of a title lives in two states, Draft and Ready, and a version number that grows at every save.
1. HR opens the title in the list and presses «Upload the title file».
2. The file is read: «Extract» fills the review table. Nothing is saved yet. If a part «Needs review», fix the text and extract again, or press «Analyse with AI» and review its answer. Do not extract again after an AI answer: extracting again replaces it with the fixed reader's reading.
3. HR presses «Save the extracted content»: the content is saved (a path that was never set ready stays a draft; one already ready stays ready) and the version goes up. Any detail can then be edited by hand in the workspace and saved with «Save changes» (the version goes up again).
4. When the panel says «Every part is complete: the path can be set ready», HR presses «Set the path ready» and confirms the number of holders.
5. The holders see the path on their next sign-in and must acknowledge it (see «My career path»). HR may press «Preview» at any time to see it as they will.
6. When the content changes later, or HR needs everyone to read it again, HR presses «Reopen the acknowledgement for its holders» with a reason.
7. To hide the path, HR presses «Set the path back to draft»: nothing the people acknowledged is deleted.
Status | Meaning | Who can move it (permission key) | Moves to
Draft (or no content) | Saved or empty; the holders do not see it | HR: Upload a title file and read the career path from it, Edit the career-path content of a job title (save), Set a career path ready or back to draft | Ready (when complete)
Ready | The holders see it and acknowledge it | HR: Set a career path ready or back to draft (back to draft); Edit the career-path content of a job title keeps it ready and raises the version | Draft
Acknowledgement reopened | Holders must acknowledge again at their next sign-in | HR: Reopen the acknowledgement of a career path for a title's holders | The holders acknowledge (Acknowledge my career path)
Automatic things
- No notice is sent when a path is set ready or the acknowledgement is reopened: the holders meet it at their next sign-in (the platform is held back until they acknowledge).
- Versions: every save raises the content version; an acknowledgement records the version read; a save on a stale version is refused.
- Audit: uploads, AI analyses (without the text of the file), saves, ready and draft changes and reopenings are recorded with who and when.
What each person sees: HR (with View the career-path content) sees every title and its state; the holders of a title see only their own path, and only when it is Ready; an employee never sees this page.

Business rules
- One file per title: description, development, learning plan and required items; the performance evaluation is not in this file because it belongs to the development stage and is uploaded once from the evaluation cycle page (FR-113).
- Nothing is saved before you review it, and a file with a part that needs review is not saved. The checks include: missing summary, indicators or responsibilities; a ladder without a marked current title; missing level-path steps, condition to move up, competencies, learning units, badges or required items or acknowledgement text; a learning period whose total does not match its units; a title code in the file that is not this title's code; and text over a limit or a duration nobody can read.
- A path can be set ready only when it is complete (description, development, learning plan with at least one unit and one badge, required items and the acknowledgement text). A draft may be saved incomplete, but never with a link that does not start with https:// or a period without a name.
- Ready or draft: the holders of a title see the path only when it is ready; back to draft hides it without deleting what they acknowledged.
- Content versions: every save raises the version, and the acknowledgement of an employee records the version. If someone else changed the content after you opened it, your save is refused («Close the window, open it again and redo your edit»).
- AI reading (FR-126, FR-127): the fixed reader always comes first and is free. The button «Analyse with AI» shows only when an AI service is switched on in the settings and you hold the AI key. Nothing is sent unless you press it, and the text of the file (company data, not employees' data) goes to that service. You review the result before anything is saved; texts that are not in the file word for word are listed to be checked. Durations and dates are always computed by the system. Up to 6 analyses per hour per person.
- Reopening needs a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
- Learning links must start with https://; an empty link clears it. A row is refused when the title code or the period or the unit is not found, the unit name is repeated in the period, or the row repeats a unit already named above.
- Audit: uploads, AI analyses (without the text of the file), saves, ready and draft changes and reopenings are recorded.

Tips and common problems
- «Save» is off: extract the file first, or fix the parts listed under «Parts that need review».
- «The text could not be read»: try pasting the text of the file.
- The path cannot be set ready: the panel names the missing parts.
- You see the workspace but cannot edit it: you do not hold Edit the career-path content of a job title.

title: Evaluation cycle
text:
«Evaluation cycle» is the HR page that runs the yearly performance evaluation. The fiscal year runs from April to March. HR uploads the evaluation file (the template of each of the five development stages, the grade scale and the fiscal-year card), checks that the cycle is ready, opens it, moves it from stage to stage by its dates, keeps the catalog of the extra component and the automatic reminders, and closes it at the end.

Who sees it
- View permission: View the «evaluation cycle» page, scope: all.
- Default roles: none of the standard roles holds it except the Administrator; the platform manager gives it, with the keys below, to the HR role from the permissions page. Administrative permissions that wait for platform admin mode work only while the mode is on.
- Menu: the group «Career file», item «Evaluation cycle».
- Before the cycle opens the page is in view mode; employees see «The evaluation cycle has not been opened yet» in their own page.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Open the page and read the stages, dates and readiness | The stepper of the stages, the readiness card, the stage dates, the catalog, the reminders and the evaluation file | View the «evaluation cycle» page
Open the evaluation cycle and notify employees | Asks for the fiscal year, takes a snapshot of the templates and starts the self-evaluation stage | Open the evaluation cycle, move it on and change its dates
Move the cycle to the next stage | The cycle moves on and never goes back | Open the evaluation cycle, move it on and change its dates
Change a stage date (pencil icon) | Saves the new date or range, checks the order, records it in the audit and notifies the people affected | Open the evaluation cycle, move it on and change its dates
Close the cycle | After a confirmation the cycle is closed for good; your name and time are saved | Close the evaluation cycle
Upload the evaluation file | Dialog to read a txt, docx or pdf file (or pasted text) and save the five stages, the scale and the card | Upload the evaluation file (stage templates, grade scale, fiscal card)
Analyse the file with AI | Lets the AI place the parts of the file; you review before saving | Analyse the evaluation file with AI
Edit, add or delete a part of the file | A form for each stage template, the grade scale and the fiscal-year card; delete a stage template | Add, change and remove the parts of the evaluation file (stages, grade scale, fiscal card)
Export the evaluation file list | Downloads the list of the seven parts | Export the list of the evaluation file
Add or delete a catalog item | Items of the extra component for this year (initiatives, contribution to growth) | Manage the extra-component catalog
Export the catalog | Downloads the catalog | Export the extra-component catalog
Add, change, switch on or off, delete a reminder | The automatic reminders of the cycle | Add, change and remove the automatic reminders of the evaluation cycle
Export the reminders | Downloads the reminders | Export the automatic reminders of the evaluation cycle
Buttons that cannot work now stay visible but dimmed, and a click explains why («The cycle has not been opened yet», «The cycle is closed»...).

The stages of the cycle
Each stage is a button in the stepper; clicking it explains who works in it, what happens and the date, and takes you to its screen.
Stage | Who works | What happens | Usual date
Self-evaluation | The employee | Rates their behaviours, writes their achievements, picks from the catalog; the manager is notified | Until 10 March
Manager's evaluation | The direct manager, then the upper manager | Reviews the self-evaluation and enters results and behaviour scores; indirect reports follow their direct manager's review | After the self-evaluation
Calibration | The holder of the calibration key | Compares scores between managers and adjusts with a written reason | 21 to 24 April
Approval | The holder of the approval key | Approves the results and decides on objections | 27 April
Individual notification | The system | Tells each employee their result, with an exportable copy | 30 April
Objection window | The employee and the approval holder | One reasoned objection on one item | Five working days
Closed | The system | The cycle is closed and results stay in the employee's record | —

How to
Prepare and open the cycle
1. Press «Upload the evaluation file». Choose a txt, docx or pdf file or paste the text, then press «Extract».
2. Read the table: for each of the five stages the basic split (results/behaviour), the shares of the criteria, the extra component and the cap, the behaviours and the state «Sound» or «Needs review»; and the shared parts (grade scale, fiscal-year card). Press «Save the evaluation of all stages» when everything is sound.
3. Look at «Readiness to open the cycle»: each stage, the grade scale and the fiscal-year card must read «Uploaded»; the catalog should have items; and someone should hold the calibration key and someone the approval key (a warning only).
4. Press «Open the evaluation cycle and notify employees», confirm the fiscal year (the next fiscal year is proposed) and press «Open the cycle».
Change the date of a stage
1. In «Stage dates» press the pencil of the row.
2. Fill «From (or a single day)» and, if it is a range, «To».
3. Press «Save the date». If the order is wrong the dialog says why (for example «The date is before the end of the stage ahead of it»).
Move on and close the cycle
1. Press «Move the cycle to the next stage» when a stage ends (stages never move by themselves: the dates only schedule the work and the reminders).
2. When the objections are decided, press «Close the cycle» and confirm.
Add a reminder
1. In «Automatic reminders» press «Add a reminder».
2. Choose the kind, the days, the title and text in Arabic (English is optional) and save.

Fields (form inputs)
HR has eight forms here. The first four set up the evaluation file; the others run the cycle. Basic idea of the score, so the fields make sense: the basic score is the results score (0 to 100 per criterion, weighted by the criteria shares) times the results weight, plus the behaviour score times the behaviour weight (the weights are percentages, so the sum is divided by 100: scores 80 and 75 with weights 60 and 40 give 78); then the extra component (learning, internal initiatives, contribution to growth) is added up to its points; the final score never goes above the cap of the stage.
Upload the evaluation file (dialog «Upload the performance evaluation file (all stages)»)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Evaluation file | One file that holds the five stages, then the grade scale and the fiscal-year card. Read in your browser | One of the two (file or text) | txt, docx or pdf
Text of the evaluation file | The same content pasted as text | One of the two (file or text) | Up to 200,000 characters
«Extract» shows a table (basic split, criteria shares, extra and cap, behaviours, state «Sound» or «Needs review»). «Save the evaluation of all stages» is on only when every part is sound.
Template of a stage (form «Template of stage n»; five stages, one for each development stage)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Name of the stage | The development stage this template is for (Foundation, Specialization, Mastery, Operational leadership, Institutional leadership) | Yes | 1 to 120 characters
Results weight | How much of the basic score the results are worth | Yes | 0 to 100
Behaviour weight | How much of the basic score the behaviours are worth | Yes | 0 to 100. Basic = results weight + behaviour weight (shown; it is computed, not typed)
Evaluation rule (who evaluates) | The rule of the stage in words | No | Up to 600 characters
Component / Points (extra component) | A part added on top of the basic score (for example learning, initiatives, growth) and the most it can add | No | Name 1 to 120 characters, points 0 to 100, up to 10 components. Cap = basic + the points of the components (shown; computed)
Criterion / Share % (results criteria) | What the manager scores from 0 to 100, and how much each criterion weighs inside the results part | Yes, at least one | Name 1 to 160 characters; shares 0 to 100 and they must add up to 100 («Sum of the shares: n of 100»); up to 30
What the results mean in this stage | An explanation shown to employees and managers | No | Up to 1,000 characters
Code / Behaviour / The evaluator's question (behaviours) | A behaviour rated from «Always» to «Never», with the question the evaluator answers | Yes, at least one; every behaviour needs its question | Code like B1.1, unique, up to 20 characters; name 1 to 160; question up to 600; up to 40 behaviours
Grade scale (form «Grade scale»)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Name of the level | A level of the final score (for example «Meets expectations») | Yes | 1 to 80 characters
From / To | The lowest and the highest final score of the level | Yes (the highest level has no «To», the lowest has no «From») | Numbers; the ranges must follow one another from the highest to the lowest without overlapping; two to ten levels
What it means | A sentence explaining the level | No | Up to 400 characters
Fiscal-year card (form «Fiscal-year card»)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Kind of each month (April to March) | Whether the month is a milestone or a month of daily follow-up | Yes, for the twelve months | «Milestone» or «Daily follow-up»
Month / Text of the note (notes) | A note about a month, shown on the card | No | Month up to 40 characters, text up to 600, up to 30 notes
Open the evaluation cycle (dialog «Open the evaluation cycle»)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Fiscal year | The fiscal year (April to March) the cycle is for. The next fiscal year is proposed | Yes | A four-digit year from 2020 to 2100; one cycle only for a year, and none while another is open
Change a stage date (dialog «Change a date»)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
From (or a single day) | The day the stage or event starts (or its only day) | Yes | A date. It may not be before the end of the stage ahead of it, nor past the start of the stage behind it
To (optional) | The last day, when it is a range | No | A date not before «From»
The dates are: final result, the two calibration meetings, approval, individual notification, objection window, last day of self-evaluation, close of the qualitative part, and the four milestones.
Add an item to the catalog (dialog «Add an item to the catalog»)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Kind | Which extra part the item belongs to | Yes | «Internal initiatives» or «Contribution to growth»
Item | What the employee can claim (for example a named initiative) | Yes | 3 to 160 characters
Points | How many points the item adds to the extra component when the manager accepts it | Yes | A whole number from 1 to 10. The total of each kind stops at its cap from the evaluation file
Add or change a reminder (dialog «Add a reminder»)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Kind | Who is reminded | Yes | «Employee: self-evaluation», «Manager: an evaluation waiting for them», «Milestones», «Calibration and approval holder»
Days before the last day (employee) | The days before the self-evaluation deadline on which the reminder goes (for example 7, 3, 1) | Yes for the employee kind | Comma separated, each 1 to 30, up to 10 days
Days before the date (milestones) | How many days before each milestone date | Yes for milestones | One number, 1 to 14
Every (days) (manager; calibration and approval holder) | The reminder repeats every N days while the work waits | Yes for these kinds | One number, 1 to 14
Title in Arabic / Text in Arabic | What the person reads | Yes | Title 3 to 120 characters, text 3 to 600
Title in English / Text in English | The English version | No (when empty the Arabic is sent) | Title up to 120, text up to 600
The reminder is on | Switches the reminder on or off | No | On or off; up to 30 reminders in all
Closing the cycle and moving it to the next stage have a confirmation and no input.

Workflow
The cycle is a machine (performance.cycle) with seven stages that move one way: Self-evaluation, Manager's evaluation, Calibration, Approval, Individual notification, Objection window, Closed. It has no timers: a stage never changes by its date. The dates schedule the work and the reminders; a person presses the button that moves it.
Before the cycle: preparation (HR)
1. Upload the evaluation file (Upload the evaluation file (stage templates, grade scale, fiscal card)), review it, save it; fix parts by hand if needed (Add, change and remove the parts of the evaluation file (stages, grade scale, fiscal card)).
2. Add the items of the catalog (Manage the extra-component catalog), prepare the dates and the reminders (Open the evaluation cycle, move it on and change its dates, Add, change and remove the automatic reminders of the evaluation cycle).
3. Check «Readiness to open the cycle» and that someone holds Calibrate the scores of employees and finish calibration and someone Approve the results and decide the objections (a warning only).
The cycle step by step
1. Open (HR, @@perm:performance.cycle_manage@@): press «Open the evaluation cycle and notify employees», confirm the fiscal year. The system takes a snapshot of the templates, keeps the dates, creates an evaluation for every employee whose title has a stage template (someone who joins later gets theirs when they open their page) and notifies each employee.
2. Self-evaluation (employees): each employee rates, writes and sends; their direct manager is notified at the first send. The employee reminder goes on its days before the last day (usually 10 March) until they send.
3. HR moves the cycle on («Move the cycle to the next stage»): managers are notified that the manager's stage began.
4. Manager's evaluation (managers): the direct manager scores and sends; the upper manager is notified at that first send, then reviews, may change and sends. An indirect report cannot be evaluated before the direct manager sent. The manager reminder repeats every N days while evaluations wait.
5. HR moves the cycle on to Calibration. The holder of Calibrate the scores of employees and finish calibration compares the scores and adjusts by half points with a reason, then presses «Finish calibration and send it to approval» (refused while any evaluation has no sent manager score). That press moves the cycle to Approval by the same step HR uses.
6. Approval (holder of @@perm:performance.approve@@): presses «Approve the results and tell everyone individually». The system freezes each final result, sets the last day of objections (five working days, Friday and Saturday off), moves the cycle to Individual notification and notifies the employees: results appear in their page for the first time.
7. Individual notification and objection window: employees read the result and may send one objection. HR may press «Move the cycle to the next stage» to open the Objection window stage (employees are notified); an objection is accepted in either stage until the last day. The approver decides each objection (see the page «Calibration and approval»).
8. Close (HR, @@perm:performance.cycle_close@@): only when no objection is pending. Your name and the time are saved and employees and managers are notified. Evaluations can no longer change.
Status / Stage | Meaning | Who can move it (permission key) | Moves to
Not opened | No cycle, or the last one closed | HR: Open the evaluation cycle, move it on and change its dates (needs a complete evaluation file) | Self-evaluation
Self-evaluation | Employees evaluate themselves | HR: Open the evaluation cycle, move it on and change its dates; employees write with My self-evaluation in the evaluation cycle | Manager's evaluation
Manager's evaluation | Direct, then upper manager score | HR: Open the evaluation cycle, move it on and change its dates; managers write with Evaluate team members and send the evaluation | Calibration
Calibration | Scores compared and adjusted | The calibration holder: Calibrate the scores of employees and finish calibration (finish); HR: Open the evaluation cycle, move it on and change its dates | Approval
Approval | Waiting for the approval of the results | The approval holder: Approve the results and decide the objections (approving moves it on); HR: Open the evaluation cycle, move it on and change its dates | Individual notification
Individual notification | Results are frozen and employees read them; objections open | HR: Open the evaluation cycle, move it on and change its dates | Objection window
Objection window | Objections are decided | HR: Close the evaluation cycle | Closed
Closed | Results stay in each employee's record (final) | — | —
HR may close from any stage with Close the evaluation cycle, but never while an objection is pending.
Automatic things
- Notices at each step: the cycle opened (employees), manager's stage began (managers), individual notification began and objection window opened (employees), closed (employees and managers). A changed date of a running cycle notifies everyone the cycle evaluates and their direct managers. Calibration and approval start without a stage notice: the holders' reminder reaches them.
- Reminders: one daily job at 08:00 Riyadh time, never on Friday or Saturday, never twice in a day, only to people who still have the work, in-app and by e-mail, with the words HR wrote (no names, no course titles): the employee on each of its days before the self-evaluation deadline; the manager every N days in the manager's stage; the managers whose minutes of a milestone are missing, N days before the milestone date; the holders of the calibration key in the calibration stage and of the approval key in the approval stage, every N days. They stop when the cycle closes.
- Frozen things: the templates (a snapshot when the cycle opens) and each employee's result (at approval).
- Audit: opening, moving, closing, date changes, file uploads, reminder and catalog changes are recorded with who and when.
What each person sees: HR sees the whole page; an employee sees only their own evaluation and, only after the individual notification, their result; a manager sees their team in «Team evaluation»; the calibration and approval holder sees everyone on «Calibration and approval». No score is ever shown to an employee before approval and the individual notification. The pages «Calibration and approval» and «Team evaluation» describe the part each one owns.

Business rules
- HR opens the cycle (FR-118), and a cycle cannot open before the evaluation file is complete: a template for each of the five stages, the grade scale and the fiscal-year card. Only one cycle can exist for a fiscal year.
- The cycle takes a snapshot of the templates when it opens, so a past year's evaluation does not change if the file changes later. A change to the file applies to the next cycles.
- Dates can be prepared before the cycle opens. They have usual values for the fiscal year (for example calibration 21 to 24 April, approval 27 April, individual notification 30 April, objection window 3 to 7 May, last self-evaluation day 10 March). The date check refuses a date before the end of the stage ahead of it, past the start of the stage behind it, or an end before the start.
- A date change in a running cycle is recorded in the audit and notifies everyone the cycle evaluates and their direct managers.
- Four milestone dates (short reviews in January and July, pulses in March and September) are edited in the same dates card.
- The cycle moves one way: stages never go back; a close is allowed from any stage.
- Closing is refused while an objection is still under consideration. After closing, evaluations cannot change and results stay in each employee's record.
- Extra component: «Learning» is automatic from the approved learning hours; «Internal initiatives» and «Contribution to growth» come from this year's catalog, each item with points (1 to 10), with a cap per kind taken from the evaluation file. An item name needs at least 3 characters. Deleting an item asks for confirmation because an employee may have picked it.
- Evaluation file checks: results + behaviour must make the basic total; the shares of the results criteria add up to 100; basic + extra make the cap; every stage has criteria and behaviours; every behaviour has a question for the evaluator and a code like B1.1; the grade scale has two to ten levels with clear ranges; the fiscal-year card has twelve months. A file with such a problem is not saved.
- Grade scale: exceptional from 110, exceeds expectations 95 to 109.9, meets expectations 80 to 94.9, needs improvement 65 to 79.9, below expectations under 65 (these are the file's values; HR can edit levels).
- Reminders arrive as an in-app notice and an e-mail, stop once the work is done, are never sent on Friday or Saturday and are sent by one daily job at 08:00 Riyadh time, never twice in a day. The employee's reminder is sent on the chosen days before the last day (1 to 30; for example 7, 3 and 1); the manager's every N days (1 to 14); milestones N days before their date (1 to 14); the calibration and approval holders every N days (1 to 14). Up to 30 reminders.
- AI reading of the file: only by pressing the button, only with an AI service on in the settings, up to 6 per hour per person; you review the result and the texts not found word for word in the file are listed.
- Audit: opening, moving, closing, date changes, file uploads and reminder changes are recorded.

Tips and common problems
- «The cycle cannot open before the evaluation file is uploaded»: read the readiness card to see what is missing.
- «A cycle for this year exists already»: choose the right fiscal year.
- Warning «nobody could calibrate or approve»: ask the platform manager to give one person the calibration and approval keys.
- The action failed: the stage may have changed meanwhile; reload the page.

title: Calibration and approval
text:
«Calibration and approval» is the page where one person compares the scores that managers gave, adjusts them by half points with a written reason, then approves the results, tells every employee individually and decides the objections that employees raise. Employees never see scores before this page's approval and the individual notification.

Who sees it
- View permission: View the «calibration and approval» page, scope: all.
- Who holds it: the platform manager gives it, from the permissions page, to HR (who see the page read only) and to the person who calibrates and approves. Nobody holds it by default except the Administrator; it is not in the head role of units.
- The two working keys Calibrate the scores of employees and finish calibration and Approve the results and decide the objections are meant to be held by one person, appointed by the platform manager from the permissions page. HR sees the page without editing: it can neither calibrate nor approve.
- Administrative permissions that wait for platform admin mode work only while the mode is on.
- Menu: the group «Career file», item «Calibration and approval».

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Open the page, search and filter | Two tabs: «Calibration» and «Approval and objections»; the distribution chart of levels; the table; search by employee name; filters: level, career stage, score adjusted | View the «calibration and approval» page
Open a row | A details window with the breakdown of the score | View the «calibration and approval» page
Adjust the score (sliders icon) | Opens «Calibration adjustment»: adjustment in points and a reason; shows the score after calibration | Calibrate the scores of employees and finish calibration
Finish calibration and send it to approval | Moves the cycle to the approval stage; scores can no longer be adjusted | Calibrate the scores of employees and finish calibration
Approve the results and tell everyone individually | Freezes each employee's final result, notifies them and starts the objection window | Approve the results and decide the objections
Accept an objection and return it to the manager | The evaluation goes back to the manager | Approve the results and decide the objections
Reject an objection | Rejects it with a reason the employee reads | Approve the results and decide the objections
Approve the revised evaluation | Approves the evaluation the manager redid after an accepted objection | Approve the results and decide the objections
Export the list | Downloads the calibration list | Export the calibration and approval list
A button without its key is hidden; a button whose stage is not on is dimmed and explains («Available in the calibration stage only», «Available in the approval stage only»).

How to
Calibrate scores
1. Open the page in the calibration stage. The notice bar «you can calibrate the employees' scores before the deadline» leads you here.
2. Look at «Distribution of the levels» and the table: employee, title, direct manager, manager's score, adjustment, score after calibration and level.
3. For a score to adjust, press the sliders icon of the row. Enter the adjustment (from −10 to +10 in steps of 0.5) and the reason (at least 5 characters), then «Save».
4. If a line shows «Waiting for the manager», that employee's manager has not sent the evaluation yet; calibration cannot be finished before.
5. Press «Finish calibration and send it to approval» and confirm.
Approve and tell everyone
1. Open the tab «Approval and objections» in the approval stage.
2. Check the distribution and the table of scores.
3. Press «Approve the results and tell everyone individually» and confirm: «Each employee's final result is frozen and they are told; the objection window (five working days) begins.»
Decide an objection
1. In «Objections» read the employee, the item, the reason and the state.
2. Press «Accept and return to the manager» (the manager redoes the evaluation and sends it again), or «Reject», write the reason (at least 10 characters) and confirm.
3. After the manager sends the revised evaluation, press «Approve the revised evaluation». That score is then final.
4. When every objection is decided, HR closes the cycle from the evaluation cycle page.

Fields (form inputs)
Calibration adjustment (dialog «Calibration adjustment: <employee>», sliders icon on a row)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Adjustment (points) | How many points to add to (or take from) the manager's score so that scores are fair between managers. The dialog shows «Manager's score» and, live, «Score after calibration» | Yes (zero means no adjustment) | From −10 to +10 in half-point steps («Enter a multiple of 0.5 between −10 and +10.»). Score after calibration = manager's score + adjustment, never below 0 and never above the cap of the stage
Reason | Why you adjusted; the employee sees it after the notification | Yes for any adjustment other than zero (setting zero clears it) | From 5 to 500 characters («Write the reason (at least 5 characters).»)
Reject an objection (dialog «Reject the objection of <employee>»)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Reason for rejecting | Why the objection is refused; the employee reads it in their result | Yes | From 10 to 1,000 characters
Accepting an objection and approving the revised evaluation are buttons with no input.
Search and filters of the calibration table
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Search the calibration | By employee name | No | Up to 100 characters
Level | Narrows by the level of the score after calibration | No | A level of the grade scale
Career stage | Narrows by the development stage of the employee | No | Stage 1 to 5
Score adjusted | Only the scores you changed, or only those you did not | No | Yes or No

Workflow
This page owns three parts of the cycle (the whole cycle is in the page «Evaluation cycle»): calibration, approval and the decision on objections.
A. Calibration
1. HR moves the cycle to the calibration stage. The holder of Calibrate the scores of employees and finish calibration opens the page: the table shows, for each employee, the manager's score (the upper manager's sent score, else the direct manager's), the adjustment, the score after calibration and the level, with the chart of the distribution of the levels.
2. For each score to adjust, the holder presses the sliders icon, enters the adjustment and a reason, and saves. A row «Waiting for the manager» has no sent evaluation yet.
3. When every evaluation has a sent manager score, the holder presses «Finish calibration and send it to approval» and confirms. The cycle moves to Approval and scores can no longer be adjusted.
B. Approval
1. In the approval stage the holder of Approve the results and decide the objections opens the tab «Approval and objections», checks the distribution and the scores.
2. The holder presses «Approve the results and tell everyone individually» and confirms. Each final result is frozen (final score, level, breakdown, adjustment and its reason), the last day of objections is set (five working days from the notification) and the cycle moves to Individual notification.
3. Every employee is notified and sees their result for the first time. HR may then open the «Objection window» stage.
C. Objections
1. The employee raises one objection on one item. The approvers are notified («A new objection to an evaluation result»).
2. The approver reads the employee, the item and the reason, and chooses: Reject (with a reason of 10 characters or more), or Accept and return to the manager.
3. If accepted: the evaluation goes back to the direct manager as a draft (and the upper manager's too), the calibration adjustment of that employee is removed, and the employee and the direct manager are notified. The direct manager revises and sends; then the upper manager reviews and sends again.
4. The approver presses Approve the revised evaluation: the result is recomputed from the managers' new scores, replaces the old one and the employee is notified. It is final.
5. When no objection is pending, HR closes the cycle.
Status / Stage | Meaning | Who can move it (permission key) | Moves to
Calibration stage | Scores can be adjusted | Calibrate the scores of employees and finish calibration (adjust, finish) | Approval
Approval stage | The results wait for approval | Approve the results and decide the objections (approve) | Individual notification
Objection: With the approver | The employee raised it; waiting for a decision | Approve the results and decide the objections (accept or reject) | Back with the manager, or Rejected
Objection: Back with the manager | Accepted; the manager redoes the evaluation | The managers: Evaluate team members and send the evaluation (revise and send, then the upper manager reviews) | Waiting for the revised evaluation to be approved
Objection: Waiting for the revised evaluation to be approved | Both managers sent again | Approve the results and decide the objections (approve the revised evaluation) | Revised evaluation approved
Objection: Revised evaluation approved | The new result is final | — | —
Objection: Rejected | Refused with a reason (final) | — | —
Automatic things
- Notices: all employees on approval; the approvers on a new objection; the employee on each decision on their objection; the direct manager when an evaluation comes back; the holders' reminder every N days in the calibration and approval stages (set in «Evaluation cycle»).
- Window: an objection is refused after the last day (checked at the moment of the request, no job); Friday and Saturday are not counted.
- Audit: every adjustment (score before and after, without the reason text), the finishing of calibration, the approval, each objection and each decision are recorded.
What each person sees: the holder of the keys sees all employees (scope all); HR with only the view key sees the page read only; an employee never sees this page, only their own result and the state of their objection; the direct manager sees an evaluation again only when it comes back to them.

Business rules
- Score shown for calibration (FR-122): the upper manager's sent score if there is one, otherwise the direct manager's. Only evaluations that the direct manager sent are calibrated.
- Adjustment: from −10 to +10 in half-point steps; a written reason of at least 5 characters is required for any non-zero adjustment (setting it back to zero clears the reason). Score after calibration = manager's score + adjustment, never below 0 and never above the cap of the stage, rounded to one decimal. It is allowed only in the calibration stage and only for the calibration key holder; every change is recorded in the audit (score before and after, without the reason text), and the employee sees the adjustment and its reason after notification.
- Finishing calibration needs every evaluation sent by its direct manager, and moves the cycle through the same step HR uses.
- Approval works only in the approval stage. It freezes the result of each employee (final score, level, breakdown, adjustment and reason) and notifies each one individually. The employee's own page carries no score before that notification; the answer itself omits it.
- Objection window (FR-123): five working days from the notification (Friday and Saturday are off). After the last day a new objection is refused.
- One objection per employee, on one item (a results criterion, a behaviour or the extra component), with a reason of at least 10 characters. States: with the approver, back with the manager, waiting for the revised evaluation to be approved, revised evaluation approved, rejected.
- After an accepted objection the direct manager redoes the evaluation, then the upper manager reviews, then the approver approves the revised evaluation; rejecting an objection needs a reason, and the approval becomes final.
- The cycle cannot be closed while an objection is still open or being redone.
- The approver is notified of a new objection, and the bar of the page tells the key holders when the calibration or approval deadline is near.
- The grade scale, the levels and the formula of the score are explained in the page «Evaluation cycle»: basic (results and behaviour by the weights of the stage) plus learning, initiatives and growth, up to the cap of the stage.

Tips and common problems
- You cannot edit as HR: HR sees the page read only; the keys to calibrate and approve belong to one appointed person.
- «Could not save»: check that the calibration stage is on and the employee's manager has sent the evaluation.
- The adjustment is refused: it must be a multiple of 0.5 between −10 and +10 and have a reason.

title: Team evaluation
text:
«Team evaluation» is the manager's page in the evaluation cycle. You evaluate the members of your team in the manager's stage: the direct manager first, then the upper manager reviews and may change it. For each person you enter the results scores and rate the behaviours, and you see the final score live. A button on each row records the minutes of the milestones of the year.

Who sees it
- View permission: View the «team evaluation» page, scopes: unit and below, all. The default scope is unit and below.
- Default roles: the head role of every unit holds the view, evaluate and export keys at «unit and below», and also the milestone keys. The Employee role does not hold them.
- It does not need platform admin mode.
- Menu: the group «Career file», item «Team evaluation». People outside your unit and below do not exist for you: the system answers as if the record was not found.
- Before the cycle opens the page says «The evaluation cycle is not open yet».

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Open the page, search and filter | The stage stepper, the chain note, the notices, and the team table; search by employee name; filters: scope («Everyone below me, all levels» or «Direct reports only») and evaluation status («Waiting for your evaluation», «Evaluated») | View the «team evaluation» page
Evaluate / View (pencil or eye icon, or a click on the row) | Opens the evaluation window of the employee; after the manager's stage it is read only | View the «team evaluation» page
Save a draft, send the evaluation, save a change | Saves what you entered, or sends the evaluation to the next step | Evaluate team members and send the evaluation
Milestones (calendar icon) | Opens the milestones of the member; record or edit the minutes of a milestone | View the team's milestones and their minutes and Record the minutes of a milestone for a team member
Export the list | Downloads the team evaluation list | Export the «team evaluation» list

How to
Evaluate a team member
1. Open Team evaluation. The banner says how many of your team are waiting for your evaluation, and the notice box says for example «<name> sent their self-evaluation and is waiting for your review»; the name opens the evaluation.
2. Press «Evaluate» on the row (or click the row). If the button is dimmed, click it to read the reason.
3. Read the note on top: the employee's self-evaluation, if sent, is shown under each behaviour and does not bind you.
4. Results: enter a score from 0 to 100 for each criterion (each criterion shows its share).
5. Behaviours: choose a level for each behaviour (Always, Often, Sometimes, Rarely, Never) and write the note; the note is required at «Always», «Rarely» and «Never».
6. Extra component: «Learning» is automatic; tick the catalog items the employee claimed that you accept.
7. Watch the live card of the final score. Press «Save draft», then «Send the evaluation». If you are the direct manager, the evaluation then goes to the upper manager, then calibration.
Review as the upper manager
1. Wait until the direct manager has sent the evaluation (otherwise the button explains «Waiting for the review of <manager> (their direct manager) first»).
2. Open the evaluation of the direct manager, review it and change it if needed, then send it. The scores then go to calibration.
Record the minutes of a milestone
1. Press the calendar icon of the member and choose the milestone.
2. For a short review answer «Where are we?», «What is in the way?» and The agreed action (required, at least 5 characters). For a pulse write a short note.
3. Press «Save the minutes». The employee is told and acknowledges reading them.

What the employee sees (their own page)
- Before the manager's stage ends the employee's evaluation is «under review»: no scores are shown before the individual notification after approval (FR-119).
- In the self-evaluation stage the employee presses «Start the self-evaluation», rates the behaviours in the same five levels, writes achievements for each results criterion (without a score) and picks catalog items. They can change it until their manager starts.
- Milestones appear in the employee's tab «Milestones» with a button «I read the minutes».

Fields (form inputs)
Evaluation of a team member (window «Evaluation of <employee>», button «Evaluate»)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Results: a score for each criterion (from 0 to 100) | How well the employee met each results criterion of their development stage. Each criterion shows its share; the results score is the weighted average, and the results weight of the stage decides how much of the basic score it is worth | Yes to send (a draft may leave it empty) | A number from 0 to 100 («Enter a number from 0 to 100.»)
Your rating (for each behaviour) | How often the employee showed the behaviour. The average of the behaviours, times the behaviour weight of the stage, is the other half of the basic score. The employee's own rating, if sent, is shown beside it and does not bind you | Yes to send | «Always» (100), «Often» (75), «Sometimes» (50), «Rarely» (25), «Never» (0)
Note (for each behaviour) | The reason for the rating, with an example | Yes at «Always», «Rarely» and «Never»; optional at the other levels | At least 5 characters when required, up to 500
Extra component: internal initiatives and contribution to growth (tick the items the employee claimed) | The items of this year's catalog that you accept. Each adds its points, up to the cap of its kind | No | Only items of the catalog of the open cycle and of the right kind; up to 30 each
Learning (not typed) | Calculated by the system from the approved learning hours against the hours of the stage, up to 10 points | — | Automatic
The card «Live final score» shows results, behaviour, basic, learning, initiatives, growth and the final score out of the cap, as you type. The buttons are «Save draft», «Send the evaluation» and, after sending, «Save the change». «Send the evaluation» stays off while a field is invalid.
Minutes of a milestone (window «Minutes: <employee>», calendar icon)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Where are we? (short review) | Where the employee stands now | No | Up to 1,000 characters
What is in the way? (short review) | The obstacles | No | Up to 1,000 characters
The agreed action (short review) | What you and the employee agreed to do | Yes for a short review | At least 5 characters, up to 1,000
Short note (pulse) | A brief note of the pulse | Yes for a pulse | Up to 1,000 characters
The minutes carry no scores. «Save the minutes» tells the employee, who then ticks «I read the minutes».
Search and filters of the team table
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Search the team | By employee name | No | Up to 100 characters
Scope | Everyone below you, or only your direct reports | No | «Everyone below me, all levels» (default) or «Direct reports only»
