Instructions for the sender (Arabic) / (English) | Formatted text (bold, italic, underline, lists, links) the sender reads above the fields when sending a ticket of this type, telling them what to include. | No | Up to 5000 characters each; no images.
Own duration in working days | The usual time for this type only; it pre-fills the sender's date. Empty uses the unit's usual completion time. | No | 1 to 60 whole days.
Personal type: the unit manager does not see it, only the sender and the assignee | Makes every ticket of this type private to its sender and its assignee. | No | Tick box. Needs an assignee, and the unit must accept personal requests.
Active type | An inactive type is no longer offered to senders; its old tickets stay. | No | Tick box, on by default.

Workflow
How a unit becomes a ticket desk
1. The unit leader turns on platform admin mode and opens Ticket setup, then chooses the unit. A unit that was never set up shows the defaults (reception stopped, durations 3 / 0 / 4 / 7 / 14).
2. In the organization structure someone sets the unit's manager (not on this page); a unit without a manager cannot be activated.
3. In Settings the leader sets reception to «Active», writes the description and the durations, and presses Save. The settings are stored and the change is recorded in the audit log.
4. In Types the leader adds the kinds of request, each with its handlers, instructions and optional own duration, and presses Save.
5. From now on employees see the unit when they press New ticket: it is listed if reception is Active (or Paused, disabled), its start date has come, and it has at least one active type. The ticket workflow then follows the Tickets page.
6. When the leader changes the settings later, new tickets use the new values, and the stale-ticket limit applies at once to open tickets; changing a type's handlers affects new tickets, and also open personal tickets whose old assignee is no longer active (the manager is told how many moved, never which).
Status (reception) | Meaning | Who can move it (permission key) | Moves to
Active | The unit is listed and receives tickets | The unit leader: Edit a unit's reception and durations (needs a manager) | Paused for now; Stopped
Paused for now | Listed but disabled with a message; resumed by hand | The unit leader: Edit a unit's reception and durations | Active; Stopped
Stopped | Not listed for anyone (the starting state of a new unit) | The unit leader: Edit a unit's reception and durations | Active; Paused for now
Type | Meaning | Who can move it (permission key) | Moves to
Active | Offered to senders | Edit a ticket type | Inactive (untick «Active type»)
Inactive | Hidden from senders; its tickets stay | Edit a ticket type, or Delete a ticket type on a type that has tickets | Active
Deleted | Removed (only when no ticket uses it) | Delete a ticket type | none
Automatic things
- The settings drive the automatic parts of the ticket workflow: automatic closing, the stale reminder, the reopen window, the needed-by date and the first-response clock.
- Reception rules are checked at the moment of sending: paused, not started or no manager refuses the ticket with a clear message.
- Deleting a type that has tickets only deactivates it, and the message says so.
- A unit that takes tickets (active or paused) or has open tickets cannot be moved or deleted in the organization structure.
- Every change of settings and every type added, edited or removed is recorded in the audit log.
What each person sees
- The unit leader (head role at «unit and below») sees and sets up their unit and every unit below it, in platform admin mode.
- A company-wide or platform administrator sees the units inside the scope of their keys (all units at «all»).
- Employees and senders never see this page; they only see the result: the unit, its description, the types and the usual time in the «New ticket» window.

Business rules
- Reception status: Active (the unit appears and receives tickets), Paused (appears disabled with a message), Stopped (not shown to anyone). A unit with no manager cannot be activated. (FR-36)
- Nothing is accepted before the unit's start date.
- Durations (all whole numbers of days, each with its limits shown on screen) (FR-36, FR-41):
  - the usual completion time, in working days (Friday and Saturday are off); default 3
  - the earliest date a sender may ask for, in working days, default 0
  - automatic close after a close request, in calendar days, default 4
  - the time allowed to reopen a closed ticket, in calendar days, default 7
  - a ticket counts as stale after, in calendar days, default 14
- A type has a name, a description, instructions for the sender, one or more handlers (from the unit manager and the employees of the unit and the units below it; with several, the ticket is unassigned until the first one replies), an optional special duration and a flag for personal. If the type has no handlers, the unit manager handles its tickets (a type with several handlers is not «no handler»: its tickets wait for the first handler's reply).
- Personal types are invisible to the unit manager and to platform administrators; they need an active assignee. (FR-38)
- Deleting a type: if tickets already use it, it is only deactivated and keeps its tickets; otherwise it is deleted. The message tells you which happened.
- A unit that takes tickets (active or paused) or has open tickets cannot be moved or deleted in the organization structure.
- The unit manager is chosen in the organization structure, not on this page.
- Changes are recorded in the audit log.

Tips / common problems
- «This page works in platform admin mode»: turn the mode on from the top of the page.
- «Active» is refused: the unit has no manager yet. Click «Assign the unit manager in the structure» under the field, set the manager on the leaders tab, then come back and activate. (FR-182)
- A sender says the unit is not offered: check that reception is Active, the start date has come, and the unit has at least one active type.

title: Ticket figures
text:
The figures page shows how the ticket desks performed over the last 30 days: how many tickets are open, how many arrived, how fast they were answered and solved, how they ended, and what needs action today. It shows counts only.

Who sees it
- View permission: View the ticket figures page («View the ticket figures page»). Scopes: own (the units you lead and every unit below), unit, unit and below, company, all.
- Needs platform admin mode: yes.
- Default roles: the head role of every unit holds it at «unit and below». A platform administrator sees every unit.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Choose a unit | Shows that unit only; «All units» adds them up | View the ticket figures page
Read the indicators and tables | Counts and averages of the last 30 days | View the ticket figures page
The page is for reading. It has no buttons that change data, and no export or import.

How to
Read the figures of one unit
1. Turn on platform admin mode and open Ticket figures.
2. At the top choose the unit. The list holds every unit of the organization structure you may see, even those not set up for tickets (their numbers are zero).
3. Read the blocks from top to bottom.
See everything together
1. Choose «All units».
2. The figures are added up and the tables get a «Unit» column.

Fields (form inputs)
This page has no create or edit form. It has one filter.
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Unit | Chooses whose figures you read: one unit, or every unit you may see added together. | No (default «All units») | «All units» or one unit of the organization structure inside your scope, including units not yet set up for tickets (their numbers are zero). With one unit the figures are that unit's; with «All units» they are the sum and the tables get a «Unit» column.

Workflow
The page does not hold a record that moves through statuses. It reads the tickets that the other two pages produce, as follows.
1. Units are set up on the Ticket setup page and employees send and close tickets (see Tickets).
2. You open the page (platform admin mode, View the ticket figures page) and choose the unit. The system counts the tickets of the chosen units for the last 30 days.
3. What each number counts:
Block | What it counts
Open now | Tickets not closed right now
Incoming tickets | Tickets that arrived in the period (with «of which N personal»)
Average time to first reply | Hours from arrival to the first answer from the unit's side
Average time to finish | Hours from arrival to closing
How tickets ended | Closed by the sender's confirmation, closed automatically, closed without being carried out, reopened after closing
By ticket type | Tickets of each type
Who handles the tickets | For each person: open, closed, average time to first reply
Needs action today | Not-closed tickets whose needed-by date has passed, or open ones quiet longer than the unit's stale days; up to 50, earliest needed-by first; personal tickets are never listed
1. A person decides what to do: for «Needs action today» the leader opens the ticket and follows up with the handler.
There is nothing to approve, no status to move, no automatic timer and no notification on this page. The figures change as the tickets change, and the audit log of the tickets records what produced them.
What each person sees
- The unit leader sees the figures of their unit and every unit below it.
- A company-wide or platform administrator sees every unit inside their scope («All units» for scope «all»).
- Requesters and handlers without the key do not see the page. Personal tickets are counted for the unit leader but their content never appears.

Business rules
- The period is the last 30 days. (FR-40)
- Indicators: Open now; Incoming tickets (with «of which N personal»); Average time to first reply; Average completion time, in hours.
- How tickets ended: closed by the sender's confirmation; closed automatically; closed without execution; reopened after closing.
- By ticket type: the count of tickets of each type.
- Ticket assignees: for each person, open tickets, closed tickets and average time to first reply.
- What needs action today: tickets that are overdue or stale; if there are none the page says «Nothing overdue or stale.»
- Personal tickets are counted in the totals but never appear in a list, so their content stays private. (FR-40)
- With one unit the figures are that unit only; with «All units» they are the sum of the units you may see.
- A unit you lead covers the units below it as well.

Tips / common problems
- «No unit is set up yet»: set up a unit on the Ticket setup page and its numbers will appear here.
- The numbers look low: only the last 30 days are counted.
- A person does not appear under assignees: no ticket of the period was assigned to them.

title: My notices
text:
Every notice and policy that reached you from human resources and corporate communications is here. A notice appears on its publishing day; a policy stays in the «Waiting for my acknowledgement» tab until you acknowledge it, and no extra reminder is sent. The sidebar shows a yellow count of what waits for you, and the home page has number tiles and the pinned notice.

Who sees it
- View permission: View the notices that reached me at scope «own»: you see only what reached you. A notice that did not reach you is shown as «not found».
- Default roles: the Employee role holds view, acknowledge and export of your list.
- No platform admin mode is needed.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Read a notice | Click the row or the eye icon to open the reading window | View the notices that reached me
Acknowledge a policy | Tick «I have read the policy…» after reaching the end of the text, then «Acknowledge» | Acknowledge a policy
Export my list | The rows on screen or all results, with the columns you choose | Export my notices
There is no import: a notice is written and approved, not made from a file. A session «signed in as an employee» can read but never acknowledges for the employee.

How to
Acknowledge a policy
1. Open the Waiting for my acknowledgement tab and click Read and acknowledge.
2. Read to the end; the box stays off with «Read the notice first» under it until the last of the text comes into view.
3. Tick the box and click Acknowledge. «Your acknowledgement is recorded. Thank you.» appears and the policy moves to «Acknowledged». Later closes the window without acknowledging.
An announcement: open it and click Read; no acknowledgement is needed.
A new version: if the publisher edits a policy you acknowledged, it returns to «Waiting for me» with the badge «Waiting for your acknowledgement of the new version».
Search and filter: search by title or text; filter by channel, type, my status, publish date (from and to) and pinned only; switch between table and cards (a notice card shows its type, channel, date, my status and a «Read» or «Read and acknowledge» button). The number waiting for your acknowledgement is a badge on the «Waiting for me» tab.

Business rules
- The text never changes after publishing; an edit is a new version that goes back for approval, and whoever acknowledged the old one is asked again.
- An archived notice shows «This notice is no longer in force» with no acknowledgement.
- Whoever joins the audience after publishing receives the notice the next night.
- A warning bar under the top bar shows on every page while a notice waits for your acknowledgement, with the count and an «Open my notices» button; it disappears once you acknowledge everything and is not drawn on the notices pages themselves.

title: Manage notices
text:
The page of the publisher and the unit leader: the writer writes a notice and sends it for approval, follows its publishing, and sees who acknowledged and who did not. No notice is published before the leader of the writer's unit approves it.

Who sees it
- View permission: View the notices management page and notice details. A writer sees the notices of their channel (scope «own»), a unit leader what the unit's people wrote and below, a platform administrator everything. Anything outside is shown as «not found».
- Default roles: the «Notice writer» role of each channel (given when the writer is added in «Publishing channels») and the head role of each unit.
- No platform admin mode is needed.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
New notice | The writing window: channel, publish date, type, title, text, audience, attachments | Write a new notice
Edit | Edit your draft or a rejected notice | Edit a draft or a rejected notice
Send for approval | Goes to your unit leader once the fields are complete | Send a notice for approval
Delete | Deletes a draft after a confirmation | Delete a draft
Pin / unpin | One published notice shows on everyone's home page | Pin a notice on the home page or unpin it
Archive | The notice leaves «My notices»; the acknowledgement report stays | Archive a notice
Edit as a new version | The published notice is hidden from employees until the leader approves the new version | Change a published notice with a new version
Cancel the edit and bring back the old version | The published version is visible at once and your edit is deleted | Cancel the change and bring back the published version
Acknowledgements tab | Who got it, who acknowledged, who did not | See who acknowledged and who did not
Export acknowledgements | Exports the list | Export the list of acknowledgements
Export the notices list | The rows or all results | Export the notices management and approval lists
There is no import: a notice is written and approved, not made from a file. A row's icons depend on the notice's state and your keys.

How to
Write a notice
1. Click New notice. Choose the channel (only yours are listed), the publish date (today or later) and the type: announcement or policy to acknowledge.
2. Write the Arabic title (the English one fills in automatically) and the text.
3. Choose the audience: all employees, or units (and below), titles and groups; every active unit, every job title and every group of people is offered to any writer whatever their other permissions (with search by name); «Reaches N employees» shows.
4. Attach up to 5 files, then Save as draft or Send for approval (off until the fields are complete, with the reason beside it).
Edit a published notice: click the «Edit as a new version» icon and confirm; the notice is hidden from employees, then edit and send. To go back, click «Cancel the edit and bring back the old version».
Follow a notice: click the row to open the details: text, approval (a timeline with names, dates and the rejection reason), audience, acknowledgements.

Business rules
- A writer does not approve their own notice; it goes to the leader of the unit above, or to a platform administrator when there is none.
- A rejected notice returns as a draft with a required reason; for a new version the published one stays hidden until it is edited and approved or the edit is cancelled.
- No extra reminder: the only notification is at publishing, in batches for a large audience.
- The platform administrator sees every active channel when writing a new notice and may write in all of them without being added as a writer; everybody else writes only in the channels they were added to.

title: Waiting for my approval
text:
The notices written by the people of your unit and below and sent for your approval. You review the text, the audience and the publish date as they are, then approve or reject. They are not published before you approve.

Who sees it
- View permission: View the page of notices waiting for my approval at scope «unit and below». A count shows beside it in the sidebar.
- Default roles: the head role of each unit.
- Anything outside your scope is shown as «not found».

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
View | Opens the notice details (a side-by-side comparison for a new version) | View the page of notices waiting for my approval
Approve | After a confirmation: «It will be published on {date} to N employees» (a new version at once) | Approve a notice
Reject | With a required reason of five characters that goes back to the writer | Reject a notice with a reason
Export | The rows or all results | Export the notices management and approval lists
There is no import: a notice is not made from a file.

How to
1. Open the page; each row shows the title, type (and a «Version 2» badge for edits), writer and unit, when it was sent, publish date and audience.
2. Click the row to read the details.
3. Click Approve and confirm, or Reject and write the reason (the button stays off until five characters).

Business rules
- You do not approve a notice you wrote: it goes to the leader of the unit above.
- Approving or rejecting a notice whose state changed before you shows an error and does nothing.
- Search by title or writer; filter by channel, type, writer and sent date.

title: Publishing channels
text:
Any unit of the organization structure can have publishing channels, and each channel has its writers. Making a channel sets up its writers' permissions automatically, adding a writer gives them at once the permissions to write in their channel only, with no new sign-in, and removing them takes the permissions back. The batch publishing settings are set here.

Who sees it
- View permission: View the publishing channels page. You see every channel whose unit your keys reach: Add a writer to the channel of a unit and Remove a writer from the channel of a unit (writers), Create a publishing channel for a unit and rename it and Disable, enable and delete a publishing channel (channels).
- A unit leader holds the four keys at scope «unit and below» automatically through the unit-head role: they manage the channels of their unit and below and see all their writers. Whoever is granted a key at a wider scope from the permissions page manages them in every unit, as does a platform administrator. A channel of no unit (company-wide) is managed by a platform administrator only.
- No platform admin mode is needed.

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Add a channel | Makes a channel for a unit (two names and a unit); its writers' role is made automatically | Create a publishing channel for a unit and rename it
Rename a channel | Changes its name and the name of its writers' role; the unit stays | Create a publishing channel for a unit and rename it
Disable or enable a channel | A disabled channel takes no new notice and its writers lose their permissions, keeping their membership and its notices; enabling brings them back | Disable, enable and delete a publishing channel
Delete a channel | Only a channel that never had a notice; its role goes with it | Disable, enable and delete a publishing channel
Add a writer | Adds an employee and gives them the channel's writer role | Add a writer to the channel of a unit
Remove a writer | Takes the role back; their drafts stay | Remove a writer from the channel of a unit
Batch size and gap | Saves the batch publishing settings | Edit the batch publishing settings
Export | Exports the list of channels and the writers of a channel | Export the list of channel writers
There is no import: a channel is made from a window that checks the name and the unit, and a writer is added from a list that checks the employee.

How to
Add a channel
1. Click Add a channel.
2. Type its name in Arabic and in English (up to 90 characters; a name is never repeated).
3. Pick the unit from the list (only the units your key reaches). The unit cannot change after the channel is made.
4. Click Add the channel.
A channel's writers: click the channel's row (or the writers icon) to open its writers.
Add a writer
1. In the channel's writers window click Add a writer.
2. Type the first letter of the employee's name and pick them from the list (their title and unit show). Add the writer stays off until you pick from the list.
3. If a notice says they have no leader above, a platform administrator will approve their notices. Click Add the writer.
Remove a writer: the remove icon on their row, then a confirmation that says how many drafts and notices waiting for approval they have.
Disable or delete a channel: from the icons of its row, after a confirmation that says how many writers it has. The delete icon is off for a channel that has notices (disable it instead).
Batch publishing: change the batch size (1–5000) and the gap (1–60 minutes); a line shows «An audience of N employees gets the notice in X batches over Y minutes».
Search and filters: search by the channel's name (Arabic or English) or its unit, filter by unit and by state (active or disabled), and switch between table and cards.

Business rules
- A writer writes only in their channel and does not approve their own notice, and nobody writes in a disabled channel.
- The writer and channel keys are checked against the channel's unit, so a unit head neither sees nor changes another unit's channel («not found»). The people to add as writers are the employees within your key's scope.
- The first two channels (human resources and corporate communications) are ordinary channels tied to their units.

title: Roles and permissions
text:
What this page is
A role is a set of permissions given to everyone who holds it. On this page you see all the roles of the platform, how each one is given (by hand or automatically) and how many people hold it. You can create a new role or change the permissions of an existing one. Each permission inside a role has a scope that decides which records it covers. The page has two tabs: «Roles» and «Exceptions».

Who sees it
Item | Detail
View key | View the roles and permissions page for the Roles tab, and View the exceptions page (what was given outside the job title) for the Exceptions tab
Default scope | All
Platform admin mode | Required. The page appears in the menu only after you turn it on; if you open it without the mode, a message asks you to turn it on
Default roles that hold it | The built-in «System Admin» role holds every key of the platform at the «All» scope. The «Employee» role, the unit head roles and the job title roles do not hold the keys of this page. The other administrative roles (for example «Platform manager», «Platform configurator», «Platform auditor») start with no permissions, and an administrator gives them what is needed on the Permissions page
If you do not hold the key of a tab, the tab does not show. If you hold none, you see «You have no permission on any tab here.»

What you can do (Roles tab)
Action | What happens | Permission
«New role» | Opens a window to create a role with Arabic and English names, a description and its permissions | Add a role
Open a role (click the row or the edit icon) | Opens the edit window: names, description, assignment and the permission matrix | Edit a role and its permissions
Delete icon | Deletes the role after you confirm; its holders lose its permissions at once | Delete a role
«Refresh members now» | Recalculates the members of the automatic roles right away and shows how many changes were made | Refresh the members of the automatic roles now
Export button | Exports the list of roles to a file after you choose the scope, the columns and the file type | Export roles
Search, filters, table/cards switch | Narrow the list by name, description, or unit and company. Filters: type (built-in/custom), assignment, kind, company, has holders | No extra key
The add button and the row actions do not show to people without the matching keys. The delete icon never shows on built-in roles, nor on job title and unit head roles.
List columns: name, number of permissions, unit and company (for job title roles), number of users, assignment (automatic/manual), kind, and a «Built-in» badge.

Kinds of roles
Kind | Who holds it | How it is managed
Manual | Whoever HR or a manager gives it to | From the employee form or the Permissions page
Automatic (rule) | «Employee»: everyone added to the platform. «Direct manager»: everyone who has people reporting to them. «Collaborator base»: people whose relation type has limited access | The rule refreshes the members after every change to employees and every night
Job title | Everyone who holds the title | The role is created with the title, carries its name and is removed with it
Unit head | The manager/leader of the unit | Created with the unit as «Head of {unit}» and starts with the default head permissions

How to
Create a role
1. Open «Roles & permissions» (after turning on platform admin mode) and press «New role».
2. Type the Arabic name; the English name is filled in automatically and you can edit it. Both names are required (at least two characters).
3. Add a short description and choose the assignment (manual or automatic).
4. Tick the permissions needed, choose the scope of each, then press «Save».
Change the permissions of a role
1. Click the role's row.
2. Use «Search permissions» to find a permission by its name or key.
3. Tick or untick the permission and change its scope in the list beside it. «Select all permissions» and «Clear all» save time.
4. Beside «Edit employees» there is a «Fields they may change» button to choose which fields of the employee record its holder may change.
5. Press «Save».
Refresh the automatic roles at once
1. Press «Refresh members now».
2. A message shows the number of changes, or «Members are up to date, nothing changed».

Fields (form inputs)
The role window («New role» / «Edit role», needs Add a role or Edit a role and its permissions)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Arabic name | The name people see in Arabic on roles lists and employee forms | Yes | 2 to 120 characters. Locked for job title and unit head roles, whose names follow their title or unit
English name | The same name in English | Yes | 2 to 120 characters. Filled in automatically from the Arabic name while you type, and you can edit it. Locked for job title and unit head roles
Description | A short sentence on what the role is for, so the next administrator understands it | No | Up to 500 characters
Assignment | How the role is given: Manual (HR or an administrator gives it to people) or Automatic (a rule or a setup in the system gives it) | No (a new role starts as Manual) | Manual, Automatic. Locked when the role already has a rule (a rule role cannot become manual)
Search permissions | Finds a permission in the matrix by its name or key | No | Free text
Permission tick box | Whether the role holds that permission. Every page has a «view» key and every button its own key | No | Up to 500 permissions per role. «Select all permissions» / «Clear all» act on the visible list
Scope (beside each ticked permission) | How far the permission reaches: which records it covers | Yes, for each ticked permission | Only the scopes that permission allows: Own record only, Their unit, Their unit and 1 to 5 levels below, Their unit and below, Their whole company, All companies. You cannot choose a scope wider than your own
«Fields they may change (N)» (only beside «Edit employees») | Opens a window to choose which fields of the employee record the holder may change | No | See the next table
The window «The fields a holder of «Edit employees» may change»
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Search the fields | Finds a field by name | No | Free text
Field tick boxes, grouped | Each ticked field may be changed by the holder | No | Groups: Personal details, Contact, Work, Identity and name, Contract and insurance, Pay and account, Notes, Structure and relation. A summary says «may change N of M fields»
Basic / All / None | Shortcuts for the whole list | No | «Basic» is the contact and personal data and is where a new permission starts
Select all / Clear all (per group) | Ticks or clears one group | No | You cannot add a field you cannot change yourself. Unit, job title and manager also need «Change placement from a date»
Roles list toolbar
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Search roles | Finds roles by name or description | No | Free text
Filters | Narrow the list | No | Type (built-in / custom), Assignment, Kind, Company, Has holders / No holders
Scope (in the «Export data» window) | How many rows go into the file | Yes | «The rows shown on this page (N)» or «All results of the current search and filters (N)»; a single export holds a limited number of rows and the window says when it caps
Columns | Which columns to put in the file | Yes, at least one | «Select all» / «Clear selection»; the window shows «N of M columns»
File type | The format of the file | Yes | Excel (.xlsx) or CSV (.csv)
The window «End date of the exception» (Exceptions tab, «Change the end date», needs Change the end date of an exception)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
End date | The last day the exception holds. After it, it is taken back by itself | No (empty or «Remove the end date» means no end date) | A date that is today or later (Riyadh time); a date in the past is refused
«Remove the end date» | Makes the exception permanent until someone takes it back | Not a field | Needs no typing
Exceptions tab toolbar: search by person, what was given or who gave it; filters Kind (Role, Personal permission, Group of roles), Given by, Ending (within 7 / 14 / 30 / 60 days, or no end date). «Take it back» asks for a confirmation only.

Workflow
The life of a role and its permissions
1. An administrator turns on platform admin mode (a fresh authenticator code, valid for a period of activity) and opens «Roles & permissions».
2. They press «New role» (Add a role), type the Arabic and English names and a description, choose the assignment, tick the permissions and choose the scope of each, then press «Save». The platform saves the role and records it in the audit log. Nobody is notified.
3. The role is given to people: by HR on the employee form (Assign employee roles), by a rule (the automatic roles), or through a group of roles. For a person it may carry an end date, typed beside the role on the employee form.
4. The administrator later opens the role (Edit a role and its permissions) to change its permissions. The change reaches every holder at once.
5. Exceptions: whatever is given outside the job title (a manual role, a personal permission, a group of roles) is listed in the Exceptions tab with its end date. An administrator with Change the end date of an exception changes the date, or takes it back at once with Take an exception back after confirming.
6. Every night the platform takes back the exceptions whose last day has passed and records each one in the audit log.
7. Deleting a role (Delete a role, after confirming) makes its holders lose its permissions at once.
Status of an exception | Meaning | Who can change it (permission key) | Moves to
No end date | Holds until someone takes it back | Change the end date of an exception (set a date), Take an exception back (take it back) | Has an end date, or taken back
Has an end date | Holds through its last day (Riyadh time) | Change the end date of an exception (change or remove the date), Take an exception back | No end date, ending soon, or taken back
Ending soon | Ends within 7 days; shown with a warning badge | Same | Ended
Ended and taken back | The last day passed; the permission is gone from that moment | Nobody; the platform does it overnight | Removed from the list
Automatic things
- Every night at 03:00 (Riyadh) the members of the automatic roles are recalculated; they are also refreshed after every change to employees. «Refresh members now» (Refresh the members of the automatic roles now) does it at once.
- Every night at 03:10 (Riyadh) ended exceptions are taken back and written to the audit log.
- The job title role is created, renamed and removed with its title, and the unit head role with its unit.
- Every creation, change, deletion, refresh, end date change and take-back is written to the audit log with the actor's name.
What each person sees: the page shows only in admin mode, and only the tabs and buttons whose keys the person holds. A person can give only what they hold themselves, at a scope no wider than their own.

Business rules
- Scopes: every permission is given with a scope: «Own record only», «Their unit», «Their unit and 1 level below» up to 5 levels, «Their unit and below», «Their whole company», «All companies». The list offers only the scopes the permission itself allows. If a person holds the same permission from several sources, the widest scope wins (FR-80).
- Outside the scope: a record outside a person's scope appears to them as if it did not exist («not found»), not as forbidden.
- Job title and unit head roles follow their title or unit: their name and members cannot be changed by hand, they cannot be deleted or assigned manually. Only their permissions and description can be edited. A job title role starts as a copy of the permissions of a role chosen when the title was created (default «Employee») and an administrator edits it afterwards (FR-68, FR-69).
- A role with a rule cannot become manual and cannot be assigned by hand.
- Built-in roles (such as «Employee» and «System Admin») cannot be deleted.
- The «Employee» role is given automatically to every new employee. It is stored like any other role: it can be removed on the employee form and does not come back by itself (FR-43).
- Head role permissions: every new unit gets a head role that starts with the leader's own account pages and the people, tasks, tickets, team evaluation and career path of the unit and below. Existing roles change only when an administrator edits them.
- Deleting: when a role is deleted, all its holders lose its permissions at once.
- Audit: every creation, change, deletion and refresh is recorded in the audit log under the name of who did it.
- Giving what you do not hold: nobody can give another person a permission at a wider scope than they hold themselves.

Groups of roles and groups of people
Both are managed from the «Permissions» page (see its section); each action has its own key.
Action | What happens | Permission
View groups of roles | They appear on the Permissions page | View groups of roles on the permissions page
Add a group of roles | Bundles roles that go together under one name | Add a role group
Edit a group of roles | Change its name and its roles | Edit a role group
Delete a group of roles | People it was given to lose what came through it | Delete a role group
View groups of people | They appear on the Permissions page | View groups of people on the permissions page
Add a group of people | Chosen people who get the same permissions | Add a user group
Edit a group of people | Change the name and the members | Edit a user group and its members
Delete a group of people | Members lose what came through it | Delete a user group
- A group of roles is given to a person (from the employee form, with the permission Give an employee groups of roles, never beyond what the giver holds) and they then hold all its roles. Permissions placed on the group reach the people it is given to and everyone who holds one of its roles (FR-46).
- A group of people is a set of people you choose by name or e-mail; all of them get the group's permissions.

The Exceptions tab
It lists everything given to a person outside what their job title brings: manual roles, personal permissions and groups of roles, each with its last day, so no permission is forgotten. Columns: person, kind (role/personal permission/group of roles), given, scope, given by, given on, ends on.
Action | What happens | Permission
«Change the end date» | Sets the last day the exception holds, or removes the date | Change the end date of an exception
«Take it back» | Takes it back at once after you confirm; the person loses what it gives | Take an exception back
Export | Exports the list | Export the exceptions
- Filters: kind, given by, «Ends within 7/14/30/60 days», «No end date». Search by person, what was given or who gave it. Table and cards views are available.
- An exception holds through its last day (Riyadh time). After it the permission is gone at once, and the platform takes the row back overnight and records it in the audit log. An exception ending within 7 days shows a warning badge.
- A date in the past is not accepted.
- The «Employee», job title and unit head roles are not exceptions (FR-70).
- The end date is set when the role is given on the employee form (a date beside each ticked role) or from this list.

Tips and common problems
- I do not see the page in the menu: turn on «Platform admin mode» at the top of the page (a fresh code from your authenticator app is needed), and check that you hold View the roles and permissions page and that the page is not hidden from your roles.
- I cannot give an employee a role: you can only give what you hold the keys of, and job title and head roles are calculated automatically.

title: Permissions
text:
What this page is
Every page of the platform has a «view» key, and every button or action (add, edit, delete, approve, export, import…) has its own key. This page is the single place where an administrator decides what a role, a group of roles, one person or a group of people may do, and how far. You choose what the permissions go on, then tick what they may do and the scope.

Who sees it
Item | Detail
View key | View the permissions page
Default scope | All
Platform admin mode | Required
Default roles that hold it | Only the built-in «System Admin» role (it holds every key). Other roles start without the keys of this page and an administrator gives them

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Choose «Place permissions on» (a role / a group of roles / one person / a group of people), then the name | The page shows the current permissions of what you chose | View the permissions page
Tick permissions, choose their scope and save them on a role | They apply to everyone who holds the role | Set the permissions of a role
Save on a group of roles | They apply to everyone the group is given to and everyone who holds one of its roles | Set the permissions of a group of roles
Save on one person | They belong to that person alone, on top of what their roles and groups give | Set the permissions of one person
Save on a group of people | They apply to every member of the group | Set the permissions of a group of people
«Export permissions» (under the matrix) | Downloads a JSON file with the keys of what you chose (a role, a group or a person), their scopes and fields exactly as saved (no draft, nothing that reaches it from elsewhere), to hand to the developer for the seeder. The System Admin holds it by default | Export the permissions of the chosen role, group or person
«New group of roles» | Creates a group bundling roles under one name | Add a role group
«Edit the group» (group of roles) | Change the name and the roles inside | Edit a role group
Delete (group of roles) | Deletes it after you confirm | Delete a role group
«New group of people» | Creates a group of people | Add a user group
«Edit the group» (group of people) | Change the name, add and remove members | Edit a user group and its members
Delete (group of people) | Deletes it after you confirm | Delete a user group
«Select all permissions» / «Clear all» / search | Shortcuts inside the matrix | No extra key
The «Save» button shows only to people who hold the save key for the kind chosen. Groups are listed according to their view keys (View groups of roles on the permissions page and View groups of people on the permissions page).

How to
Place permissions on a role
1. Turn on «Platform admin mode», then open «Permissions».
2. In «Place permissions on» choose «A role», then choose the role in the «Role» list.
3. Tick the permissions a holder of the role may use, and choose the scope of each from the list beside it.
4. Press «Save». The message «Permissions saved.» appears.
Give one person particular permissions
1. Choose «One person».
2. Open the «Person» list, or type a letter of the name or e-mail to narrow it, then choose the person.
3. Tick the extra permissions to give them alone. What already reaches them through their roles and groups shows with the badge «Comes from roles and groups» and its scope.
4. Press «Save».
Create a group of roles and give it permissions
1. Choose «A group of roles» and press «New group of roles».
2. Type the Arabic and English names and an optional description, choose the roles it bundles (search by name) and save.
3. Pick the group from the list, tick the extra permissions for it, and press «Save».
Create a group of people
1. Choose «A group of people» and press «New group of people».
2. Type the two names, search people by name or e-mail and add them, then save.
3. Pick the group, tick its permissions and press «Save».

Scopes
Beside each permission is the scope list (shown only for permissions that allow more than one scope):
Scope | Covers
Own record only | The person's own record
Their unit | Records of their organization unit (and the units they manage)
Their unit and 1 … 5 levels below | The unit and a set number of levels below it
Their unit and below | The unit and everything below with no limit
Their whole company | Every record of their company
All companies | Every company

Fields (form inputs)
The page
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Place permissions on | What kind of thing receives the permissions | Yes | A role, A group of roles, One person, A group of people
Role / Group of roles / Person / Group of people (the second list) | Which one of that kind | Yes | For a person: open the list for the first names, or type a letter of the name or e-mail to narrow it. If there are no groups yet, create the first one with the button below the lists
Search permissions | Finds a permission in the matrix by name or key | No | Free text
Permission tick box | Whether the chosen target holds the permission. A badge «Comes from roles and groups (scope)» shows what already reaches the target from elsewhere; it cannot be ticked off here | No | Up to 500 permissions at once. «Select all permissions» / «Clear all» act on the visible list
Scope (beside each ticked permission) | How far the permission reaches | Yes, for each ticked permission | Only what the permission allows: Own record only, Their unit, Their unit and 1 to 5 levels below, Their unit and below, Their whole company, All companies; never wider than yours
«Fields they may change (N)» (beside «Edit employees») | Chooses the fields of the employee record that the holder may change | No | Same window as on the Roles page; nothing you cannot change yourself
Saving needs the key of the kind chosen: Set the permissions of a role, Set the permissions of a group of roles, Set the permissions of one person or Set the permissions of a group of people.
The window «New group of roles» / «Edit group of roles» (Add a role group / Edit a role group)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Name in Arabic | The group's name in Arabic | Yes | 2 to 120 characters
Name in English | The group's name in English | Yes | 2 to 120 characters
Description | What the bundle is for | No | Up to 500 characters
Add a role to the group | Chooses a role to put in the bundle; search by name | No (a group may start empty) | Existing roles, up to 100 in a group. The list «Roles in the group (N)» lets you take one out; «No roles in this group yet» shows when empty
The window «New group of people» / «Edit group of people» (Add a user group / Edit a user group and its members)
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Name in Arabic | The group's name in Arabic | Yes | 2 to 120 characters
Name in English | The group's name in English | Yes | 2 to 120 characters
Description | What the group is for | No | Up to 500 characters
Search for a person to add | Finds a person by the first letters of the name or e-mail; matching names appear under «Results» | No | Free text; people already in the group can be removed with the remove button beside each name
Members | The people who get the group's permissions | No (a group may start empty) | Up to 2000 people
A group of roles is given to a person from the employee form (Give an employee groups of roles); that choice and its end date are explained in the Roles section.

Workflow
Placing permissions
1. An administrator turns on platform admin mode and opens «Permissions».
2. They choose «Place permissions on», then the role, group or person.
3. They tick the permissions and choose a scope for each, and press «Save». The platform refuses anything wider than what the administrator holds, saves it, and the message «Permissions saved.» appears.
4. The change reaches every person the target covers (all holders of a role; everyone a group is given to and all holders of its roles; one person; every member of a group of people). It applies at once.
5. The audit log records the change with the key names only. Nobody is notified.
Using groups
1. The administrator chooses «A group of roles» (or «A group of people») and presses the new-group button, fills the names, picks the roles (or people) and saves.
2. They pick the group in the list and place permissions on it, as above.
3. HR gives a group of roles to a person from the employee form; members of a group of people are chosen in the group window.
4. Deleting a group (after confirming) removes what reached people through it.
There are no statuses here: permissions and groups are either set or not. Personal permissions later appear in the «Exceptions» tab of the Roles page with their end date, if any.
Automatic things: none run on this page; the nightly take-back of ended exceptions is explained in the Roles section. Every change is written to the audit log.
What each person sees: the page shows only in admin mode, and groups are listed only to people who hold View groups of roles on the permissions page or View groups of people on the permissions page. The «Save» button shows only with the key of the kind chosen.

Business rules
- Nobody places more than they hold: you cannot place a permission at a wider scope than yours, nor fields you cannot change yourself; the attempt is refused.
- Permissions add up: a person gets the total of what comes from their roles, groups of roles, groups of people and what was given to them alone; the widest wins when the same permission repeats. The matrix shows what reaches the chosen target from elsewhere, with a badge beside the permission.
- The fields a holder of «Edit employees» may change: beside this permission a «Fields they may change (count)» button opens a window to choose which fields of the employee record its holder may change, grouped (personal details, contact, work, identity and name, contract and insurance, pay and account, notes, structure and relation) with «Basic», «All» and «None». It starts with the basic data (contact and personal). These fields add to what other roles give the same person, apply to the records the scope reaches, and the person's own record always counts. The unit, job title and manager also need the permission «Change placement from a date».
- Keys are declared: every page and button has a key with Arabic and English labels; a person without a key does not see the button, and the platform refuses the action if they try another way.
- Deleting a group: the people it was given to (or its members) lose the permissions that came through it.
- Audit: every change is recorded in the audit log, with key names only (FR-47).
- Personal permissions later show in the «Exceptions» tab of the Roles page with their end date, if any.
- What an ordinary employee gets: every employee starts with the «Employee» role, which holds their account pages, tasks, tickets, team directory and the structure page. Everything else is given from this page or from the employee form.

Tips and common problems
- The message «This page works in platform admin mode» appears: turn the mode on at the top of the page with a fresh authenticator code; it stops by itself after 30 minutes without admin activity.
- The «Save» button is missing: you need the save key for the kind you chose (role, group of roles, person or group of people).
- I search for a person and they do not show: type the first letter of their name or e-mail.
- Saving was refused: most likely you are trying to give a scope or fields wider than you hold.

title: Audit log
text:
What this page is
A record of every important event on the platform: who did what, when and from which address, as a plain sentence and a category (sign-in, employees, tasks…). Here you review every sign-in and every change to employees, the organization, permissions, tickets, tasks and settings. Values of fields named like a password, secret, token, national ID or IBAN are hidden in it.

Who sees it
Item | Detail
View key | View the audit log page
Default scope | All
Platform admin mode | Required
Default roles that hold it | The built-in «System Admin» role. A «Platform auditor» role exists in the roles list and starts without permissions; an administrator gives it the keys it needs. The «Employee» role and the unit head roles do not hold it

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Open the page, search and filter | Shows the log, newest first, narrowed by what you type or choose | View the audit log page
«View» icon or click on a row | Opens the «Audit entry» window: time, actor, category, action, IP address, the record concerned by name, and the changes line by line (a label for each detail and the name of each role, unit, person… instead of ids; the technical form stays under «Technical details») | View the audit log page
Export button | Exports the log to a file after you choose the scope, columns and file type (columns: when, by, category, action, IP address) | Export the audit log
Integrity check of the log | The platform runs it by itself every week and records any problem; there is no button for it on this page | Check the audit log has not been tampered with
Table columns: when, by (or «System» for automatic events), category, action. You can switch between table and cards.

How to
Find what a person did
1. Turn on «Platform admin mode» and open «Audit log».
2. In the filters type the person's name or e-mail in «Person (name or e-mail)».
3. Set «From date» and «To date» if you want a period.
4. Click any row to see its details.
Find who changed a particular thing
1. Click the tab of the module (for example «Roles and permissions»; «All» shows everything): the tabs sit above the table and are one table of the same records, only narrowed; the «Action» filter then lists that module's actions.
2. Choose the «Action», or type part of the sentence, or the id of the record, in the search box.
Export the log
1. Narrow what you want with the filters.
2. Press the export button and choose the scope (this page or all), the columns and the file type.

Categories
Sign-in and security, Employees, Organization and companies, Roles and permissions, Tickets, Tasks, System settings, Other.

Fields (form inputs)
The audit log is read-only; its inputs are the search box and the filters, plus the export window. Nothing typed here changes a record.
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Search the log | Finds entries by what was done (the sentence, in either language), by who did it, or by the id of the record | No | Free text
Category | One kind of event | No | Sign-in and security, Employees, Organization and companies, Roles and permissions, Tickets, Tasks, System settings, Other
Action | One sentence of the log, such as «Edited an employee» | No | Only the actions of the chosen category are offered; with no category, all actions
Person (name or e-mail) | Entries made by one person | No | Part of the name or e-mail, up to 100 characters
From date | Entries from this day on | No | A date
To date | Entries up to this day | No | A date
Scope (in the «Export data» window) | How many rows go into the file | Yes | «The rows shown on this page (N)» or «All results of the current search and filters (N)»; a single export holds a limited number of rows and the window says when it caps
Columns | Which columns to put in the file | Yes, at least one | «Select all» / «Clear selection»; the window shows «N of M columns»
File type | The format of the file | Yes | Excel (.xlsx) or CSV (.csv)
Export columns offered: When, By, Category, Action, Record, Changes, IP address. Export needs Export the audit log. The «Audit entry» window (click a row) is read-only: time, actor, category, action, IP address and the changes.

Workflow
How an entry is born
1. Someone or something acts on the platform: a person signs in, edits an employee, changes a role, moves a task, saves a setting, or a background job runs.
2. The platform writes one entry in the same breath: who (or «System» for automatic events), what (a plain sentence and its category), the record concerned, the IP address and the changes. A field named like a password, secret, token, national ID or IBAN is stored as «[redacted]», by the field's name and only at the top level of the change (see the rules below for what is not covered).
3. The entry is chained to the one before it with a digital fingerprint, and the database refuses to change or delete it.
4. An auditor with View the audit log page opens the page in admin mode, filters by category, action, person and dates, and opens an entry to read it. Nobody is notified by the page.
5. Every Sunday at 04:00 (Riyadh) the platform checks the whole chain; if it is broken at some entry, it logs an error and records that failure as an entry itself (Check the audit log has not been tampered with is the key for this check; there is no button).
Audit entries have no statuses: they are written once and never change. This is why there is no table of statuses.
Automatic things: entries are written by the platform itself on every important action, including the start and end of a «sign in as» session (each entry made during it carries the administrator's name beside the employee's); the integrity check runs weekly.
What each person sees: only people with View the audit log page in admin mode see the page, and they see the whole log (scope «All»). Nobody can edit or delete an entry, whatever role they hold.

Business rules
- Every action is a plain sentence (for example «moved a task to another status») with a category, not a technical name (FR-63).
- Filters: category, action (only the sentences of the chosen category), person (name or e-mail), from date, to date. Search finds the sentence in either language, the actor's name and the id of the record concerned.
- Some values are hidden: before writing, a change whose field is named like a password, secret, token, national ID or IBAN is stored as «[redacted]». This is by the field's name and only at the top level of the change: a field with another name (for example an API key) or a sensitive value inside a nested field is not covered, so do not rely on the log being free of every sensitive value. Mostly the names of the fields that changed are recorded, not their values (FR-11).
- Never edited or deleted: each entry is chained to the previous one with a digital fingerprint, and the database refuses to change or delete it; the platform checks the chain weekly and records a failure if it breaks (FR-75).
- Signing in as another employee: every entry written during it carries the administrator's name beside the employee's, and the start and end of the session are recorded.
- Time: times show in your device's time zone.
- Read only: nothing on the page changes the log.

Tips and common problems
- I cannot find an event: search with part of the sentence, widen the period, or clear the category.
- The action I look for is not in the list: choose the right category first; the list shows the actions of the chosen category.
- I want to know who changed permissions: filter by the «Roles and permissions» category and open the entry to see the actor, the time and the changes.

title: Sent e-mail log
text:
What this page is
It shows every e-mail the platform sent and its status: Pending, Sent or Failed, with the reason for a failure. Use it to know whether an activation invitation reached an employee, or why a notice did not arrive by e-mail. The message text itself is not stored.

Who sees it
Item | Detail
View key | View the sent e-mail log page
Default scope | All
Platform admin mode | Required
Default roles that hold it | Only the built-in «System Admin» role; the «Employee» role and the unit head roles do not hold it

What you can do
Action | What happens | Permission
Open the page, search and filter | Shows the e-mails, newest first | View the sent e-mail log page
«View» icon or click on a row | Opens the «Sent e-mail» window with the details of the message | View the sent e-mail log page
Export button | Exports the log to a file after you choose the scope, columns and file type | Export the sent e-mail log
Table columns: when, to, subject, category, status, details (the failure reason or the server's reply). You can switch between table and cards.
The details window shows: when, sent at, to, subject, category, status, error, server response.

How to
See what was sent to a person
1. Turn on «Platform admin mode» and open «E-mail log».
2. Type the person's e-mail in the «Person (e-mail)» filter.
3. Click the message you want to see its status.
Look for failed e-mails
1. Choose the status «Failed» in the filters.
2. Open the message and read «Error» and «Server response».
3. If failures repeat, check «Settings → E-mail» and try the service.

Categories and statuses
Categories | Statuses
Account activation invitations, Tickets, Tasks, General notices, E-mail settings test, Other | Pending, Sent, Failed

Fields (form inputs)
The e-mail log is read-only; its inputs are the search box, the filters and the export window.
Field | What it means / what to type | Required | Allowed values / rules
Search e-mails | Finds messages by subject or by the person's e-mail | No | Free text
Status | Where the message stands | No | Pending, Sent, Failed (empty = all statuses)
Category | Why the message was sent | No | Account activation invitations, Tickets, Tasks, General notices, E-mail settings test, Other (empty = all categories)
Person (e-mail) | Messages sent to one address | No | Part of an e-mail, up to 254 characters
From date | Messages from this day on | No | A date
To date | Messages up to this day | No | A date
Scope (in the «Export data» window) | How many rows go into the file | Yes | «The rows shown on this page (N)» or «All results of the current search and filters (N)»; a single export holds a limited number of rows and the window says when it caps
Columns | Which columns to put in the file | Yes, at least one | «Select all» / «Clear selection»; the window shows «N of M columns»
File type | The format of the file | Yes | Excel (.xlsx) or CSV (.csv)
The «Sent e-mail» window (click a row) is read-only: when, sent at, to, subject, category, status, error and server response.

Workflow
1. An action sends a message: HR sends an activation invitation, a task or ticket notice goes by e-mail, an administrator presses «Try» in the e-mail settings or «Send me a test» in the templates.
2. The platform records the message as Pending (recipient, subject, category) just before it hands it to the e-mail service that is switched on in Settings (or the server's own settings when none is on). The message body is never stored, because it can hold one-time links.
3. If the service accepts it, the entry becomes Sent, with the sending time and the server's reply. If the service refuses or cannot be reached, it becomes Failed, with the reason.
4. The system administrator (with View the sent e-mail log page, in admin mode) filters by status, category or person and opens the entry to read the error and the server's reply.
5. If it failed, the administrator checks «Settings → E-mail» and tries the service; the page itself cannot resend or delete a message. To send again, repeat the action that caused it (for an activation invitation, HR resends it with Resend the activation link).
Status | Meaning | Who can change it (permission key) | Moves to
Pending | The message was recorded and is being handed to the service | Nobody; the platform changes it | Sent or Failed
Sent | The service accepted the message (not a proof that it was read) | Nobody | Final
Failed | The service refused it or could not be reached; the reason is shown | Nobody | Final
Automatic things: the notices are sent in the background after the action that caused them, within about a second; every attempt is recorded; no message body is kept.
What each person sees: only people who hold View the sent e-mail log page in admin mode see the page, and they see every e-mail the platform sent (scope «All»). An employee sees their own notices only through the bell.

Business rules
- Filters: status, category, person (e-mail), from date, to date. Search by subject or the person's e-mail (FR-26, FR-63).
- The message text is not stored because it can hold one-time links; only the recipient, subject, status, failure reason and server reply are kept.
- The category is set by whoever sends the message: activation invitations, tickets, tasks, general notices. Test messages (from trying the e-mail service or «Send me a test» in the e-mail templates) are filed as «E-mail settings test». Old messages keep their old category.
- Task and ticket notices carry no sensitive text in the e-mail: only the task or ticket number and the department name.
- The page is read only: it does not resend or delete a message.
- Sending goes through the service switched on in «Settings → E-mail»; if none is on, the server's settings are used.

Tips and common problems
- «Pending» lasts long: refresh after a moment; if it stays, check the e-mail service in Settings.
- The message shows «Sent» but the employee did not get it: it means the server accepted it; ask them to check their junk folder, and check their e-mail address on their record.
- I cannot see the message text: this is intended; it is not stored.

title: Settings
text:
What this page is
One page with tabs that gathers the settings of services and messages: Translation, E-mail, Bot protection, AI, E-mail templates, Notification templates, Welcome tour and Security. Each tab shows only to whoever holds its view key.

Who sees it
Tab | View key | Hidden as page
Translation | View the translation settings page | Translation settings
E-mail | View the e-mail settings page | E-mail settings
Bot protection | View the bot protection page | Bot protection
AI | View the AI settings page | AI service
Address locations | View the address locations (city) page (View the address locations page) | Address locations
E-mail templates | View e-mail templates | E-mail templates
Notification templates | View notification templates | Notification templates
Welcome tour | View the welcome tour settings | Welcome tour
Security | View the security settings (trusted devices and request limits) | Security
Problem reports | View the problem report settings | Problem report settings
- Default scope of all these keys: All.
- Platform admin mode: required; the page appears in the menu after you turn it on.
- Roles: the built-in «System Admin» role holds all these keys and no other role holds them by default (the «Platform configurator» role starts without permissions and an administrator gives it the keys it needs). If you hold the key of no tab, the message «You may not view any of these settings.» appears.

Translation, e-mail, bot protection and AI services
Each of these tabs shows a table of the available services (table or cards) with the columns: service, status, last test, in use. Each row has icons: «How to get the data», edit, «Try», and switch on or off. The table has search, filters (status, in use) and export.
Services in each tab | 
Translation | Amazon Translate, Google Cloud Translation, Azure AI Translator
E-mail | SMTP, Amazon SES, SendGrid, Microsoft 365 (Graph)
Bot protection | Cloudflare Turnstile
AI | Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI-compatible service (free Gemini, Groq…)
Address locations | MaxMind GeoLite2 City (account number and license key from a free MaxMind account; the «How to get the data» icon lists the steps)
Action | What happens | Permission (translation / e-mail / bot protection / AI)
«How to get the data» icon | Opens a window with the steps to get the keys and the meaning of every value (also available inside the edit window) | The view key
Edit (click the row) | Opens the service's data window; whoever holds the edit key can save | Edit translation provider data / Edit e-mail provider data / Edit the bot protection keys / Edit the AI key and model / Edit the address locations service data
«Try» | Tries the service with the data in the form (translates an example, sends a short message to any address, runs a real Turnstile check, or sends one short AI request) | Try a translation provider / Send a test e-mail with an e-mail provider / Try the bot protection keys / Try the AI key / Try the address locations service and download its database
«Switch on» or «Switch off» | Puts the service in use or stops it | Activate and switch off a translation provider / Activate and switch off an e-mail provider / Switch the bot protection on and off / Switch the AI service on and off / Switch the address locations on and off
Export | Exports the list of services | Export the list of translation providers / Export the list of e-mail providers / Export the list of bot protection providers / Export the list of AI providers / Export the list of address location providers (Export the list of translation / e-mail / bot protection / AI / address location providers)
There is no import in these lists because each row is a fixed service, not a record created from a file.
How to set up and switch on a service
1. Open «Settings» and choose the tab (for example «E-mail»).
2. Press the «How to get the data» icon of the service you will use and follow the steps to get the keys.
3. Open the service by clicking its row, fill in the fields, then «Save». A short hint sits under each field.
4. Press «Try»; the test must pass with the same saved data.
5. Press «Switch on». The message «… is now in use.» appears.
Rules of the services
- A service is switched on only when its data is complete and a test with exactly that data has passed. The status goes «Data incomplete», then «Not tested», then «Tested».
- Changing the data of the service in use switches it off until it is tried and switched on again.
- One service is in use per kind at a time.
- Secret keys are never shown after saving (they show «Saved»), are stored encrypted, are never written to the audit log, and are removed from error texts. Leave a secret field empty to keep the saved value.
- With no service switched on: translation and e-mail use the server's settings if they exist (otherwise translation is off); bot protection asks no check; and the «Analyse with AI» button is not offered (FR-59, FR-60, FR-78).
- Bot protection: when on, the Cloudflare widget shows in the e-mail step of the sign-in page and its answer is verified before anything is sent; if Cloudflare cannot be reached within 4 seconds the person is let in and this is recorded. The Microsoft sign-in and the code step are not behind it.
- AI: the text of an uploaded job title file is sent to the service; it is company data, not employee data, so do not put personal data in it. The AI's reading is always reviewed by a person before it is saved.

Guides to get the keys (summary)
Each service has a window with the full steps in Arabic and English and the meaning of each field, plus a reminder: «Keep keys secret. Anyone holding them can use the service on your account.»
Translation
- Amazon Translate: create an IAM user with a policy allowing only translate:TranslateText, then an access key; copy the Access key ID and the Secret access key at once (the secret shows only once) and choose a region where the service is available.
- Google Cloud: enable the Cloud Translation API in your project, create a service account with the role «Cloud Translation API User», then a JSON key and paste the whole file into the field.
- Azure: create a Translator resource, copy Key 1 and the Region from «Keys and Endpoint», and leave the default endpoint.
E-mail
- SMTP: ask the provider for the server, the port (587 or 465), user name and password; turn on «Secure connection» for port 465 only. Microsoft 365: server smtp.office365.com, port 587, with SMTP AUTH enabled.
- Amazon SES: verify your domain or an address, ask to leave the sandbox, and create an IAM user allowed ses:SendEmail only.
- SendGrid: create an API key with Mail Send only, and verify the sender.
- Microsoft 365 (Graph): register an app in Entra, copy the client ID and the tenant ID, create a secret and copy its «Value», grant the Mail.Send application permission with admin consent, and use a real mailbox as the sender.
Bot protection
- Turnstile: in the Cloudflare dashboard → Turnstile add a widget with the platform's hostname in «Managed» mode, copy the «Site key» and the «Secret key», then «Try», solve the check, then «Switch on».
AI
- Anthropic: at console.anthropic.com add a payment method and a small credit, create an API key and copy it at once, and leave the model as it is or change it. You pay by use.
- OpenAI-compatible service: for the free option use «Get API key» in Google AI Studio and leave the address and model as they are. For another service type its https address and a model that supports structured JSON answers.
Address locations
- Create a free MaxMind account, open «Manage license keys», generate a license key and copy it at once, then type it with the account number. «Try» downloads the city database to the server (it can take a minute) and the service can then be switched on. The database is refreshed every Monday at 03:00 (Riyadh) while the service is on.

E-mail templates and notification templates
Here you edit the wording of every e-mail the platform sends (the account activation invitation and the frame of notices sent by e-mail) and every in-app notice (the bell), in Arabic and English. The list columns: message, area (Sign-in, Tickets, Tasks, Notifications), state («Default wording», «Customised», «Waiting for approval»), last change, with search, filters and export.
Action | What happens | Permission (e-mail / notifications)
Open a message | Opens a window with the wording in two languages and a preview with example values | View e-mail templates / View notification templates
Edit the text and save | Saves the new wording or sends it for approval | Edit e-mail templates / Edit notification templates
«Send me a test» (e-mail only) | Sends a test copy to your own address | Send yourself a test of an e-mail template
«Back to default» | Brings back the default wording at once; when second-person approval is on, going back is itself a change that waits for approval | Reset an e-mail template to its default wording / Reset a notification template to its default wording
«Approve» / «Reject» | Approves or rejects a change that is waiting | Approve changes to e-mail templates / Approve changes to notification templates

How to reword a message
1. Open «Settings», then «E-mail templates» (or «Notification templates») and click the message.
2. Choose the language (Arabic or English) and edit the title and text. For e-mail: the preview line, the button label, and the header and button colors, from the seven brand colors only.
3. Type @ inside the text to insert a value the platform fills in (the person's name, the activation link, the task number…) and pick it from the list shown.
4. Check the preview, and for e-mail press «Send me a test» to see the result.
5. Press «Save» (or «Send for approval» if second-person approval is on).
Rules of templates
- The available values are fixed: only the values the platform fills for that message can be used, and some «must stay» (such as the activation link). The platform refuses an unknown value or the removal of a required one.
- E-mail is formatted text (bold, italic, underline, lists, link), cleaned by the platform (no scripts or images), and the platform builds the page itself with the logo, the footer and right-to-left for Arabic; notifications are plain text only.
- The default wording is kept in the platform and is sent when nothing is changed or when a changed message fails to render, so a bad edit never stops a message.
- Second-person approval (off at first): when on, every change stays «Waiting for approval» and the current wording is sent until someone other than its author approves it; the author cannot approve their own change. Whoever holds the approval key can approve or reject.
- A short delay: the new wording may take about 30 seconds to reach every part of the system.
- Audit: every change, approval, rejection and reset is recorded in the audit log (FR-64, FR-65).

Workflow
Setting up and switching on an outside service (translation, e-mail, bot protection, AI)
1. The administrator turns on admin mode, opens «Settings» and the right tab, and presses the «How to get the data» icon to follow the numbered steps for getting the keys.
2. They open the service (click its row), fill the fields and press «Save». The platform stores the secrets encrypted and records in the audit log only the names of the fields that changed.
3. They press «Try» (integrations.<kind>_test). The platform tries the service with exactly that data; if it works, the status becomes «Tested».
4. They press «Switch on» (integrations.<kind>_activate). The message «… is now in use.» appears, and the service starts working. Only one service per kind is in use.
5. If messages later fail, the administrator reads the E-mail log for the error and the server's reply, then fixes the data, saves it (step 2), and repeats steps 3 and 4.

Rewording a message (templates)
1. The administrator opens the message, edits both languages, checks the preview and presses «Send me a test» (e-mail only).
2. They press «Save». If second-person approval is off, the new wording is in use after about 30 seconds. If it is on, the change becomes «Waiting for approval» and the current wording stays in use.
3. A different person with the approve key reads the change and presses «Approve» (it goes live) or «Reject» (it is dropped). The author cannot approve their own change.
4. «Back to default» returns the original wording at once, or, when approval is on, becomes a change that also waits for approval.

Tour steps and security settings: a tour step is edited, switched off, moved or reset and takes effect for the next tour; the security settings are saved with one button and apply at once. Both are recorded in the audit log.
Automatic things: a changed active service is switched off by the platform until it is tried again; a bad template never stops a message because the default is sent when a changed one fails to build; template changes may take about 30 seconds to reach every part of the system; every save, test, switch, approval, rejection and reset is written to the audit log; secrets are removed from error texts.
What each person sees: a tab and its buttons show only to people who hold its keys, in admin mode. A person with no tab key sees «You may not view any of these settings.» No ordinary employee sees this page.

Tips and common problems
- The «Switch on» button is missing: it shows only after the test passes with the saved data (status «Tested») and with the activate key.
- The service was switched off after I edited it: this is intended; try it and switch it on again.
- Messages do not arrive: open the «E-mail log» and read «Error» and «Server response».
- I want to change the service in use: switch on the other service after its test passes, and it replaces the first.
